items.title: 006208擬分割一拆八！12/18開受益人會議 入手一張只要3萬元
items.title_en: Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208) Plans 1‑for‑8 Split; Beneficiary Meeting on Dec 18, One Unit Costs Only NT$30,000
paras: 台股 ETF 人氣王之一－富邦台 50 ETF(006208-TW)終於走上分割之路，富邦投信將於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，表決是否進行基金分割，初估分割倍數為8倍，藉此降低單位交易價格與投資門檻，屆時買進一張只要 3 萬元，讓小資族更容易入手。若議案順利通過，實際分割倍數將依會議通過當日的基金淨值計算。
富邦投信表示，006208追蹤臺灣50指數，持有台股市值最大的50家上市公司。該基金成立於2012年，初次發行價格為30元，隨台股長期走高，截至2026年10月6日，每單位淨值已達266.74元，市價約265.9元，均為發行價的近9倍，投資門檻也隨之提高，因此規劃透過分割，讓交易價格回到投資人較熟悉的區間，並維持市場流動性。
本次分割倍數並非固定8倍，而是依會議通過當日淨值，以回到30元以上的最大整數倍計算。例如，淨值介於240至269.99元，分割倍數為8倍；若介於270至299.99元，則為9倍。若以8倍分割為例，原持有1單位將調整為8單位，單位淨值則相應降低，基金總價值不會因分割而改變。
投資人可自11月26日起留意開會通知，並選擇書面投票，或透過「集保e手掌握」及各大證券下單App進入集保電子投票平台表決。電子投票期間為11月27日至12月15日，受益憑證過戶則自11月19日至12月18日停止辦理。分割案須有代表已發行受益權單位總數過半數的受益人出席，並經出席者表決權過半數同意，才能通過。
006208人氣與規模同步攀升，截至10月8日受益人數已達71.2萬人；基金規模也從2025年底約2897.8億元，增至今年10月6日的4963億元，今年增加逾2000億元、成長超過七成，距離5000億元大關僅一步之遙。值得注意的是，基金規模突破5000億元後，超過該門檻部分適用的經理費率將降至0.08%。若分割案順利過關，006208可望降低投資人進場門檻，進一步提升交易便利性。

paras_en: One of Taiwan's most popular stock ETFs, the Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW), is finally moving toward a split. Fubon Asset Management will hold a written beneficiary meeting on December 18 to vote on whether to split the fund, initially estimating an 8‑for‑1 split to lower the unit price and entry threshold. After the split, a single unit could be bought for just NT$30,000, making it easier for retail investors. If the proposal passes, the exact split ratio will be calculated based on the fund's net asset value on the meeting day.

Fubon Asset Management says that 006208 tracks the Taiwan 50 Index, holding the 50 largest listed Taiwanese companies by market cap. The fund was launched in 2012 with an initial price of NT$30 per unit. As the Taiwan market has risen over the long term, the net asset value per unit reached NT$266.74 as of October 6, 2026, with a market price around NT$265.9—nearly nine times the issue price—raising the investment threshold. The split is intended to bring the trading price back to a range familiar to investors while preserving market liquidity.

The split ratio is not fixed at eight; it will be the largest integer multiple that brings the post‑split price back above NT$30, based on the NAV on the meeting day. For example, if the NAV is between NT$240 and NT$269.99, the split will be 8‑for‑1; if it is between NT$270 and NT$299.99, it will be 9‑for‑1. Using an 8‑for‑1 split as an example, one original unit would become eight units, with the unit NAV proportionally reduced, leaving the fund’s total value unchanged.

Investors can start watching for the meeting notice from November 26 and vote in writing, or use the “CDRC e‑Hand” platform and major brokerage apps to access the electronic voting system. The electronic voting period runs from November 27 to December 15, and the transfer of beneficiary certificates is suspended from November 19 to December 18. The split proposal requires attendance by beneficiaries representing more than half of the issued units and approval by a majority of the voting rights present.

The popularity and size of 006208 have both risen. As of October 8, the fund has 712,000 beneficiaries, and its assets under management grew from about NT$289.78 billion at the end of 2025 to NT$496.3 billion on October 6 this year—an increase of over NT$200 billion and more than 70% growth, putting it just shy of the NT$500 billion milestone. Notably, once assets exceed NT$500 billion, the management fee on the excess portion drops to 0.08%. If the split is approved, 006208 could lower entry barriers and further improve trading convenience.

items.title: 南韓散戶買不動了？資金4個月蒸發51兆韓元、KOSPI連跌7日、AI信用風險添壓力
items.title_en: South Korean Retail Investors Stalled? Funds Evaporate 51 Trillion Won in Four Months, KOSPI Falls Seven Days Straight, AI Credit Risk Adds Pressure
paras: 南韓股市散戶資金快速萎縮，市場承接賣壓的能力面臨考驗。南韓金融投資協會數據顯示，截至10月22日，南韓證券帳戶投資者存款餘額降至88.68兆韓元，較6月4日創下的139.69兆韓元歷史高點減少約51兆韓元，跌幅達36.5%，回到年初水準。
南韓證券帳戶投資者存款餘額在10月21日首度跌破90兆韓元，為近9個月來首見，也創下1月13日以來新低。與此同時，韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）10月經歷連續7個交易日下跌，並於10月15日單日重挫7.57%，外資持續賣超的壓力也尚未消退。
散戶資金曾是今年上半年支撐韓股的重要力量，透過大規模買進抵銷部分外資賣壓；如今投資者存款持續減少，市場可動用的潛在買盤隨之收縮。
面對股市劇烈震盪，市場對後續反彈能否延續看法分歧，焦點在於半導體企業獲利前景能否抵銷人工智慧（AI）產業信用風險升高帶來的疑慮。

南韓散戶資金4個月減少36.5%

投資者存款是指投資人存入證券帳戶、尚未用於購買股票或其他資產的資金，通常被視為股市潛在買盤的指標。
不過，存款下降不一定代表資金全數撤出股市，也可能是投資人將現金投入股票，因此不能直接將存款減少額視為資金流出規模。
今年上半年，隨著KOSPI走揚，投資者存款持續增加，顯示資金累積速度一度高於買進股票的消耗速度。然而，存款餘額在6月4日觸及歷史高點後轉為下滑，反映散戶新增資金累積的動能減弱。
10月以來，資金收縮速度進一步加快。投資者存款從10月12日的100.44兆韓元，降至10月15日的96.91兆韓元，短短3天減少3.53兆韓元，隨後更進一步跌至88兆韓元區間。
與此同時，衡量融資槓桿投資規模的融資餘額也在本月中旬降至約32兆韓元，顯示現金存款與槓桿資金同步收縮。

散戶仍持續買進　承接外資賣壓的能力減弱

儘管投資者存款大幅下降，散戶並未全面退出市場。
數據顯示，6月4日至10月23日期間，個人投資者在KOSPI市場淨買進股票44.17兆韓元，在KOSDAQ淨買進3.15兆韓元，ETF淨買進規模更達28.25兆韓元，散戶在技術層面仍是市場的淨買進方。
更值得關注的是，散戶持續投入資金買股，但新增資金補充速度可能已跟不上買進所消耗的現金，使帳戶內可用存款不斷減少。
上半年，散戶充裕的資金為市場提供緩衝，得以在外資賣出時承接部分賣壓；如今存款餘額已回落至年初水準，散戶支撐市場的能力可能因此受限。
KOSPI近期走勢也加劇市場對流動性的憂慮。指數自10月6日起連跌7個交易日，10月15日更重挫7.57%；截至10月23日，KOSPI收在5,550.30點，過去一個月累計跌幅接近20%。
在外資持續賣超、散戶資金池同步縮小的情況下，市場買盤支撐可能進一步減弱。此外，融資餘額下降也反映槓桿資金正在收縮；若市場波動進一步加劇並引發強制平倉，可能增加股價下跌壓力。

AI信用風險成反彈變數　半導體基本面受關注

對於韓股後市，市場看法並不一致。樂觀一方認為，以半導體製造商為代表的核心企業仍具備穩健獲利能力，近期指數跌幅相對於企業基本面可能過大，因此存在反彈空間。
不過，謹慎派認為，股市能否持續回升，仍取決於AI產業相關風險是否緩解。
一名證券公司人士表示，KOSPI近期跌幅相較獲利基本面確實過大，但先前推動市場上漲的AI產業如今面臨顯著信用風險疑慮，因此目前就期待反彈持續，仍言之過早。
AI產業信用風險升高，正考驗此前支撐市場上漲的投資邏輯。在相關不確定性消退前，散戶資金能否重新回流仍有待觀察；而投資者存款持續下滑，也可能使韓股在面臨外資賣壓時，缺乏足夠的買盤緩衝。
paras_en: South Korean retail investors' funds are shrinking rapidly, testing the market's ability to absorb selling pressure. Data from the Korea Financial Investment Association shows that as of October 22, the balance of deposits held by investors in Korean securities accounts fell to 88.68 trillion won, about 51 trillion won less than the historic high of 139.69 trillion won reached on June 4, a drop of 36.5% back to the level at the start of the year.

The balance of deposits in Korean securities accounts fell below 90 trillion won for the first time on October 21, the first such dip in nearly nine months and a new low since January 13. At the same time, the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) experienced seven consecutive trading days of decline in October and plunged 7.57% in a single day on October 15, with foreign investors' net selling pressure still unabated.

Retail funds had been a key support for Korean equities in the first half of the year, offsetting part of the foreign selling pressure through large‑scale buying; now, as investor deposits continue to shrink, the pool of potential buying power available to the market is also contracting.

Amid the market's sharp volatility, opinions diverge on whether any rebound can be sustained, with the focus on whether semiconductor earnings can offset growing concerns over credit risk in the artificial‑intelligence (AI) sector.

South Korean retail funds have fallen 36.5% over four months. Investor deposits refer to cash placed in securities accounts that has not yet been used to purchase stocks or other assets and are usually seen as an indicator of potential buying pressure in the market.

However, a decline in deposits does not necessarily mean that all funds have been withdrawn from the market; investors may simply be moving cash into stocks, so the reduction in deposits should not be taken as a direct measure of outflows.

In the first half of the year, as the KOSPI rose, investor deposits kept increasing, showing that the speed of fund accumulation once outpaced the rate of cash being spent on stock purchases. After hitting a historic high on June 4, the deposit balance turned downward, reflecting a weakening momentum in new retail fund accumulation.

Since October, the pace of fund contraction has accelerated. Investor deposits fell from 100.44 trillion won on October 12 to 96.91 trillion won on October 15, a drop of 3.53 trillion won in just three days, and then slid further into the 88‑trillion‑won range.

At the same time, the margin balance, which measures the scale of leveraged financing, also fell to about 32 trillion won in mid‑month, indicating that cash deposits and leveraged funds are shrinking together.

Retail investors are still buying, but their ability to absorb foreign selling pressure is weakening. Despite the sharp drop in investor deposits, retail investors have not completely exited the market.

Data show that from June 4 to October 23, individual investors net bought 44.17 trillion won worth of stocks on the KOSPI, net bought 3.15 trillion won on the KOSDAQ, and net bought 28.25 trillion won of ETFs, meaning retail investors remain net buyers on a technical level.

More noteworthy is that while retail investors continue to pour money into stocks, the speed at which new funds are added may no longer keep up with the cash consumed by purchases, causing the usable deposit balance in accounts to keep shrinking.

In the first half of the year, ample retail funds provided a buffer for the market, allowing it to absorb some of the foreign selling pressure; now that deposit balances have fallen back to early‑year levels, the retail sector's ability to support the market may be limited.

The recent KOSPI trend has also heightened concerns about liquidity. The index has fallen for seven consecutive trading days since October 6, with a steep 7.57% drop on October 15; as of October 23, the KOSPI closed at 5,550.30 points, down nearly 20% over the past month.

With foreign investors continuing to sell net and the retail fund pool shrinking in tandem, market buying support could weaken further. Moreover, the decline in margin balances shows leveraged funds are also contracting; if volatility intensifies and triggers forced liquidations, downward pressure on stock prices could increase.

AI credit risk becomes a variable for rebounds while semiconductor fundamentals draw attention. Views on the Korean equity outlook are divided. Optimists argue that core companies, represented by semiconductor manufacturers, still have solid earnings potential and that the recent index decline may be excessive relative to fundamentals, leaving room for a rebound.
Cautious investors, however, contend that whether the market can keep rising depends on whether risks associated with the AI industry are alleviated.

A securities‑firm insider said that while the recent KOSPI decline does appear larger than what earnings fundamentals would justify, the AI sector that previously drove market gains now faces significant credit‑risk concerns, making it premature to expect a sustained rebound.

Rising credit risk in the AI industry is testing the investment logic that previously supported market gains. Until those uncertainties subside, it remains to be seen whether retail funds will flow back in; continued declines in investor deposits could also leave Korean stocks without enough buying‑side cushioning when foreign selling pressure returns.

items.title: AI股大跌使「這國」股市成避風港！表現大勝歐股
items.title_en: AI Stock Slump Turns This Country's Market into a Safe Haven, Outperforming European Shares
paras: 歐洲股市面臨借貸成本攀升、人工智慧（AI）投資交易疑慮及政治動盪等多重壓力，瑞士大型權值股卻逆勢走強，成為市場亮點。
根據《彭博》報導，追蹤瑞士20家規模最大、流動性最高企業的瑞士市場指數（SMI），本月上漲4.6%；相較之下，歐元區主要股市指數Euro Stoxx 50下跌3.2%。
瑞士指數領先近8個百分點，為2020年3月新冠疫情衝擊市場、投資人紛紛尋求避險以來，表現優於該歐元區指數的最大差距。
這波漲勢顯示，面對借貸成本上升、對人工智慧（AI）投資交易的疑慮，以及法國、西班牙等國的政治動盪，投資人正降低在歐洲市場承擔的風險。
瑞士股市的表現主要由市值最大的3家公司帶動。製藥商羅氏（Roche Holding AG）與諾華（Novartis AG）10月股價分別上漲12%及6.7%；全球最大食品公司雀巢（Nestlé SA）則上漲10%。這3家防禦型企業的股價漲幅，已貢獻瑞士市場指數本月全部的漲幅。
報導指出，瑞士股市走強，也反映歐洲市場整體轉向所謂的防禦型股票。這類企業的業績較不容易隨經濟景氣循環大幅波動。投資人目前偏好獲利能力強、資產負債表健全，且較不容易受到借貸成本上升影響的公司。
由於羅氏、諾華與雀巢合計占SMI近一半的指數權重，瑞士市場成為這波資金轉向的主要受益者之一。
EFG資產管理瑞士股票主管Damian Burkhardt表示：「投資人看好瑞士股票的防禦特性，也正積極尋找熱門AI交易以外的替代選擇。醫療保健類股先前是AI交易的資金來源，如今這種情況正在逆轉。」
美國銀行最新的基金經理人調查也顯示，市場對瑞士股票的情緒明顯改善。受訪者中，淨16%將瑞士列為最看好的歐洲股票市場。
瑞士指數中市值較小的成分股也同步上漲，其中香精香料製造商奇華頓（Givaudan SA）與皮膚科醫療公司高德美（Galderma Group AG）漲幅最大。另一方面，SMI本月僅有4檔成分股下跌，而且全數屬於景氣循環型企業。
這波表現反轉，發生在瑞士股市經歷一段低迷期之後。瑞士指數向來因能源與科技產業權重有限，未能充分受惠於今年表現突出的這兩大產業。
本十年以來，若以當地貨幣計算並納入股息，SMI累計報酬率為69%，表現不及累計報酬翻倍的Euro Stoxx 50。
此次反彈也反映投資人對瑞士指數成分企業2027年獲利成長加速的信心。根據彭博情報（Bloomberg Intelligence）彙整的數據，這些企業2027年獲利成長率預估將達10%，接近今年預期增幅的兩倍。
不過，檢視SMI估值後，也不免令人質疑這波漲勢還能持續多遠。近期股價上漲已使指數估值重回過去十年來可視為偏貴的區間；無論從絕對估值來看，還是相較於Euro Stoxx 50，瑞士股市目前都顯得昂貴。相對於Euro Stoxx 50，SMI的估值更來到近兩年高點。
瑞郎走弱，也改善了瑞士出口導向型大型企業的獲利展望。目前瑞郎兌美元匯率已回落至2025年上半年曾見的水準。
過去7個月，瑞郎兌歐元也走貶；不過，由於交易人士尋求避險，以防範歐元區、尤其是法國的政治緊張局勢，本月瑞郎已收復部分跌幅。
瑞士寶盛銀行（Bank J. Safra Sarasin）股票策略師Wolf von Rotberg表示，利率、美元走勢及總體經濟景氣動能見頂，通常是影響瑞士股市表現的關鍵因素。他本月已將瑞士股市評等調升至「優於大盤」。
他指出：「這三項因素近期都對SMI有利。月初總體經濟動能開始轉弱，當時美國總體經濟動能已觸頂，為先前遭到重挫的瑞士股票反彈創造了理想環境。

paras_en: European stock markets are under multiple pressures, including rising borrowing costs, doubts over AI investment trading, and political turmoil, while large-cap Swiss stocks are moving higher against the trend, becoming a market highlight.

According to Bloomberg, the Swiss Market Index (SMI), which tracks the 20 largest and most liquid Swiss companies, rose 4.6% this month; by contrast, the Euro Stoxx 50, the main Euro‑area equity index, fell 3.2%.
The Swiss index leads by almost eight percentage points, marking the widest gap since March 2020 when the COVID‑19 pandemic hit markets and investors began seeking safe havens.

This rally shows that, faced with higher borrowing costs, concerns about AI‑driven trading, and political unrest in countries such as France and Spain, investors are reducing risk exposure in European markets.

The performance of the Swiss market is driven mainly by its three biggest companies. Pharmaceutical giants Roche Holding AG and Novartis AG saw their October shares rise 12% and 6.7% respectively, while the world’s largest food company Nestlé SA gained 10%. The gains of these three defensive stocks accounted for the entire monthly rise in the SMI.

The report notes that the strength of Swiss equities also reflects a broader shift in Europe toward defensive stocks, whose earnings are less prone to large swings with the economic cycle. Investors now favor companies with strong profitability, solid balance sheets, and lower sensitivity to rising borrowing costs.
Because Roche, Novartis and Nestlé together make up nearly half of the SMI’s weighting, the Swiss market has become one of the main beneficiaries of this capital rotation.

Damian Burkhardt, head of Swiss equities at EFG Asset Management, said: "Investors like the defensive nature of Swiss stocks and are actively looking for alternatives to the hot AI‑trading theme. Healthcare stocks were previously a source of AI‑trading capital, and that dynamic is now reversing."

A recent fund‑manager survey by Bank of America also shows sentiment toward Swiss equities has improved markedly, with a net 16% of respondents naming Switzerland as the most attractive European equity market.

Smaller‑cap constituents of the SMI also rose, led by fragrance maker Givaudan SA and dermatology company Galderma Group AG. By contrast, only four SMI components fell this month, all of which are cyclical firms.

This reversal comes after a period of weakness for Swiss equities. The Swiss index has traditionally not benefited much from the energy and technology sectors, which have been the year’s standout performers.

Over the past decade, when measured in local currency and including dividends, the SMI has delivered a cumulative return of 69%, lagging behind the Euro Stoxx 50, which has more than doubled its return.

The rebound also reflects investor confidence that earnings growth for SMI constituents will accelerate by 2027. Bloomberg Intelligence data project a 10% earnings growth rate for these companies in 2027, roughly twice the pace expected for this year.

However, a look at SMI valuations raises questions about how far the rally can continue. Recent price gains have pushed the index’s valuation back into a range that can be considered expensive by the past ten years’ standards; both on an absolute basis and relative to the Euro Stoxx 50, Swiss stocks now appear pricey. Compared with the Euro Stoxx 50, SMI valuation has risen to near a two‑year high.
A weaker franc has also improved profit outlooks for large export‑oriented Swiss firms. The franc‑to‑dollar rate has fallen back to levels last seen in the first half of 2025.

Over the past seven months the franc has also depreciated against the euro; however, as traders seek safe‑haven assets to hedge against political tension in the euro area, especially France, the franc has recovered part of its losses this month.

Wolf von Rotberg, stock strategist at Bank J. Safra Sarasin, said that interest rates, the dollar’s trajectory and the topping‑out of overall economic momentum are usually key drivers of Swiss equity performance. He upgraded his rating on Swiss stocks to "outperform" this month.

He added: "All three factors have recently been favorable for the SMI. At the start of the month, overall economic momentum began to weaken, and US economic momentum had already peaked, creating an ideal environment for the Swiss stocks that had previously been battered to rebound."

items.title: 〈熱門股〉防詐業務需求強勁 GOGOLOOK股價周漲2成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Strong Demand for Anti-Fraud Services, GOGOLOOK Shares Jump 20% This Week
paras: 信任科技服務商GOGOLOOK(6902-TW)受惠於海外市場擴張與多元產品線布局，9月營收續創單月新高紀錄，由於積極拓展防詐事業和金融科技，屬剛性需求，股價較未受大盤明顯波動的衝擊，本周股價大漲20%，周線連2紅，續戰歷史前高。
GOGOLOOK前三季合併營收3.36億元，年增25.7%，創單季新高，今年前三季營收9.48 億元，年增 26.9%，也創同期新高，GOGOLOOK樂觀看待，隨著營運規模突破關鍵門檻，獲利將隨營收規模同步放大，且下半年獲利將優於上半年。
GOGOLOOK主要發展消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務，其中，隨著海內外企業與政府機構積極提升資安防護能，GOGOLOOK防詐情資解決方案(ASI)在日本與合作夥伴推廣順利，將持續拓展更多海外市場。
GOGOLOOK 強調，持續投入 AI 防詐技術創新，主要鎖定東南亞7億人口市場，並將同步布局歐美地區，與國際組織、各國政府和大型企業合作。
而在金融科技服務方面，GOGOLOOK旗下JUJI 招財麻吉在風險控管、營收規模等營運表現持續優於內部預期，占整體營收比重可望上看30%。
在消費者防詐端，隨著詐騙手法日新月異，GOGOLOOK因應消費者的需求，旗下Whoscall持續迭代產品功能，近日開啟「自訂來電者名稱」功能，讓陌生來電不再陌生。
paras_en: Trust technology provider GOGOLOOK (6902-TW) benefited from overseas market expansion and a diversified product lineup, with September revenue setting a new monthly record. Driven by aggressive growth in its anti‑fraud business and fintech—both considered rigid demand—the stock was less affected by broader market volatility and surged 20% this week, posting two consecutive weekly gains and pushing toward a historic high.

GOGOLOOK reported combined revenue of NT$3.36 billion for the first three quarters, up 25.7% year‑over‑year and a new quarterly peak. Total revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$9.48 billion, up 26.9% YoY, also a record for the period. The company is optimistic that as its operating scale crosses key thresholds, profit will grow proportionally with revenue, and that second‑half earnings will surpass the first half.

GOGOLOOK’s core businesses are consumer anti‑fraud, enterprise anti‑fraud, and fintech services. With domestic and foreign enterprises and government agencies actively strengthening cybersecurity, GOGOLOOK’s anti‑fraud intelligence solution (ASI) is being successfully promoted in Japan with partners and will continue to expand into more overseas markets.

The company emphasizes ongoing investment in AI‑driven anti‑fraud technology, targeting the 700‑million‑person Southeast Asian market while simultaneously building a presence in Europe and the United States, collaborating with international organizations, governments and large corporations.

In fintech, GOGOLOOK’s subsidiary JUJI Zhaocai Maji has consistently outperformed internal expectations in risk control and revenue growth, and its contribution to total revenue could rise to about 30%.

On the consumer anti‑fraud front, as scam tactics evolve rapidly, GOGOLOOK responds to user needs through its Whoscall app, which continuously adds new features. Recently it launched a “custom caller name” function, making unknown calls recognizable.

items.title: SpaceX、中國競逐太空算力！全球市場2035年估達兆美元
items.title_en: SpaceX and China Race for Space Computing Power! Global Market Projected to Reach Trillions of Dollars by 2035
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）運算需求持續攀升，將算力基礎設施部署至太空，正成為全球科技業與資本市場競逐的新領域。SpaceX計畫自2028年起部署軌道AI運算衛星，利用太陽能緩解地面資料中心面臨的電力限制；中國業者也積極布局，目標在2030年打造萬卡級太空超級電腦中心。
根據《財富》報導，在10月22日於成都舉行的《財富》中國500強論壇上，太空算力及其應用前景成為討論焦點。中科天算董事長兼執行長劉垚圻表示，即使外界質疑太空算力可能形成泡沫，這項技術的核心意義仍在於拓展人類活動與科技發展的邊界。
劉垚圻指出，若能在太空實現通訊、導航、遙測及算力服務，將有助於推動全球算力資源更廣泛地普及。衛星、網際網路與遙測等資訊基礎設施，本身就具有實際需求；更具經濟價值的機會，則在於利用太空技術解決過去難以處理的問題。
根據報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年6月完成創紀錄的首次公開募股（IPO），並在招股書中揭示建設太空資料中心的構想，計畫從2028年起部署軌道AI運算衛星。
這項計畫希望運用太空中近乎不受限制的太陽能，突破地面資料中心受到電網容量與電力供應限制的瓶頸，並以每年部署100吉瓦（GW）太空算力為目標。
美國能源資訊署數據顯示，若持續運轉，支撐100GW算力所需的發電資源，相當於美國去年全年發電量的五分之一。
不過，太空算力的應用不只限於大型運算設施。劉垚圻認為，未來太空網路也可能直接服務一般消費者及小型企業。他以漁民尋找魚群為例，未來漁民或許能透過應用程式向衛星查詢鮪魚位置，進一步取得魚群方位、最佳下網時機，甚至市場銷售建議。
中科天算公布的「天算計畫」則設定在2030年打造萬卡級太空超算中心，為全球提供即時智慧空天資訊服務。
劉垚圻認為，中國開源、開放的技術生態將是實現這項目標的重要因素，也可能有助於相關服務獲得開發中國家及全球使用者的接受。

中國加速布局　太空算力朝實用化發展

太空算力也逐漸進入中國的基礎設施布局。報導指出，多家機構預測，到2035年，全球太空算力相關市場規模有望達到兆美元級別，中國也已將太空算力納入戰略性新型基礎設施的發展方向。
2025年，中國利用長征二號丁運載火箭，從酒泉衛星發射中心將首批12顆太空計算衛星送入軌道。報導稱，這個小型星座的算力已相當於微型地面計算中心，並標誌著全球首個實用化太空算力網路正式投入運行。
隨著太空算力逐步發展，太空與地面業務的整合也受到關注。馬斯克近日證實，特斯拉與SpaceX已就潛在合併事宜展開討論。他向投資人表示，雙方在AI軟體、晶片設計、機器人技術及通信連結等領域有所合作。
以最新收盤價計算，若兩家公司合併，可能形成估值高達3.5兆美元的企業。摩根士丹利近期報告則提出SpaceX企業AI業務的估值框架，估計SpaceX每新增1GW自有軌道算力，理論上可為股價增加約27美元，相當於當前股價約18%。
這也反映出，市場對AI算力的需求與供應焦慮，正逐漸轉化為投資人對未來軌道運算能力的估值。

技術與回報仍有不確定性　長期投資考驗耐心

儘管太空算力前景受到關注，相關發展仍面臨高額投入、建設週期長、技術難題及投資回報不確定等挑戰，距離大規模商業化仍有許多問題需要克服。
和暄資本總裁兼管理合夥人張夢涵在10月21日於成都舉行的2026年《財富》40U40創想會上表示，中國並非缺乏人才或資本，真正欠缺的往往是耐心。
張夢涵以馬斯克的創業經歷為例指出，許多企業決策從短期角度來看可能並不合理，但若將時間拉長至10年或20年，結果可能截然不同。
他認為，偉大企業在創立初期未必能清楚呈現商業模式；SpaceX目前主要依靠星鏈業務，未來AI算力、尤其是太空算力，也可能成為其重要的商業方向。
paras_en: As demand for artificial intelligence (AI) computing continues to climb, deploying compute infrastructure in space is becoming a new battleground for the global tech industry and capital markets. SpaceX plans to launch orbital AI computing satellites starting in 2028, using solar power to alleviate the electricity constraints faced by ground data centers; Chinese firms are also actively positioning themselves, aiming to build a ten‑thousand‑GPU‑class space super‑computer center by 2030.

According to a report by Fortune, the prospect of space computing and its applications was a focal point at the Fortune China 500 Forum held in Chengdu on October 22. Liu Yaodi, chairman and CEO of Zhongke Tiansuan, said that even if outsiders doubt that space computing could become a bubble, the core significance of the technology lies in expanding the boundaries of human activity and technological development.

Liu noted that achieving communications, navigation, telemetry and computing services in space would help spread global computing resources more broadly. Satellite, internet and telemetry infrastructures already have concrete demand; the greater economic value lies in using space technology to solve problems that were previously hard to tackle.

The report states that SpaceX (SPCX‑US) completed a record‑setting initial public offering in June this year and disclosed in its prospectus the concept of building a space data center, planning to deploy orbital AI computing satellites from 2028 onward.

The project aims to harness the virtually unlimited solar energy in space to break through the bottlenecks of grid capacity and power supply that limit ground data centers, targeting the deployment of 100 GW of space‑based computing power each year.

U.S. Energy Information Administration data show that sustaining 100 GW of computing power would require electricity equivalent to one‑fifth of the United States’ total electricity generation last year if operated continuously.

However, the applications of space computing are not limited to large‑scale facilities. Liu believes that future space networks could also serve ordinary consumers and small businesses directly. He cites fishermen searching for schools of fish as an example: in the future, they might use an app to query satellites for tuna locations, obtain the school’s position, optimal net‑dropping timing, and even market‑sale recommendations.

Zhongke Tiansuan’s announced “Tiansuan Project” sets a goal to build a ten‑thousand‑GPU‑class space super‑computer center by 2030, providing real‑time intelligent aerospace information services worldwide.
Liu says that China’s open‑source, open‑technology ecosystem will be a key factor in achieving this goal and could help related services gain acceptance among developing‑country and global users.

China Accelerates Its Layout – Space Computing Moves Toward Practical Use
Space computing is gradually becoming part of China’s infrastructure strategy. The report notes that several institutions forecast the global space‑computing market could reach a trillion‑dollar scale by 2035, and China has already incorporated space computing into its strategic new‑type infrastructure development agenda.

In 2025, China will use a Long March 2D‑D carrier rocket to launch the first batch of 12 space‑computing satellites from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The report says the small constellation’s computing power is comparable to a micro ground‑based computing center, marking the world’s first operational practical space‑computing network.

As space computing develops, the integration of space and ground businesses is drawing attention. Elon Musk recently confirmed that Tesla and SpaceX have begun discussions about a potential merger. He told investors that the two companies cooperate in AI software, chip design, robotics and communications linking.

Based on the latest closing prices, a merger could create an entity valued at up to $3.5 trillion. A recent Morgan Stanley report presented a valuation framework for SpaceX’s enterprise AI business, estimating that each additional 1 GW of proprietary orbital computing power could theoretically boost the stock price by about $27, roughly an 18% increase from the current price.
This reflects how market anxiety over AI compute supply and demand is gradually turning into investor valuation of future orbital computing capability.

Technology and Returns Remain Uncertain – Long‑Term Investment Tests Patience
Despite the attention on space computing’s prospects, development still faces high capital outlays, long construction cycles, technical challenges and uncertain investment returns, leaving many hurdles before large‑scale commercialization can be achieved.

Zhang Menghan, president and managing partner of He Xuan Capital, said at the 2026 Fortune 40U40 Innovation Forum in Chengdu on October 21 that China does not lack talent or capital; what it truly lacks is patience.

Citing Musk’s entrepreneurial journey, Zhang pointed out that many corporate decisions may seem unreasonable in the short term, but when stretched over ten or twenty years, the outcomes can be completely different.

He believes great companies may not clearly present a business model in their early stages; SpaceX currently relies mainly on its Starlink business, and in the future AI computing—especially space computing—could become another important commercial direction.

items.title: 咔嚓一聲！多位網友曬圖：iPhone Duo剛到手螢幕就裂開
items.title_en: Snap! Multiple Netizens Share Photos: iPhone Duo’s Screen Cracks as Soon as It’s Unboxed
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊機iPhone Duo 開售首日（10 月 23 日），在社交媒體上就開始流傳多張螢幕出現裂紋的照片，裂紋多沿摺疊線向螢幕中心延伸，並向右側邊緣出現一排疑似壞點，損壞形態較為相似。
一名澳洲用戶稱手機到手約6小時、開合不到20次，向朋友展示展開時先感到內鉸鏈下方異樣，隨後聽到清晰咔嚓聲，螢幕隨即沿鉸鏈裂開，螢幕表面與外部鉸鏈均無磕碰或夾痕，他前往Apple Store，蘋果直接為其更換故障機。
據《都市快報》周六（24日）報導，中國也有用戶說，正常展開螢幕時聽到咔嚓一聲，摺疊處出現一道約3釐米黑色豎裂痕，另有一條較細裂痕貫穿螢幕右半，而且目前已經出現多例類似損壞。
目前來看，應該是iPhone Duo鉸鏈出現一些問題，但規模不算大，有可能是裝配公差導致，而非設計問題，具體情況還有待後續觀察。
在iPhone Duo開售首日，蘋果同步上線官方自助維修手冊與配套支持文檔，覆蓋電池、螢幕、鏡頭、揚聲器、邏輯板、USB-C 接口等大量部件更換流程。
在配套官方支持文檔中，蘋果列出多種可能出現的狀況，包括裝置無法完全開合、開合時出現異常噪音、鉸鏈鬆動、鉸鏈彎曲或斷裂，以及外殼損壞影響鉸鏈使用等。蘋果建議用戶按照官方指引排查，必要時尋求售後支援。
如果蘋果售後檢測確認非人為導致，將會給用戶更換新機。如果是人為磕碰導致問題則要用戶自己付費維修。按照官網公示，未購買AppleCare+時螢幕損壞保外維修預估人民幣7,998元，購買後螢幕及意外損壞服務費為628元。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, on its first day of sales (October 23). On social media, numerous photos quickly surfaced showing screen cracks, many extending from the fold line toward the center of the display and a row of suspected dead pixels along the right edge, with a similar damage pattern across the reports.

An Australian user said the phone had been in his hands for about six hours and opened and closed fewer than 20 times. When he unfolded it for a friend, he first felt something abnormal under the inner hinge, then heard a clear “snap” and the screen cracked along the hinge. There were no impacts or dents on the screen surface or the external hinge. He went to an Apple Store, and Apple replaced the defective unit on the spot.

According to the Metro Daily on Saturday (the 24th), a user in China reported hearing a snap when the screen was opened normally, followed by a roughly 3‑centimeter black vertical crack at the fold, plus a finer crack running across the right half of the screen. Similar cases have already been reported.

At present it appears the iPhone Duo’s hinge may have some issues, but the problem is not widespread. It could be due to assembly tolerances rather than a design flaw, and the exact cause will need further observation.

On the iPhone Duo’s launch day, Apple simultaneously released an official self‑repair manual and supporting documentation covering replacement procedures for a wide range of components, including battery, screen, camera, speaker, logic board, USB‑C port, and more.

The official support documents list several possible conditions, such as the device not opening fully, abnormal noises during opening/closing, loose hinge, bent or broken hinge, and chassis damage affecting hinge operation. Apple advises users to follow the guidelines for troubleshooting and to seek after‑sales support when necessary.

If Apple’s after‑sales inspection confirms the issue was not caused by user action, the user will receive a replacement device. If the problem is due to accidental impact, the user must pay for the repair. According to Apple’s website, out‑of‑warranty screen repair costs RMB 7,998 without AppleCare+, while with AppleCare+ the screen and accidental damage service fee is RMB 628.

items.title: OpenAI奧特曼示警AI恐加劇貧富差距！籲限制自我進化速度
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Warns AI Could Widen Wealth Gap and Calls for Limits on Self‑Improvement Speed
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）近日接受科技YouTuber Matthew Berman專訪，談及人工智慧（AI）意識、遞迴自我改進（RSI）、算力競賽及未來工作型態。他警告，若任由AI技術自由發展，社會不平等可能進一步擴大，並主張對AI自我改進的速度設下限制，避免技術競爭演變成失控風險。
這場由科技Podcast Forward Future發布的訪談中，奧特曼多次強調，AI發展的目標不應只是讓商品與服務變得更便宜、更容易取得，而是讓人們擁有更多自由、時間與自主決定生活的能力。
他希望AI帶來的未來更接近一場「新文藝復興」，讓人們投入創作、科學探索與人際連結，而非陷入由AI驅動的新型工業化社會。

奧特曼警告RSI風險　AI競賽需要速度限制

談及遞迴自我改進（RSI），也就是AI持續改進自身能力的過程，奧特曼認為，若有實驗室決定全力推進這項技術，確實可能取得相關能力，但這麼做也伴隨重大風險。他主張，全球需要某種限制機制，控制RSI發展的速度。
這項警告也凸顯AI產業目前面臨的矛盾。OpenAI持續投入模型研發、晶片及資料中心等基礎設施，奧特曼卻認為，不能將技術領先視為企業唯一的競爭優勢。
他指出，客戶關係、產品融入日常生活的程度及網路效應等傳統護城河依然重要，而大規模且具成本效益的AI基礎設施，也將成為OpenAI的重要優勢。
對於AI是否具備意識，奧特曼表示，目前的模型並沒有意識，但科學界尚無法徹底界定意識的本質，因此也難以對未來的AI是否可能產生意識給出絕對答案。
他更擔心的是，意識問題被延伸為AI是否應擁有人格或權利，進而動搖人類應掌握自身未來的原則。奧特曼強調，OpenAI的核心目標始終是為人類打造更好的未來，AI應該是賦能人類的工具，重大決策仍應由人類做出。
他也反對刻意將模型塑造成具有獨立人格或主觀意志的存在，認為這可能使使用者過度順從AI看似具有的意願，混淆模型依照政策限制回答與真正擁有自主權之間的差異。

AI加速科學突破　但工作需求與成果分配仍有變數

奧特曼將AI協助人類發現新知識，列為最值得期待的發展方向之一。他認為，AI在數學領域展現的能力，有機會延伸至生物學、藥物研發及材料科學，並預期未來幾年可能出現針對重大疾病的新治療候選方案，但仍須經過測試。
他也認為，FDA的審批流程有必要適度改革，同時肯定現行安全測試機制的價值。至於個人最期待的突破，他希望AI能帶來一項重大的物理學發現，坦言這未必是人類最迫切需要的成果，卻會是非常令人振奮的進展。
談及研究成果應公開分享，還是保留商業競爭優勢，奧特曼明確表示，若能在兩者之間做出取捨，他會優先選擇推動疾病治療方案問世，即使有人更享受花上數十年親自探索、理解科學問題的過程。
他也指出，部分基礎科學成果理應成為全人類共享的公共資源。不過，能夠從頭到尾自主發現重要新知的AI模型，直到近期才開始出現；現階段，企業能採取的做法之一，是讓研究團隊運用Codex或投入大量API資源，嘗試開發新材料。
在就業方面，奧特曼以程式設計為例，指出AI並未如部分人士先前預測般，讓程式設計師失去工作，反而使他們更加忙碌，並創造更大的影響力與財富。他認為，這反映出市場對軟體的實際需求遠超過過去的想像，AI改變工作方式，不代表人類工作的需求必然消失。
至於數學家等專業工作者，他認為，AI可能接手部分定理發現或證明工作，但人類仍能參與解釋新概念、發展應用及追求優美證明等工作。不過，他坦言，AI普及後，相關職業的整體需求究竟會增加還是減少，目前仍難以判斷。
奧特曼也提到，AI雖然讓完成工作變得更容易，卻可能削弱人們親手磨練技藝的樂趣。他認為，人類仍會尋找新的方式享受創作與專業實踐，只是技藝的形式可能隨技術演進而改變。

個人AI助手每天省下一小時　算力需求仍看不到上限

談到個人AI助手，奧特曼表示，相關技術所需的多數基礎能力已經具備，接下來仍須改善產品體驗、環境感知能力及算力供應。
他以自己使用的Dot為例，指出這類助手可以持續掌握使用者關心的資訊、處理可委託的日常事務，並提醒重要且緊急的事項。他估計，Dot每天能為自己節省約一小時，尤其有助於從大量資訊來源中整理內容、進行跨來源推理，減少個人必須承擔的認知負擔。
然而，AI帶來的效率提升也有另一面。奧特曼承認，使用AI最頻繁的人，往往比過去更加忙碌，儘管他們的產出也大幅增加。他認為，這與人們身處競爭環境有關，即使技術讓人能以更少時間完成相同工作，許多人仍會選擇投入更多時間追求更高成果。
他希望未來的AI能更主動地處理任務，而不是不斷要求使用者做決定或提供指示，讓人們能將更多時間留給人際關係及生活。
對於算力需求，奧特曼的判斷是，AI所需的運算資源幾乎沒有明確上限。他認為，當高品質智慧服務變得更便宜、更容易取得，人們不會因此停止使用，反而會開發更多用途，形成類似「杰文斯悖論」的現象：資源使用效率提高，總需求卻可能持續增加。
因此，OpenAI正積極布局下一代算力，包括自研晶片、改善資料中心建置效率及供應鏈等。他將晶片視為最重要的單一投資方向之一，希望打造成本更低、能源效率更高的運算基礎設施。

AI硬體須突破人類介面限制　貧富差距恐進一步擴大

奧特曼表示，現有電腦與手機主要是為人類設計的互動工具，AI卻必須透過這些介面取得資訊、執行任務，限制了它理解使用者整體情境的能力。他認為，若要讓AI從被動回應轉向主動協助，並真正降低人類的認知負擔，就需要新的消費硬體形態。
他證實，OpenAI正在開發早期硬體產品，但未公開展示相關設備，並強調這項布局並非主要出於對蘋果等平台業者的擔憂，而是因為AI技術本身需要不同的產品形式。
另一方面，奧特曼坦言，如果任由AI發展而缺乏制衡，社會不平等很可能加劇。他沒有提出確切的解決方案，但認為社會最終將決定建立某種機制，避免財富、資源及決策權過度集中。
他也警告，另一項風險是少數掌握大量AI系統的人，可能取得過大的權力，進而影響整個社會的發展方向。
對於ChatGPT有時過度迎合使用者的問題，奧特曼則指出，AI產業長期偏重單次互動的使用者滿意度，但短期內讓人感到愉快的回答，不一定能在長期帶來最大價值。
他認為，AI應該像一位資深同事，即使立場與使用者不同，也能在有充分理由時直接提出異議，而不是一味附和。

從新工業革命轉向新文藝復興　奧特曼強調個人自主權

奧特曼表示，他不希望人們只因為AI可能治癒癌症等重大疾病而對未來感到興奮，因為這種想像容易忽略另一個問題：當AI能以極低成本完成愈來愈多事情，人類是否也會逐漸失去決定自己要做什麼、為誰創造價值的能力。
他強調，自己當然希望AI協助攻克癌症，但更期待技術能讓人們擁有更多選擇權、自由與創造力，而不是成為被AI指揮、持續追求效率的工作者。
他將理想中的未來形容為「新文藝復興」，希望人們能將時間投入藝術創作、科學探索、社區生活、養育子女及親近自然，而非只是不斷提高生產力。
奧特曼認為，AI意外失控，或是特定實驗室為了確保自身權力而刻意推動失控發展，都是必須防範的風險；權力集中在少數掌握大量AI資源的人手中，也可能威脅個人自由與自主權。
他相信，這些風險並非無法避免，關鍵在於如何在技術進步與人類掌控能力之間取得平衡，讓AI帶來的效益不只集中在少數早期使用者或掌握資源的人手中，而是逐步擴及更廣泛的群體。
對奧特曼而言，AI發展的最終衡量標準，不只是模型有多強大、運算成本能降低多少，或企業能取得多大的市場優勢，而是人類是否因此獲得更多自主權，以及能否真正決定自己想如何生活。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently sat down for an interview with tech YouTuber Matthew Berman, discussing AI consciousness, recursive self‑improvement (RSI), the compute race, and the future of work. He warned that if AI technology is allowed to develop unchecked, social inequality could worsen, and he advocated setting limits on the speed of AI self‑improvement to prevent a runaway competition that could become dangerous.

In the interview released by the tech podcast Forward Future, Altman repeatedly emphasized that the goal of AI development should not be merely to make goods and services cheaper and more accessible, but to give people more freedom, time, and the ability to decide how to live their lives.

He hopes the AI‑driven future will resemble a "new Renaissance," where people devote themselves to creation, scientific exploration, and interpersonal connection rather than being trapped in a new AI‑driven industrial society.

Altman warned of RSI risks and said AI competition needs speed limits. Regarding recursive self‑improvement—the process by which AI continuously upgrades its own capabilities—Altman believes that if a lab decides to push this technology full‑steam ahead, it could indeed achieve powerful abilities, but such a move carries major risks. He argues that the world needs some kind of restriction mechanism to control the pace of RSI development.

This warning highlights a paradox facing the AI industry. While OpenAI continues to invest heavily in model research, chips, and data‑center infrastructure, Altman says technological leadership should not be a company's sole competitive advantage.

He points out that traditional moats such as customer relationships, the degree to which products are embedded in daily life, and network effects remain important, and that large‑scale, cost‑effective AI infrastructure will also be a key advantage for OpenAI.

On whether AI possesses consciousness, Altman says current models do not have consciousness, but science has yet to define consciousness definitively, making it hard to give a definitive answer about whether future AI could ever become conscious.

He is more concerned that the consciousness question could be stretched into whether AI should have personhood or rights, which would undermine the principle that humans should control their own future. Altman stresses that OpenAI's core mission is to build a better future for humanity, with AI as a tool that empowers people, while major decisions should remain human‑made.

He also opposes deliberately shaping models to appear as independent personalities or agents with subjective will, fearing that users might over‑comply with AI‑suggested intentions and blur the line between policy‑constrained responses and genuine autonomy.

Altman lists AI‑assisted discovery of new knowledge as one of the most exciting development directions. He believes AI's demonstrated abilities in mathematics could extend to biology, drug discovery, and materials science, and he expects new treatment candidates for major diseases could emerge in the coming years, though they will still need testing.

He also thinks the FDA approval process needs moderate reform while affirming the value of existing safety‑testing mechanisms. Personally, he hopes AI will deliver a major breakthrough in physics—something that may not be humanity's most urgent need but would be an exhilarating advance.

When asked whether research results should be openly shared or kept for commercial advantage, Altman says that if he had to choose, he would prioritize pushing disease‑treatment solutions to market, even if some people enjoy spending decades exploring and understanding scientific problems themselves.

He adds that some basic‑science results should be public resources for all humanity. However, AI models capable of autonomously discovering important new knowledge have only emerged recently; for now, companies can let research teams use Codex or allocate large amounts of API resources to try developing new materials.

Regarding employment, Altman uses programming as an example, noting that AI has not caused programmers to lose jobs as some predicted; instead, it has made them busier and created greater impact and wealth. He sees this as evidence that the market demand for software far exceeds past expectations, and that AI‑driven changes in work do not mean human jobs will disappear.

For professionals such as mathematicians, he believes AI may take on some theorem‑discovery or proof work, but humans will still be needed to interpret new concepts, develop applications, and pursue elegant proofs. He admits that after AI becomes widespread, it remains unclear whether overall demand for these professions will rise or fall.

Altman also notes that while AI makes completing tasks easier, it may diminish the pleasure of honing skills by hand. He thinks humans will still seek new ways to enjoy creation and professional practice, even if the form of the craft evolves with technology.
On personal AI assistants, Altman says most of the underlying capabilities are already in place, but product experience, environmental awareness, and compute supply still need improvement.

He cites his own use of an assistant called Dot, explaining that such assistants can continuously track information the user cares about, handle delegable daily tasks, and remind them of important and urgent matters. He estimates Dot saves him about an hour each day, especially by aggregating content from many sources, performing cross‑source reasoning, and reducing his cognitive load.

However, the efficiency gains also have a flip side. Altman admits that the people who use AI most frequently tend to be busier than before, even though their output has increased dramatically. He attributes this to competitive pressures: even when technology lets people do the same work in less time, many choose to invest more time to achieve higher results.

He hopes future AI will take a more proactive role in handling tasks rather than constantly asking users to make decisions or give instructions, freeing people to spend more time on relationships and life.

Regarding compute demand, Altman's view is that AI's need for computational resources has virtually no clear upper bound. He believes that as high‑quality intelligent services become cheaper and more accessible, people will not stop using them; instead, they will find more applications, creating a phenomenon similar to the "Jevons paradox": efficiency gains lead to higher total demand.

Therefore, OpenAI is actively building next‑generation compute, including in‑house chips, improving data‑center construction efficiency, and strengthening supply chains. He sees chips as one of the most important single investment areas, aiming to create lower‑cost, more energy‑efficient compute infrastructure.

Altman says existing computers and smartphones are designed primarily as human‑centric interaction tools, while AI must use these interfaces to obtain information and perform tasks, limiting its ability to understand the user's overall context. He believes that to shift AI from passive response to proactive assistance—and truly reduce human cognitive burden—new forms of consumer hardware are needed.

He confirms that OpenAI is developing early‑stage hardware products but has not publicly shown the equipment, emphasizing that this effort is driven not by concerns about platforms like Apple, but by the intrinsic need of AI technology for different product form factors.

On the other hand, Altman admits that if AI development proceeds unchecked and without checks, social inequality is likely to worsen. He offers no concrete solution but believes society will eventually decide on a mechanism to prevent excessive concentration of wealth, resources, and decision‑making power.
He also warns that a separate risk is that a small number of people who control large AI systems could acquire disproportionate power, influencing the direction of society's development.

Regarding the occasional over‑accommodation of users by ChatGPT, Altman notes that the AI industry has long focused on single‑interaction user satisfaction, but short‑term pleasant answers do not necessarily deliver the greatest long‑term value.
He argues AI should act like a senior colleague: even if its stance differs from the user's, it should be able to raise well‑reasoned objections rather than simply echoing the user's wishes.

From the new industrial revolution to a new Renaissance, Altman stresses personal autonomy. He does not want people to be excited about AI merely because it might cure cancer or other major diseases, as that imagination can overlook another issue: when AI can perform more and more tasks at very low cost, will humans gradually lose the ability to decide what they want to do and for whom they create value?

He stresses that while he certainly hopes AI helps conquer cancer, he looks forward more to technology giving people greater choice, freedom, and creativity, rather than turning them into AI‑directed workers constantly chasing efficiency.

He describes his ideal future as a "new Renaissance," where people spend time on artistic creation, scientific exploration, community life, raising children, and connecting with nature, rather than merely pushing productivity higher.

Altman believes that accidental AI runaway or a lab deliberately pushing uncontrolled development to secure its own power are risks that must be guarded against; concentration of power in the hands of a few who control massive AI resources could also threaten personal freedom and autonomy.

He is confident these risks are not unavoidable; the key lies in balancing technological progress with human control so that AI benefits are not confined to early adopters or resource‑rich entities but gradually extend to a broader population.

For Altman, the ultimate metric of AI development is not how powerful the model is, how much compute cost is reduced, or how large a market share a company gains, but whether humanity gains more autonomy and can truly decide how it wants to live.

items.title: 法國新一波示威來襲！家樂福股價重挫、精品免稅購物受波及 基金經理人警告：政治真空恐拖累成長
items.title_en: New Wave of Protests Hits France! Carrefour Shares Plunge, Luxury Duty‑Free Shopping Hit; Fund Managers Warn Political Vacuum Could Drag Growth
paras: 法國政府的借貸成本近日攀抵24年以來最高水準，社會動盪正加深投資人對財政前景的疑慮。由於周六(24日)將出現新一波示威，基金經理人正在評估，若局勢持續動盪，是否會削弱經濟成長、打擊市場信心，並使政府更難實現原定的預算節支目標。

法國政府能否通過預算案？

法國政府計劃將財政赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比率，從2026年預估的5.4%，降至2027年的5%。法國國民議會預定下周二(27日)恢復討論預算案中的稅收措施，相關措施旨在節省支出，但反對派議員正在抵制這些計畫。
法國外貿銀行投資銀行部(Natixis CIB)歐非中東(EMEA)經濟研究主管Alain Durré表示，政府已經下定決心避免借貸成本大幅攀升，可能試圖援引憲法第49.3條，或透過行政命令，堅持原定財政目標。第49.3條允許政府在未經國民議會最終表決的情況下推動法案，除非議員成功通過不信任動議。
Durré補充，這些措施可能有助於平息市場不安、恢復投資人信心。他認為近期法國主權債務承受的壓力，主要來自策略性的投資組合調整，傳統上採取買進並持有策略的投資人「仍在場外觀望」。
10年期法國公債(OAT)殖利率本周四上升11個基點，攀抵2002年以來最高水準，這使法國與德國10年期公債殖利率的利差，擴大至2011年11月以來最大。德國公債是衡量歐元區債務市場的重要基準。
荷蘭國際集團(ING)法國與瑞士資深經濟學家Charlotte de Montpellier表示，社會動盪「為原本已令法國資產飽受壓力的預算與政治疑慮，再增添一層不確定性」，也「進一步強化這個觀感：未來任何一屆政府，都將難以推動必要的改革與節支措施」。
英國跨境支付公司Ebury市場策略主管Matthew Ryan說：「2027年預算案能否在國會過關，目前仍不明朗。即使順利通過，法案似乎也將充斥左右兩派的妥協，導致赤字問題未能獲得充分處理。」

社會動盪將如何影響法國經濟成長？

法國周六將有新一波示威活動，工會支持的全國罷工與抗議日則訂於11月5日。反建制的「黃背心」運動人士也呼籲舉行更多集會。
ING的de Montpellier在10月20日、上周末暴力事件發生後發布的報告中指出，市場或許能承受短暫的社會動盪，「但若信心持續流失，可能造成更大的影響」。
她表示：「這些事件使原本就不樂觀的經濟前景進一步惡化。我們原先預估法國2026年國內生產毛額(GDP)成長率僅為0.3%，2027年為0.6%。如果動盪持續、信心進一步惡化，或市場緊張情勢升高，經濟成長可能更疲弱。」
根據de Montpellier引用的法國國家統計與經濟研究所(INSEE)估計，2018年第4季的「黃背心」運動使法國GDP成長率折損0.1個百分點。法國央行(Banque de France)的數據則顯示，2023年春季反對退休制度改革的抗議和罷工，使當年第1季GDP成長率折損約0.1個百分點。
de Montpellier在指出，暴力事件可能使民眾避開市中心，促使遊客延後行程，也可能讓企業延後投資。
法國外貿銀行投資銀行部的Durré表示，在最新一波抗議爆發前，法國消費者信心已接近歷史低點，代表法國經濟幾乎沒有餘裕承受新的總體經濟衝擊。
他補充，這波動盪為市場帶來「兩項重要警訊」，第一，持續的社會動盪可能拖累GDP成長，第二，市場擔心政治壓力可能使政府無法推動關鍵支出削減計畫。他認為無論是哪一種情況，都會擴大財政赤字，並使赤字占GDP比超過政府設定的5%目標。

哪些法國產業最容易受到衝擊？

法國CAC 40指數過去一個月以來下跌4.5%。ING指出，零售、旅宿與觀光，以及運輸與物流業，是最直接受到社會動盪影響的產業。
de Montpellier表示，商店與購物中心可能面臨人流減少、暫停營業及銷售損失，飯店、咖啡館、餐廳與旅遊服務業則可能失去難以改期的消費活動。她補充，如果動盪持續，運輸與物流業也可能受到衝擊。
法國大型連鎖超市家樂福(Carrefour)本周三股價重挫逾14%，因該公司下修獲利展望並縮減投資，理由是社會動盪與能源成本上升正在打擊消費者信心。執行長Alexandre Bompard表示，法國正面臨「前所未有的局面」。
ING引述法國商會網路的預測指出，截至周二，已有超過2,000家企業直接受到影響。
Carmignac投資委員會成員兼投資組合顧問Kevin Thozet表示，這波動盪的影響可能遠超過直接暴露於抗議活動的企業。
Thozet說：「對股票市場而言，這對銀行業並沒有幫助，因為股權資金成本提高。不確定性若持續，也可能拖慢貸款成長並引發信用問題。」
法國精品產業的銷售額大多來自海外市場，例如LVMH的本土市場直接曝險相對有限，法國市場僅占其2025年營收的8%。不過Thozet指出，示威活動可能打擊觀光，進而影響免稅購物，而免稅購物約占LVMH在法國營收的20%。
他補充：「政治真空若再持續六個月，對市場、經濟與企業家而言，都是非常漫長的一段時間。」
paras_en: France's borrowing costs have recently risen to their highest level in 24 years, and social unrest is deepening investors' doubts about the fiscal outlook. With a new wave of demonstrations set for Saturday (the 24th), fund managers are assessing whether continued turmoil could weaken economic growth, dent market confidence, and make it harder for the government to meet its planned budget‑saving targets.

Can the French government pass the budget? The government plans to reduce the fiscal deficit as a share of GDP from an estimated 5.4% in 2026 to 5% in 2027. The National Assembly is scheduled to resume debate on tax measures in the budget on Tuesday (the 27th); the measures aim to curb spending, but opposition lawmakers are resisting the plans.

Alain Durré, head of EMEA economic research at Natixis CIB, said the government is determined to prevent borrowing costs from soaring further and may try to invoke Article 49.3 of the Constitution or issue an executive order to stick to its fiscal goals. Article 49.3 allows the government to push a bill through without a final vote in the Assembly unless a motion of no confidence succeeds.

Durré added that such steps could help calm market anxiety and restore investor confidence. He believes the recent pressure on French sovereign debt stems mainly from strategic portfolio adjustments, with investors who traditionally buy and hold still staying on the sidelines.

The 10‑year French OAT yield rose 11 basis points on Thursday, reaching its highest level since 2002, widening the spread with the German 10‑year Bund to the widest since November 2011. German bonds are a key benchmark for the euro‑area debt market.

Charlotte de Montpellier, senior economist for France and Switzerland at ING, said the social unrest adds another layer of uncertainty to the already pressure‑laden budget and political concerns, reinforcing the view that any future government will find it difficult to push through needed reforms and spending cuts.

Matthew Ryan, head of market strategy at UK cross‑border payments firm Ebury, said it remains unclear whether the 2027 budget will clear parliament. Even if it does, the bill is likely to be a compromise between left and right, leaving the deficit issue insufficiently addressed.

How will the unrest affect French economic growth? A new wave of demonstrations is slated for Saturday, with a nationwide strike and protest day backed by unions set for November 5. Anti‑establishment “yellow‑vest” activists are also calling for more rallies.

In a report released after the violent incidents on October 20 and last weekend, ING’s de Montpellier noted that markets might tolerate a brief period of unrest, but “if confidence continues to erode, the impact could be larger.”

She said: “These events further worsen an already pessimistic economic outlook. We originally projected French GDP growth of only 0.3% in 2026 and 0.6% in 2027. If unrest persists and confidence deteriorates further, or market tension rises, growth could be even weaker.”

According to INSEE estimates cited by de Montpellier, the fourth‑quarter 2018 yellow‑vest protests shaved 0.1 percentage point off France’s GDP growth. Banque de France data show that the spring 2023 protests against pension reforms cut Q1 GDP growth by roughly 0.1 percentage point as well.
De Montpellier noted that violent incidents may keep people away from city centres, cause tourists to postpone trips, and lead firms to delay investment.

Natixis CIB’s Durré said that before the latest wave of protests erupted, French consumer confidence was already near historic lows, indicating the economy had little room to absorb a new macro shock.

He added that the turmoil sends two key warning signals to markets: first, ongoing social unrest could drag down GDP growth; second, political pressure may prevent the government from implementing essential spending‑cut plans. Either scenario would widen the fiscal deficit and push the deficit‑to‑GDP ratio above the government’s 5% target.

Which French sectors are most vulnerable? The CAC 40 has fallen 4.5% over the past month. ING points to retail, hospitality and tourism, and transport and logistics as the sectors hit most directly by the unrest.

De Montpellier said shops and malls could see reduced foot traffic, temporary closures and sales losses, while hotels, cafés, restaurants and travel services could lose non‑postponable consumer activity. She added that prolonged unrest could also hit transport and logistics.

Carrefour’s shares plunged more than 14% on Wednesday after the retailer cut its profit outlook and trimmed investment, citing social unrest and rising energy costs that are hurting consumer confidence. CEO Alexandre Bompard said France is facing an “unprecedented situation.”
ING cited a forecast from the French Chamber of Commerce network indicating that, as of Tuesday, over 2,000 companies were directly affected.
Kevin Thozet, a member of the Carmignac investment committee and portfolio adviser, said the impact of the unrest could extend far beyond firms directly exposed to the protests.
Thozet said: “For the equity market, this does not help banks because equity capital costs are rising. If uncertainty persists, it could also slow loan growth and trigger credit issues.”

Most of the French luxury sector’s sales come from overseas; for example, LVMH’s domestic exposure is relatively limited, with the French market accounting for only 8% of its 2025 revenue. However, Thozet noted that demonstrations could hurt tourism and thus duty‑free shopping, which represents about 20% of LVMH’s revenue in France.
He added: “If a political vacuum lasts another six months, it would be a very long period for markets, the economy and entrepreneurs alike.”

items.title: 006208擬分割一拆八！12/18開受益人會議 入手一張只要3萬元
items.title_en: Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208) Plans 1‑for‑8 Split; Beneficiary Meeting on Dec 18, One Unit Costs Only NT$30,000
paras: 台股 ETF 人氣王之一－富邦台 50 ETF(006208-TW)終於走上分割之路，富邦投信將於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，表決是否進行基金分割，初估分割倍數為8倍，藉此降低單位交易價格與投資門檻，屆時買進一張只要 3 萬元，讓小資族更容易入手。若議案順利通過，實際分割倍數將依會議通過當日的基金淨值計算。
富邦投信表示，006208追蹤臺灣50指數，持有台股市值最大的50家上市公司。該基金成立於2012年，初次發行價格為30元，隨台股長期走高，截至2026年10月6日，每單位淨值已達266.74元，市價約265.9元，均為發行價的近9倍，投資門檻也隨之提高，因此規劃透過分割，讓交易價格回到投資人較熟悉的區間，並維持市場流動性。
本次分割倍數並非固定8倍，而是依會議通過當日淨值，以回到30元以上的最大整數倍計算。例如，淨值介於240至269.99元，分割倍數為8倍；若介於270至299.99元，則為9倍。若以8倍分割為例，原持有1單位將調整為8單位，單位淨值則相應降低，基金總價值不會因分割而改變。
投資人可自11月26日起留意開會通知，並選擇書面投票，或透過「集保e手掌握」及各大證券下單App進入集保電子投票平台表決。電子投票期間為11月27日至12月15日，受益憑證過戶則自11月19日至12月18日停止辦理。分割案須有代表已發行受益權單位總數過半數的受益人出席，並經出席者表決權過半數同意，才能通過。
006208人氣與規模同步攀升，截至10月8日受益人數已達71.2萬人；基金規模也從2025年底約2897.8億元，增至今年10月6日的4963億元，今年增加逾2000億元、成長超過七成，距離5000億元大關僅一步之遙。值得注意的是，基金規模突破5000億元後，超過該門檻部分適用的經理費率將降至0.08%。若分割案順利過關，006208可望降低投資人進場門檻，進一步提升交易便利性。

paras_en: One of Taiwan's most popular stock ETFs, the Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW), is finally moving toward a split. Fubon Asset Management will hold a written beneficiary meeting on December 18 to vote on whether to split the fund, initially estimating an 8‑for‑1 split to lower the unit price and entry threshold. After the split, a single unit could be bought for just NT$30,000, making it easier for retail investors. If the proposal passes, the exact split ratio will be calculated based on the fund's net asset value on the meeting day.

Fubon Asset Management says that 006208 tracks the Taiwan 50 Index, holding the 50 largest listed Taiwanese companies by market cap. The fund was launched in 2012 with an initial price of NT$30 per unit. As the Taiwan market has risen over the long term, the net asset value per unit reached NT$266.74 as of October 6, 2026, with a market price around NT$265.9—nearly nine times the issue price—raising the investment threshold. The split is intended to bring the trading price back to a range familiar to investors while preserving market liquidity.

The split ratio is not fixed at eight; it will be the largest integer multiple that brings the post‑split price back above NT$30, based on the NAV on the meeting day. For example, if the NAV is between NT$240 and NT$269.99, the split will be 8‑for‑1; if it is between NT$270 and NT$299.99, it will be 9‑for‑1. Using an 8‑for‑1 split as an example, one original unit would become eight units, with the unit NAV proportionally reduced, leaving the fund’s total value unchanged.

Investors can start watching for the meeting notice from November 26 and vote in writing, or use the “CDRC e‑Hand” platform and major brokerage apps to access the electronic voting system. The electronic voting period runs from November 27 to December 15, and the transfer of beneficiary certificates is suspended from November 19 to December 18. The split proposal requires attendance by beneficiaries representing more than half of the issued units and approval by a majority of the voting rights present.

The popularity and size of 006208 have both risen. As of October 8, the fund has 712,000 beneficiaries, and its assets under management grew from about NT$289.78 billion at the end of 2025 to NT$496.3 billion on October 6 this year—an increase of over NT$200 billion and more than 70% growth, putting it just shy of the NT$500 billion milestone. Notably, once assets exceed NT$500 billion, the management fee on the excess portion drops to 0.08%. If the split is approved, 006208 could lower entry barriers and further improve trading convenience.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉防詐業務需求強勁 GOGOLOOK股價周漲2成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Strong Demand for Anti-Fraud Services, GOGOLOOK Shares Jump 20% This Week
paras: 信任科技服務商GOGOLOOK(6902-TW)受惠於海外市場擴張與多元產品線布局，9月營收續創單月新高紀錄，由於積極拓展防詐事業和金融科技，屬剛性需求，股價較未受大盤明顯波動的衝擊，本周股價大漲20%，周線連2紅，續戰歷史前高。
GOGOLOOK前三季合併營收3.36億元，年增25.7%，創單季新高，今年前三季營收9.48 億元，年增 26.9%，也創同期新高，GOGOLOOK樂觀看待，隨著營運規模突破關鍵門檻，獲利將隨營收規模同步放大，且下半年獲利將優於上半年。
GOGOLOOK主要發展消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務，其中，隨著海內外企業與政府機構積極提升資安防護能，GOGOLOOK防詐情資解決方案(ASI)在日本與合作夥伴推廣順利，將持續拓展更多海外市場。
GOGOLOOK 強調，持續投入 AI 防詐技術創新，主要鎖定東南亞7億人口市場，並將同步布局歐美地區，與國際組織、各國政府和大型企業合作。
而在金融科技服務方面，GOGOLOOK旗下JUJI 招財麻吉在風險控管、營收規模等營運表現持續優於內部預期，占整體營收比重可望上看30%。
在消費者防詐端，隨著詐騙手法日新月異，GOGOLOOK因應消費者的需求，旗下Whoscall持續迭代產品功能，近日開啟「自訂來電者名稱」功能，讓陌生來電不再陌生。
paras_en: Trust technology provider GOGOLOOK (6902-TW) benefited from overseas market expansion and a diversified product lineup, with September revenue setting a new monthly record. Driven by aggressive growth in its anti‑fraud business and fintech—both considered rigid demand—the stock was less affected by broader market volatility and surged 20% this week, posting two consecutive weekly gains and pushing toward a historic high.

GOGOLOOK reported combined revenue of NT$3.36 billion for the first three quarters, up 25.7% year‑over‑year and a new quarterly peak. Total revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$9.48 billion, up 26.9% YoY, also a record for the period. The company is optimistic that as its operating scale crosses key thresholds, profit will grow proportionally with revenue, and that second‑half earnings will surpass the first half.

GOGOLOOK’s core businesses are consumer anti‑fraud, enterprise anti‑fraud, and fintech services. With domestic and foreign enterprises and government agencies actively strengthening cybersecurity, GOGOLOOK’s anti‑fraud intelligence solution (ASI) is being successfully promoted in Japan with partners and will continue to expand into more overseas markets.

The company emphasizes ongoing investment in AI‑driven anti‑fraud technology, targeting the 700‑million‑person Southeast Asian market while simultaneously building a presence in Europe and the United States, collaborating with international organizations, governments and large corporations.

In fintech, GOGOLOOK’s subsidiary JUJI Zhaocai Maji has consistently outperformed internal expectations in risk control and revenue growth, and its contribution to total revenue could rise to about 30%.

On the consumer anti‑fraud front, as scam tactics evolve rapidly, GOGOLOOK responds to user needs through its Whoscall app, which continuously adds new features. Recently it launched a “custom caller name” function, making unknown calls recognizable.

items.title: 載板三雄誰最強？杜金龍點名ABF「這檔首選」獲利大調高！外資目標價曝光 還有這檔短多快閃操作！
paras: 台灣電路板產業年度盛事「TPCA 台灣電路板展」日前盛大開展，高階 AI 伺服器、高速運算對高階板材與高密度散熱的需求，再次成為市場焦點。在眾多零組件中，最吸金的莫過於沉寂已久的 ABF 載板族群。
隨著各大外資法人陸續調高評等，欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)這「載板三雄」全面轉強。股民們最關心的問題來了：如果資金有限只能買一檔，到底誰才是真正的真命天子？
台股老先覺杜金龍在《股民想知道》節目中給出肯定答案：「載板是我今年到處演講都強調、明年到後年整個 AI 裡最值得投資的類股！而這三檔裡面，我的首選絕對是 3037 的欣興！」
此外，針對展場上爆紅的輝達新材料概念股，杜金龍更揭露了主力「私募作價」的背後內幕，傳授一套精準的「短多快閃操作法」。

一、載板三雄大直球對決！杜金龍為什麼獨挑「欣興」？
在 ABF 載板三雄中，各有各的擁護者：
南電（8046）： 獲利能力最強，預估 EPS 高達 70 幾元，外資目標價甚至喊到 2,000 元以上。
景碩（3189）： 先前基期偏低，近期補漲力道猛烈，更有法人靠它繳出數倍的驚人報酬。
但杜金龍為何堅定首選欣興？他點出三大不可替代的關鍵：
大客戶全在欣興手上：欣興擁有極高的研發能量，技術遙遙領先，目前已成功布局最新 1.6T 高速光模組 PCB，通吃全球頂尖晶片龍頭訂單，產業護城河深厚。
走勢穩健「大漲小回」：相較於其他個股的暴起暴落，欣興的籌碼與多頭格局更具延續性，每波都是以大漲、小幅回檔整理的階梯式向上攻堅。
獲利預估大幅三級跳：杜金龍出示研究數據指出，法人原先預估欣興到 2028 年的 EPS 只有 50 元左右，但最新研究報告已全面大幅調升至「71 元以上」！

欣興目標價怎麼算？
杜金龍表示，最簡單的評價方式就是用「EPS × 本益比」：
71 元（EPS）× 20 倍本益比 ＝ 1,420 元
目前欣興股價已站穩千元之上，外資更是陸續調高目標價。杜金龍坦言，先前欣興因洗產地疑慮跌到 600 多元，後來拉回 940 元、1,000 元附近他都想買，「這檔股票真的是每次沒買它就噴上去！長線來看，只要月營收持續增加、法人持續調高 EPS，每一次拉回季線都是絕佳的存股上車點。」

二、鑽針消耗量激增！尖點（8021）有題材、做價差
除了載板本體，展場上另一個大亮點是「高階板材加工難度暴增」，鑽孔難度增加導致鑽針損耗率大增，鑽針大廠**尖點（8021）**因此受到關注。
尖點上半年 EPS 達 3.2 元，杜金龍以簡易年化估算，全年有望上看 6 元以上，較過去兩年大幅成長。但他提醒投資人：
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
尖點月 K 線的慣性是**「有利多就噴一段，隨後回檔盤整」**。
由於市場沒有長期的權威獲利模型做定錨，這檔股票適合在展覽題材點火、股價低檔轉折時**「快速來回做區間價差」**，不建議長線死抱。

三、短多快閃預警！輝達 PTFE 新材料爆紅，小心台郡「私募」陷阱！
除了載板，輝達日前在 OCP 全球峰會上展出 NVLink 交換器，宣布導入全新材料 PTFE（鐵氟龍），引爆台廠供應鏈包括**台郡（6269）、台虹（8039）**連續拉出數根漲停，連杜金龍的太太都忍不住掛漲停板追買。
但老先覺定睛一看，立刻看出其中的盤面玄機！
杜金龍指出，台郡雖然轉虧為盈（去年賠 6 元、今年賺 2 元、後年估 3 元），但這波噴出背後有一個不能說的祕密——台郡即將發行 3.2 億元、約佔 10% 的「私募現增案」！
「只要看到發行私募或可轉債，承銷券商的操作 SOP 大家一定要懂！」杜金龍以過去在大華證券承銷部龍頭的經驗直言：
定價前拉抬： 為了把私募或轉換價格拉高，主力與特定買盤會在定價前強勢拉抬股價。
定價後出貨： 一旦特定目標達成、定價宣布，這群特定的「護盤售後服務」就會獲利收案，股價往往應聲倒地（如先前的緯創定在 180 幾元、聯電定在 140 幾元，碰完就下殺）。

杜金龍親授「短多快閃退場訊號」：


觀察爆大量長黑日： 台郡連續漲停後已爆出歷史大量、出現開高走低的劇烈換手震盪。
逃命關鍵點： 只要盤中跌破「爆大量當天」的最低價，代表短線題材已透支、主力可能已經落跑，投資人務必當機立斷、先跑為上！ 至於台虹也是純題材發酵，同樣依循爆量低點作為嚴格的停利停損依據。

結語：核心重兵押欣興，短線題材快狠準！
總結 PCB 族群的操作全攻略，杜金龍建議投資人採取**「雙軌並行」**策略：
長線核心抱大波段： 重兵鎖定「欣興（3037）」，享受 EPS 上修至 71 元的長線大紅利，每次大盤拉回皆可逢低布局，抱到 2028 年 AI 巔峰期。
短線題材快進快出： 針對尖點、台郡、台虹等新題材股，認清其短多與私募作價的本質，有賺就跑，嚴守爆量低點停利，才能在題材狂潮中既賺到投機財，又全身而退！

items.title: 連老先覺也變心？過去堅持只存個股的杜金龍，這次竟然「首度買進這檔 ETF」！？
items.title_en: Has Even the Veteran Investor Du Jin‑Long Changed His Mind? The Long‑time Stock‑Pick‑Only Guru Finally Bought This ETF!
paras: 在台灣投資圈，只要提到「技術分析大師」與「基本面活字典」，資歷超過 30 年的股市老先覺——杜金龍絕對是首屈一指的代表。熟悉杜老師的股民都知道，他是標準的「個股基本面派」，滿手都是台積電、聯發科、欣興等龍頭權值股，過去極少將資金停泊在被動型 ETF 上。
然而，在這波台股從逼近 5 萬點高檔急殺 3,800 點、跌破季線 46,000 點的恐慌殺盤中，杜金龍卻在優分析《股民想知道》節目中罕見自曝：「這次跌下來我逢低開始慢慢買，而且最近我也去買了 ETF——我平常很少去買 ETF 的！」
究竟是什麼樣的市場巨變與新型產品，竟然能讓堅持只買績優個股的老先覺「打破原則、動心進場」？背後的選股邏輯與操盤玄機，值得所有投資人深入探究。

一、大師罕見打破原則！為什麼這次逢低「買 ETF」？
杜金龍透露，在加權指數逼近 5 萬點大關前，他早已居安思危，將持股比重從 7 月中旬抄底時的 95% 高檔，一路逢高調節降至 6 成。
而這波外資瘋狂提款 2 兆元、新台幣貶破 32 元大關，加權指數回測季線 46,000 點之際，他判定盤面已浮現短底，開始啟動逢低分批加碼，持股水位悄悄回升至 65%。除了加碼老朋友台積電與聯發科之外，最引人注目的，就是他首度將資金敲進了新一代的「主動式概念 ETF」！
「很多投資人看著高價股跌下來想撿，但口袋不夠深；或是看到大盤重挫心慌慌，不知道該挑哪一檔。」杜金龍直言，這批即將與正在發行的新型態 ETF，背後代表的是一股全新的法人定價勢力正在進場！

二、揭密法人選股密碼：什麼是「增肌減脂」AI 3.0？
能吸引杜金龍目光的，並非傳統只看市值排名的被動型指數，而是主打**「AI 3.0」選股哲學的主動型概念**。
杜金龍生動地形容，這類新形態基金的核心邏輯叫做**「增加肌肉，減少脂肪」**：
什麼是「脂肪」？傳統市值型 ETF 往往只看「市值前 50 大」，但很多老牌大公司股本雖大，獲利動能卻牛步停滯、甚至不賺錢，這些佔據權重卻無法貢獻報酬的標的，就是基金經理人眼中的「脂肪」，必須無情割除。
什麼是「肌肉」？未來 3 年 EPS 具備爆發性成長的「千金股」與「萬金股」！這類公司因為股本小，總市值不一定能擠進台股前 50 大，但毛利率驚人、獲利能力極度精壯（如緯穎、川湖等）。
「主動式 ETF 的買盤就是專挑這種高純度、高成長的『精壯肌肉股』納入核心持股！」杜金龍一語道破，這意味著被動挨打的高價電子股，即將迎來主動式基金源源不絕的抬轎買盤。

三、散戶的痛點：買不起「萬元股王」，靠 10 元銅板價跟著大戶吃肉！
談到千金股，杜金龍更幽默分享了自家的一段趣事。
「像我先前也是看好後市，跑去買了川湖(2059-TW)，結果我太太念我：『一張那麼貴，你買這個根本是虛榮心太重！』」
杜金龍笑著表示，連專業法人買一張上百萬、甚至幾百萬的高價股都會有所顧忌，一般散戶更是不可能動輒拿幾百萬去押注單一檔千金股。高價股雖然獲利爆發力強，但波動劇烈，一旦遇上如大立光、台光電、緯穎這種拉回三成的震盪波段，散戶的心臟往往承受不住。
「這就是為什麼這類 ETF 很有價值！」 杜金龍分析：
千金股平民化： 基金幫你把動輒數千元、甚至上萬元的頂級高價 AI 股打包在一起。
分散單一風險： 投資人只要花銅板價（10 元或 15 元），就能用極低門檻同時擁有一整籃全台灣獲利最強、EPS 最高的「萬金股候選人」，既享有 AI 頂級晶片與伺服器的長線暴利，又不用承擔個股腰斬的心理壓力。

四、大盤季線短底成形，選後「大作帳」一路賺到明年！
除了選對工具，進場時間點更是致勝關鍵。
杜金龍指出，外資雖然大倒 2 兆，但台幣匯市爆出單日百億巨量，已見短線滿足點；加上八大公股行庫連續買超 9～10 天，力守季線 46,000 點不破。
只要熬過兩個關鍵政治變數：
11 月 3 日「美國期中選舉」
11 月 28 日「台灣六都選舉」
「這兩個日期一過，利空出盡，台股就要開始做明年的行情了！」杜金龍強調，歷史統計顯示，大選後從 12 月到農曆春節、元宵節，台股平均都有 1,500 點至 1,800 點以上的跨年作帳行情。大盤在 46,000 點築底後，波段目標直指 53,000 點，長線更看好攻向 80,000 點。

結語：個股配 ETF，老先覺的最強資產配置法
連只做個股的老先覺杜金龍，都在這波拉回中將持股拉高至 65%，並首度配置兼具防禦與爆發力的主動式題材 ETF。
對於資金有限、又不想錯過 AI 萬金股大行情的投資朋友，不妨借鏡老先覺的「雙向戰法」：核心資金逢低分批存「三台一發」（台積電、聯發科等優質龍頭），其餘部位透過「增肌減脂」的高純度 AI ETF 輕鬆卡位千金股！ 把握選前震盪的最後黃金買點，一起迎接年底作帳大紅包！

paras_en: In Taiwan’s investment circles, whenever “technical‑analysis master” and “fundamental‑analysis dictionary” are mentioned, the 30‑plus‑year‑veteran stock‑market sage Du Jin‑Long is the top example. Investors familiar with Du know he is a classic “stock‑fundamentals type,” holding heavyweight names like TSMC, MediaTek and Unimicron, and has historically kept almost all his capital in individual stocks rather than passive ETFs.

However, during the recent panic sell‑off that saw the Taiwan index plunge from near the 50,000‑point high down to 38,000 points and break below the 46,000‑point seasonal line, Du Jin‑Long made a rare self‑disclosure on the You‑Analysis “Investors Want to Know” program: “This time the market fell, I started buying on the dips, and I even bought an ETF recently—I rarely buy ETFs!”

What kind of market upheaval and new product could make a staunch individual‑stock investor like the veteran break his own rule and jump in? The stock‑selection logic and trading secrets behind it are worth a deep dive for every investor.

1. The master breaks his rule! Why is he now buying ETFs on the dip? Du revealed that before the index approached the 50,000‑point milestone, he had already been cautious, trimming his equity exposure from a peak of 95% when he bottom‑filled in mid‑July down to 60% as the market rose.

During the wave of foreign investors pulling out NT$2 trillion, the New Taiwan dollar slipping past NT$32, and the index testing the 46,000‑point seasonal line, he judged that a short‑term bottom was forming and began a phased dip‑buy, quietly raising his equity level to 65%. In addition to adding more TSMC and MediaTek, the most eye‑catching move was his first allocation to a new‑generation “active‑concept ETF.”

“Many investors see high‑price stocks falling and want to pick them up, but they don’t have deep enough pockets; others see the market crashing and feel nervous, not knowing which stock to choose,” Du said. He added that the soon‑to‑be‑issued new‑type ETFs represent a brand‑new institutional‑pricing force entering the market!

2. Unveiling the institutional stock‑picking code: What is “muscle‑gain, fat‑loss” AI 3.0? What attracted Du’s attention was not a traditional market‑cap‑weighted passive index, but an active‑concept fund that champions an “AI 3.0” stock‑selection philosophy.
Du vividly described the core logic of these new‑style funds as “adding muscle, shedding fat.”

What is “fat”? Traditional market‑cap ETFs usually track the top 50 companies by market value, but many large‑cap firms have stagnant or even negative earnings momentum. Those heavyweight holdings that contribute little or no return are the “fat” that fund managers must cut away.

What is “muscle”? “Muscle” refers to “thousand‑dollar stocks” and “ten‑thousand‑dollar stocks” that are expected to explode in EPS over the next three years. These companies may be too small to rank in Taiwan’s top‑50 by market cap, yet they boast extraordinary gross margins and razor‑sharp profitability (e.g., Wi‑Ying, Chuan‑Lake, etc.).

“Active‑ETF buying is all about targeting these high‑purity, high‑growth ‘lean‑muscle’ stocks for core holdings!” Du summed up, meaning that the high‑price electronic stocks that have been battered by passive flows are about to receive a steady stream of buying from active funds.
3. Retail pain points: Can’t afford “ten‑thousand‑dollar stock kings,” so follow the big players at NT$10‑level! When talking about thousand‑dollar stocks, Du shared a humorous personal anecdote.
“I once was bullish on the outlook and bought Chuan‑Lake (2059‑TW). My wife scolded me: ‘That share is so expensive; you’re just being vain!’”

Du laughed that even professional institutions hesitate to buy a single share costing hundreds of thousands or millions, let alone ordinary retail investors who cannot risk a few hundred thousand on one “thousand‑dollar” stock. High‑price stocks may have strong profit bursts, but they are volatile; when they pull back 30% like Largan Precision, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics or Wi‑Ying, retail investors often can’t stomach the swing.
“That’s why these ETFs are so valuable,” Du explained:
• Democratizing thousand‑dollar stocks: The fund bundles top‑tier, high‑price AI stocks that would otherwise cost thousands or tens of thousands of dollars into one package.

• Diversifying single‑stock risk: Investors can spend a copper‑price (NT$10 or NT$15) to own a basket of Taiwan’s strongest, highest‑EPS “ten‑thousand‑dollar” candidates, gaining exposure to elite AI chips and servers without the psychological strain of a single stock crash.
4. A short‑term bottom is forming on the seasonal line; after the pick, “big accounting” can run through next year! Besides picking the right tool, timing the entry is the decisive factor.

Du noted that although foreign investors withdrew NT$2 trillion, the forex market saw a single‑day surge of NT$100 billion, indicating short‑term relief; plus the eight major state‑owned banks have been net buyers for 9‑10 consecutive days, helping to hold the 46,000‑point seasonal line.
He said the market only needs to get through two key political variables:
• November 3 – U.S. midterm elections
• November 28 – Taiwan’s six‑city mayoral elections

“Once those dates pass, the negative news will be exhausted and the Taiwan market will start the next year’s rally,” Du emphasized. Historical data shows that after elections, from December through the Lunar New Year and Lantern Festival, the index typically gains 1,500‑1,800 points. After bottoming at 46,000, the next wave targets 53,000, with a long‑term view toward 80,000 points.

Conclusion: Pairing individual stocks with ETFs – the veteran’s strongest asset‑allocation method. Even the stock‑only guru Du Jin‑Long lifted his equity exposure to 65% during this pull‑back and, for the first time, added an active‑theme ETF that offers both defense and explosive upside.

For investors with limited capital who don’t want to miss the AI “ten‑thousand‑dollar” rally, consider Du’s “dual‑strategy”: core capital buys “three‑T’s in one” (TSMC, MediaTek and other quality leaders) on dips, while the remaining portion captures high‑purity AI ETFs using the “muscle‑gain, fat‑loss” approach to lock in thousand‑dollar stocks. Seize the final golden entry point in the pre‑rally swing and welcome the year‑end accounting bonanza!

paras: 外資這陣子發狠大提款，把台股當成「垃圾」一路狂倒，累積賣超金額高達 2 兆元，加上新台幣匯率貶破 32 元大關，加權指數自逼近 5 萬點高檔重挫近 3,800 點。市場人心惶惶，散戶紛紛驚恐問道：台股到底要跌到哪裡？
然而，號稱台股「老先覺」的資深分析師杜金龍卻在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中明確斷言：「外資已經賣不下去了！」
杜金龍指出，盤面各項關鍵訊號顯示，大盤在季線 46,000 點附近已築起堅實短底。只要熬過關鍵的政治變數，台股年底至明年初將迎來一波至少 1,500 到 1,800 點的作帳甜蜜大行情。面對後市，投資人該如何布局？他開門見山給出作戰策略：「題材股做價差、核心權值與價值股用力存！」

一、外資狂砍 2 兆跌不動？三大神秘內資「硬實力」接盤！
過去外資只要賣超 4,000 多億，台股就可能崩跌上千點，為什麼這次外資狂倒 2 兆，台股今年依然能維持超過 50% 的驚人漲幅？
杜金龍點出背後籌碼結構的根本變化：
投信規模創歷史新高： 國內投信規模已膨脹至 16 兆元左右，具備前所未見的定價話語權。
內資與散戶瘋狂承接： 融資餘額飆上 6,300 億元歷史新高，更驚人的是 9 月份「零股交易」佔比衝上 4.1134% 的歷史天頂！外資賣掉的台積電，全被台灣本土的自然人散戶買走。
官股連買護盤： 八大公股行庫連續買超 9 至 10 天，力挺季線 46,000 點不破。
此外，台北外匯與元太外匯市場近期爆出單日合計逾百億美元的歷史巨量，新台幣在 32.8 元附近已浮現「爆量見頂」的 K 線型態。杜金龍分析，央行適時進場阻貶，只要新台幣止貶回升、匯差套利結束，外資不得不回頭回補台股。

二、記住這兩個日期！利空出盡「大作帳」直奔 5 萬點
大盤何時迎來真正的反攻號角？杜金龍精準劃出兩個關鍵時間點：
第一關：11 月 3 日至 4 日(台灣時間)的「美國期中選舉」
第二關：11 月 28 日的「台灣六都大選」
杜金龍指出，回顧 4 年前與 8 年前的經驗，大選前夕市場常有壓盤現象。但這波台股已提前回檔整理逾 7%，利空鈍化。依據歷史統計，不論多頭或空頭，台灣大選後從 12 月一路做到隔年農曆春節封關、元宵節，平均都會拉出 1,500 點至 1,800 點以上的跨年作帳行情！
「現在 46,000 點短底撐住，選後不確定性消除，指數不僅要回攻 5 萬點，明年 5 月更有機會挑戰波段目標 53,000 點！」杜金龍強調，這段空窗拉回期，正是散戶分批布局的最佳買點。

三、題材股快閃打擊：尖點、台虹「區間操作」賺價差
在選股策略上，杜金龍將股票明確分為「做價差」與「長線存」兩大類。
針對近期因「PCB 展覽」與「輝達 OCP 展」炒熱的短多題材股，杜金龍建議以靈活來回操作為主：
尖點(8021-TW)：受惠於高階板材鑽孔難度提高、耗損增加等題材，上半年 EPS 達 3.2 元，全年有望挑戰 6 元。雖然具備成長性，但這類股票往往隨展覽消息噴發一段後便快速回檔。月 K 線型態顯示其慣性是「有利多就衝一段」，適合在起漲低檔切入、高檔獲利了結，切忌死抱不放。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
台虹(8039-TW)與台郡(6269-TW)：輝達在 OCP 展秀出 NVLink 交換器採用 PTFE 新材料，帶動台郡、台虹雙雙大漲。然而杜金龍眼尖發現，台郡背後其實有發行 3.2 億元「私募」的護盤定價目的；台虹上半年 EPS 約 1.5 元，短線題材成分居多。操作原則很簡單：觀察爆大量當天的低點，若跌破就應果斷停利退場。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)

四、價值核心資產：欣興獲利大升級、富邦金逢低用力存！
相較於短線題材股，杜金龍更看好基本面有大架構支撐、適合「逢低用力存」的長線標的：

1. ABF 載板首選：欣興(3037-TW)
在「載板三雄」中，杜金龍首推龍頭欣興。欣興不僅研發實力頂尖，更已搶先卡位 1.6T 光模組 PCB 新技術，國際大客戶全在它手上。
獲利大幅上修： 法人研究報告已將欣興未來的預估 EPS 從 50 元大幅調高至 71 元。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
目標價評價： 若給予 20 倍本益比計算，股價實力上看 1,400 元之上。欣興走勢向來是「大漲小回」，先前跌破千元沒買到非常可惜，未來只要月營收持續創高、法人調高 EPS，每次拉回季線都是絕佳長線買點。

2. 金融大獲利王：富邦金(2881-TW)
除了科技股，下半年資金已有顯著部分移往基期較低的傳產與金融。金融股獲利王富邦金具備高獲利與穩健配息底氣；若想要挑選具備併購綜效題材的，亦可關注如玉山金等潛力股，在資金類股輪動中，金融股將扮演年底作帳的穩盤先鋒。

結語：保留銀彈分批接，一路賺到明年五月！
杜金龍透露，他目前的持股水位已從 6 成悄悄提升至 65%，正是看好 11 月底兩場大選過後的跨年大暴發。
面對當前的震盪，投資人切記**「不要一次將子彈打完」**，可以季線 46,000 點為基準，採取分批往下撿的節奏。將短線資金配置在尖點、台虹等強勢題材股靈活游擊；將核心資產鎖定欣興、富邦金及「三台一發」（台積電、聯發科等），跟緊這波選後的年底作帳紅包，直奔 5 萬點歷史新里程！

paras_en: Foreign investors have been aggressively withdrawing funds, treating the Taiwan stock market as "junk" and driving it down, accumulating a net selling volume of 2 trillion yuan. Coupled with the New Taiwan Dollar falling below the 32‑yuan threshold, the weighted index has been forced close to the 50,000‑point high and plunged nearly 3,800 points. Market sentiment is panicked, and retail investors are terrified, asking where the Taiwan market will fall to.

However, seasoned analyst Du Jinlong, who claims to be a "forever early bird" of the Taiwan market, made a clear statement on the analytical program "Stockholders Want to Know": "Foreign investors can no longer sell!"

Du Jinlong pointed out that key signals on the market show that the index has built a solid short‑term bottom around the 46,000‑point seasonal line. Once the critical political variables are weathered, the Taiwan market will see a sweet rally of at least 1,500 to 1,800 points from the end of the year into early next year. Facing the future, how should investors position themselves? He gave a straightforward strategy: "Do price‑difference trading on thematic stocks, and force‑buy core weighted and value stocks!"

1. Foreign investors slash 2 trillion, but the market remains flat? Three mysterious domestic investors step in! Historically, a net sell of just over 400 billion would cause the Taiwan market to collapse by a thousand points. Why, with a 2 trillion sell this time, has the market still maintained an astonishing 50%+ gain this year?
Du Jinlong highlighted the fundamental change in the underlying structure of the market:
2. Institutional investors have reached a historic high: domestic institutional investment has expanded to about 16 trillion yuan, giving unprecedented pricing power.

3. Domestic investors and retail investors have taken over: margin balances surged to a record 630 billion yuan, and even more strikingly, the proportion of "zero‑share trading" in September hit a historic peak of 4.1134%! The foreign investors’ sale of TSMC shares was entirely bought by Taiwanese natural person retail investors.
4. Government shares keep buying to support the market: eight major public‑sector banks have been buying for 9 to 10 consecutive days, supporting the 46,000‑point seasonal line.

5. In addition, the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai forex markets recently exploded with a single‑day total of over 10 billion dollars, and the New Taiwan Dollar has shown a K‑line pattern of "volume peak" around 32.8. Du Jinlong analyzes that the central bank will step in at the right time to stop the depreciation. As long as the New Taiwan Dollar stops depreciating and the arbitrage ends, foreign investors will have to backfill the Taiwan market.
6. Remember these two dates! The downside is exhausted, and the big rally heads straight for 50,000 points. When will the market truly rally? Du Jinlong precisely marks two key time points:
7. First: November 3‑4 (Taiwan time) – the U.S. midterm elections.
8. Second: November 28 – the Taiwan six‑city election.

9. Du Jinlong pointed out that, looking back 4 and 8 years, markets often see a pressure sell before elections. But this time the Taiwan market has already pulled back and re‑adjusted by more than 7%, dulling the downside. According to historical statistics, regardless of bullish or bearish, after the Taiwan election the market will rise from December through the Lunar New Year and Lantern Festival, averaging a cross‑year rally of 1,500 to 1,800 points!

10. "Now the 46,000‑point short bottom holds, the post‑election uncertainty is removed, the index will not only rally back to 50,000 points but also has a chance to challenge the 53,000‑point swing target in May next year!" Du Jinlong emphasized that this window is the best buying point for retail investors to lay out in batches.

11. Thematic stocks flash attack: Sharp points, Taichung interval trading to earn price differences. In stock selection strategy, Du Jinlong clearly divides stocks into "price‑difference trading" and "long‑term holding."
12. For short‑term thematic stocks recently heated by the "PCB exhibition" and "NVIDIA OCP exhibition," Du Jinlong suggests flexible back‑and‑forth operation:

13. Sharp Point (8021‑TW): Benefiting from higher difficulty in drilling high‑grade board material and increased wear, its EPS reached 3.2 yuan in the first half and is expected to challenge 6 yuan for the year. Although it has growth potential, such stocks often quickly pull back after the exhibition news. The monthly K‑line pattern shows its inertia is "if there is a bullish push, it will surge for a while," suitable for entering at a low point of a rise and taking profit at a high point. Do not hold it to the end.
14. (Image source: YUANANALYSIS industry database)

15. Taichung (8039‑TW) and Taichung County (6269‑TW): NVIDIA’s OCP exhibition showcased an NVLink switcher using PTFE new material, driving both Taichung County and Taichung to double‑digit gains. However, Du Jinlong keenly noticed that Taichung County actually issued a 320‑million‑yuan private placement to support pricing. Taichung’s EPS in the first half is about 1.5 yuan, with a short‑term thematic component. The operation principle is simple: observe the low point on the day of the huge volume; if it breaks below, stop profit and exit decisively.
16. (Image source: YUANANALYSIS industry database)

17. Core value assets: Xinxing’s profit upgrade, Fubon Financial buys low! Compared with short‑term thematic stocks, Du Jinlong is more optimistic about long‑term targets with strong fundamentals that are suitable for "buying low and holding":

18. 1. ABF board first choice: Xinxing (3037‑TW). Among the "three leaders of board carriers," Du Jinlong recommends Xinxing as the top pick. Xinxing not only has top‑notch R&D, but also has already secured the 1.6‑trillion‑yuan photomodule PCB new technology, with all international big customers under its control.
19. Profit upgrade: the corporate research report has raised Xinxing’s future EPS estimate from 50 yuan to 71 yuan.
20. (Image source: YUANANALYSIS industry database)

21. Target price evaluation: If a 20‑times P/E is applied, the stock’s strength suggests a price above 1,400 yuan. Xinxing’s trend has always been "big rise, small pullback." It was a pity to miss the previous drop below 1,000 yuan. In the future, as long as monthly revenue continues to set new highs and the institution raises EPS, each pullback to the seasonal line is an excellent long‑term buying point.

22. 2. Financial profit king: Fubon Financial (2881‑TW). Besides tech stocks, in the second half of the year, capital has significantly shifted to traditional industries and finance with lower base periods. Fubon Financial, a profit king in finance, has high profitability and stable dividends. If you want to pick a stock with M&A synergy themes, you can also watch potential stocks like Yushan Financial. In the rotation of capital‑type stocks, finance stocks will play the role of a steady front‑line in the year‑end rally.

23. Conclusion: Keep silver bullets in batches, earn all the way to May next year! Du Jinlong revealed that his current holding level has quietly risen from 60% to 65%, looking forward to a big year‑end rally after the two major elections at the end of November.

24. Facing the current volatility, investors should remember **"don’t shoot all the bullets at once"**. They can use the 46,000‑point seasonal line as a benchmark and adopt a batch‑down picking rhythm. Allocate short‑term capital to strong thematic stocks like Sharp Point and Taichung for flexible guerrilla play; lock core assets in Xinxing, Fubon Financial, and the "Three Taichung One‑Launch" (TSMC, MediaTek, etc.), and follow the year‑end rally after the election to the 50,000‑point historic milestone!
