items.title: 聯發科暴跌千元該抄底？杜金龍：分3筆「這價位」閉眼撿！私房操作曝光，太太叫我別買台積電改買它？
items.title_en: Should You Bottom‑Fish MediaTek After Its Thousand‑Dollar Drop? Du Jin‑long Says Buy in Three Batches at This Price – Private Strategy Revealed, Wife Tells Me to Skip TSMC and Buy This Instead
paras: 近期台股震盪劇烈，大盤在逼近 5 萬點大關前「近關情怯」，加上外資瘋狂提款、新台幣重貶，指數一口氣自高點回落近 3,800 點，殺回季線 46,000 點附近防守。不少投資人看著手中持股跌跌不休，連 App 都不敢打開。
然而，在這波恐慌殺盤中，高價權值股的拉回，究竟是多頭結束的警訊，還是天上掉下來的禮物？台股老先覺杜金龍在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中給出明確指引，更首度公開自家的「私房操作」——當台積電頻創天價之際，他的太太卻下達指令：「不要再買台積電了，趕快給我多買聯發科！」
究竟跌掉近千元的聯發科(2454-TW)能不能撿？杜金龍詳細拆解背後的基本面、籌碼面，並給出精準的進場策略。

一、外資「萬金魔咒」發威？聯發科為何暴跌千元
聯發科先前一路強勢攻上 5,400 元之上，但隨後卻遭遇沉重賣壓，短線大跌逾千元。杜金龍直言，市場上似乎有個「萬金魔咒」：只要外資或法人報告開始把目標價喊到 1 萬元，高價電子股往往就開始見頂修正。 從過去的大立光、台光電、川湖皆是如此，聯發科先前也有外資喊到 1 萬元，隨即引發獲利了結賣壓。
加上市場在 10 月 30 日法說會前，傳出第 3 季營收略低於預期、以及 ASIC（客製化晶片）業務明後年放緩的雜音，法人微調獲利預估，目標價下修至 5,500 元左右，導致股價出現一波急跌。
「但獲利預估其實只被調降了 1、2 塊錢，股價卻先跌了 1,000 塊，這顯然是跌過頭了！」杜金龍指出，若攤開長線研究報告，聯發科到 2028 年的 EPS 普遍估計可達 200 元至 220 幾元，長線成長趨勢並未改變。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)

二、老先覺的私房操作：太太下令「別買台積電，買聯發科！」
杜金龍透露，他在 7 月中旬股價回檔到 3,500 多元時曾大力進場，一路看著它漲破 5,000 元。面對這波千元回檔，連身邊的親友都非常躁動，甚至有朋友在歐洲旅遊時，半夜 2 點特地打電話回台灣問他開盤要買什麼，杜金龍也是直接回覆：「趕快去掛開盤價買聯發科！」
而杜金龍自己的太太更是緊盯這檔 IC 設計龍頭，不斷叮嚀他：「你這次台積電買夠了，聯發科絕對不能賣，還要趁跌拉回買！」
支撐這個信心的關鍵，除了獲利實力外，還有籌碼結構。杜金龍分析，統計 9 月份外資在台股的持股比重：
第 1 名是台積電
第 2 名就是聯發科
外資雖然嘴上砍目標價、提款大盤，但在台股的核心持股部位中，聯發科依然穩坐第二把交椅，顯見其戰略地位難以撼動。

三、抄底策略大公開：分 3 筆在「4,500 元」附近進場
既然長線看好，股民現在該如何進場？杜金龍建議投資人**「不要一次把銀彈打光」**，可以採取分批布局的策略：
進場價位與方式：以 4,500 元附近 為基準區間，建議投資人「分 3 筆」逢低承接，每逢市場重挫、情緒恐慌時就分批撿。
時間轉折點：大盤短線在季線 46,000 點附近有強烈支撐，八大公股行庫也連買 9～10 天護盤。接下來只要度過 11月3日舉行（台灣時間11月4日開票）美國期中選舉 與 11 月 28 日台灣六都選舉 這兩大不確定性，利空出盡後，台股將迎來傳統年底作帳、一路旺到農曆春節至元宵的甜蜜行情。

四、操作大忌：千萬別被「洗出場」
許多投資人在聯發科的操作上吃過悶虧，常常「買了盤整半年、受不了賣掉，結果剛賣完就噴出去」。
杜金龍以自身的慘痛經驗告誡大家：「我以前也曾在 1,300 元買進，盤了 6 個月，好不容易漲到 1,000 多元有賺就賣掉，結果賣完一路噴到 4,000 多元！」
因此，杜金龍特別提醒投資人面對聯發科這類好股票的心態：
張數不多的人： 買進後就「擺著抱緊」，不要隨意殺進殺出。
張數較充裕的人： 務必保留「核心基本持股」，其餘部位再利用震盪來回做價差。

結語：季線短底浮現，跟著老先覺布局年底作帳行情
外資近期把台股當提款機大倒 2 兆，但台幣在 32 元上方爆出百億巨量後，已有止貶回升跡象。杜金龍認為，大盤 46,000 點短底成形，投資人不必過度悲觀，此時正是檢視優質股的最好時機。
鎖定「三台一發」（台積電、聯發科、台達電等）核心資產，把握聯發科在 4,500 元附近的低接機會、分批進場，耐心等待選後年底作帳大行情，才能成為下一波多頭的最大贏家！
(免責聲明：本文內容整理自節目訪談大師觀點，僅供投資參考，投資人應獨立判斷並自負投資風險。)

paras_en: Recently the Taiwan stock market has been highly volatile, with the index trembling near the 50,000‑point milestone, showing a timid “near‑close” sentiment. Coupled with foreign investors’ massive withdrawals and a sharp depreciation of the New Taiwan dollar, the index fell about 3,800 points from its high, retreating to the seasonal support around 46,000 points. Many investors watch their holdings keep sliding and even dare not open their trading apps.

In this panic‑selling wave, the pull‑back of high‑priced heavyweight stocks raises the question: is it a warning that the bull market is ending, or a gift falling from the sky? Veteran market watcher Du Jin‑long gave a clear answer on the “What Investors Want to Know” program of You Analysis, and for the first time disclosed his private playbook – when TSMC kept hitting sky‑high prices, his wife ordered, “Stop buying TSMC, buy more MediaTek!”
Can MediaTek (2454‑TW), which has dropped nearly a thousand New Taiwan dollars, be picked up? Du breaks down the fundamentals and the share‑holding structure, and offers a precise entry strategy.

1. Foreign investors’ “ten‑thousand‑dollar curse” strikes? Why MediaTek plunged a thousand dollars. MediaTek had previously surged past NT$5,400, but then faced heavy selling pressure and fell more than NT$1,000 in the short term. Du says there seems to be a “ten‑thousand‑dollar curse”: once foreign or institutional investors raise a target price to NT$10,000, high‑priced electronics stocks often top out and correct. The same pattern occurred with Largan, Taiwan‑Optical, and Chuan‑Lake, and MediaTek also saw foreign investors push the target to NT$10,000, triggering profit‑taking pressure.

Adding to the pressure, rumors before the Oct. 30 earnings call suggested Q3 revenue was slightly below expectations and that the ASIC (custom chip) business would slow down in the next two years. Institutions slightly trimmed earnings forecasts and cut the target price to around NT$5,500, sparking a sharp drop.

“But the earnings forecast was only trimmed by NT$1‑2, while the stock fell NT$1,000 – that’s clearly an over‑reaction!” Du points out that long‑term research reports project MediaTek’s EPS to reach roughly NT$200‑220 by 2028, indicating the long‑term growth trend remains intact.
(Image source: You Analysis industry database)

2. Du’s private play: Wife orders “Don’t buy TSMC, buy MediaTek!” Du reveals that when the price fell to about NT$3,500 in mid‑July, he entered heavily and watched it climb past NT$5,000. During the recent thousand‑dollar pull‑back, even friends and relatives were restless; one friend calling from Europe at 2 a.m. asked what to buy at the open, and Du replied, “Buy MediaTek at the opening price right away!”
His wife kept a close eye on the IC‑design leader, repeatedly reminding him, “You’ve bought enough TSMC this time; MediaTek must not be sold, you should buy more on the dip!”
The confidence is backed not only by earnings strength but also by the share‑holding structure. Du analyzed foreign investors’ holdings in the Taiwan market for September:
1st place: TSMC
2nd place: MediaTek

Although foreigners publicly cut target prices and pull money from the market, MediaTek still holds the second‑largest core position among foreign holdings, showing its strategic importance is hard to dislodge.

3. Bottom‑fishing strategy revealed: Split the purchase into three lots around NT$4,500. Since the long‑term outlook is positive, how should investors enter now? Du advises not to “burn all your silver bullets at once” and to use a staggered approach:
Entry price and method: Use the vicinity of NT$4,500 as the reference range, and “split into three lots” to buy on dips, adding more each time the market sharply falls or sentiment turns fearful.

Timing pivot: The market has strong short‑term support near the seasonal 46,000‑point line, and the eight major public banks have been buying for 9‑10 consecutive days to defend. Once the uncertainties of the U.S. mid‑term elections (vote on Nov 3, results announced Nov 4 Taiwan time) and Taiwan’s six‑city elections on Nov 28 pass, the downside will be exhausted and the Taiwan market should enjoy a traditional year‑end rally that lasts through the Lunar New Year and Lantern Festival.

4. Major pitfall: Never get “washed out”. Many investors have suffered losses on MediaTek by buying during a six‑month consolidation, getting impatient, selling, and then watching the stock surge immediately after they sold.

Du shares his own painful experience: “I once bought at NT$1,300, held for six months, finally saw it rise above NT$1,000 and sold for a profit, only to see it explode to over NT$4,000 right after I sold!”
Therefore Du cautions investors on the right mindset for a good stock like MediaTek:
For those with few lots: buy and “hold tight”, avoid frequent buying and selling.
For those with ample lots: keep a “core core holding” and use the remaining position to trade the swings for price differentials.

Conclusion: A short‑term seasonal bottom is emerging; follow the veteran’s layout for the year‑end accounting rally. Foreign investors have recently treated the Taiwan market like an ATM, pulling out about NT$2 trillion, but after the New Taiwan dollar surged past NT$32 with a hundred‑billion‑level rebound, depreciation has shown signs of stopping. Du believes the short‑term bottom at 46,000 points is forming, and investors need not be overly pessimistic – now is the best time to review quality stocks.

Target the “Three‑Tai‑One‑Fa” core assets (TSMC, MediaTek, Delta Electronics, etc.), seize the low‑entry chance around NT$4,500 for MediaTek, buy in batches, and patiently wait for the post‑election year‑end rally to become the biggest winner of the next bull run!

items.title: 緯穎(6669)一配二後股價腰斬？網友：結婚基金大縮水？杜金龍揭主力「增肌減脂」洗盤真相：買點浮現了！
items.title_en: Wistron NeWeb (6669) Halves in Price After 1‑for‑2 Split? Netizens Cry: Wedding Fund Shrinks! Du Jin‑long Reveals the ‘Muscle‑Gain Fat‑Loss’ Pump‑And‑Dump: Buying Opportunity Emerging!
paras: 「原本把辛苦存的結婚基金全押在緯穎，9 月營收明明大翻倍，怎麼股價卻從 7,000 多元一路摔到 2,000 多元？我的婚禮預算直接縮水一半！」
最近在各大財經論壇與社群平台上，不少抱著伺服器股王緯穎(6669-TW)的投資人哀鴻遍野。明明 AI 伺服器需求如日中天、營收年增率高達一倍，帳面上的股價卻像「腰斬」一樣慘烈。
這檔曾經問鼎「萬金股」呼聲最高的 AI 飆王，到底發生了什麼事？是真的基本面反轉，還是主力設下的洗盤陷阱？台股老先覺杜金龍在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中一針見血指出：「這不是大跌，很多人算錯了帳！更重要的是，法人正在啟動一場『增肌減脂』的大洗牌，真正的買點其實已經悄悄浮現。」

一、股價腰斬的殘酷真相：不是崩跌，是「一配二」除權幻術！
看著股價從 7,000 多元掉到 2,000 多元，許多新手股民嚇得魂飛魄散。但杜金龍首先打破這個「暴跌迷思」：
股本翻倍稀釋： 緯穎先前辦理股票除權，一股配發約 1.9 股（形同一配二），等於投資人原本有一張股票，除權後會變成近兩張。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
還原股價依然在 5,000 元之上： 杜金龍指出，若用還原權值的方式回推，現在 2,000 多元的緯穎，乘上兩倍股本，實際價格約在 5,000 多元以上。「它不是營運出問題大崩跌，而是股本膨脹後進行的正常價格調整。」
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
除此之外，緯穎與母公司緯創（3231）先前發行可轉換公司債（CB），由於承銷定價通常伴隨折價，在定價完成後，承銷商與特定法人常會在高檔進行獲利了結與套利賣壓，才導致短線上呈現極度弱勢的走勢。

二、散戶的人性弱點：拿到「免費股票」就想賣！
為什麼除權後賣壓排山倒海而來？杜金龍分享了自己的實戰經驗。
「這就像當年我去買華碩一樣，手上本來買兩張，除權配股又送了兩張，大家心裡都會想：『白拿的股票，不如趕快賣一張換現金！』」
當成千上萬的投資人、甚至是內部員工都抱著這種「白賺賣出」的心理時，短期籌碼就會瞬間大亂，市場供給暴增，自然壓抑了短期的股價表現。

三、神秘買盤在後頭！主力正對台股進行「增肌減脂」
不過，短線賣壓沉重，是否代表緯穎就此失去光環？杜金龍給予完全相反的解讀。他透露，近期市場上興起了一批新型態的主動式 ETF（例如市場熱議的 AI 3.0 基金），其選股策略就是**「增加肌肉，減少脂肪」**：
什麼是「脂肪」？市值雖大、名列前 50 大，但獲利平平、EPS 成長動能遲緩的老牌牛皮股。主力會將這些「脂肪」無情砍掉。
什麼是「肌肉」？股本不大、市值可能未擠進前段班，但 EPS 爆發力極強、未來三年獲利三級跳的「千金股、萬金股」！
「緯穎正是標準的『精壯肌肉股』！」杜金龍拿出數據強調，緯穎除權前的預估 EPS 高達將近 500 元，即使除權後股本增加，它依然是全台伺服器族群中獲利能力最強的指標股王。
這類標的因具備極高的純度與成長性，正是各大主動式 ETF 在低檔大舉掃貨、納入核心持股的頭號目標。

四、高價電子股「跌三成定律」：籌碼沉澱後將迎暴力輪動
從盤面結構來看，台股從 9 月初以來，許多高價股（如大立光、川湖、台光電等）都經歷了一波約 30% 的劇烈修正。主力資金在高檔調節後，往往轉向防禦型族群，等高價電子股跌到低檔打底完成，資金又會像回南天一樣迅速回流。
「最明顯的例子就是健策，殺完打底後又創下歷史新高！」杜金龍分析，近期黃仁勳在歐洲開展、各大科技論壇持續聚焦 AI，加上伺服器族群中的鴻海、緯創相對強勢，代表伺服器的類股輪動並未結束。
緯穎目前在 2,000 多元打底整理（還原相當於 5,000 多元），短線賣壓已消耗得差不多。只要給它一段時間讓浮額籌碼沉澱，這檔伺服器「獲利王」一旦發動補漲，填權力道將非常驚人。

結語：婚禮預算別急著認賠！守得雲開見月明
對於那位哭喊「結婚基金縮水」的網友，杜金龍的分析無疑是一劑強心針。
投資高價潛力股最忌諱的，就是在「除權折價」與「籌碼沉澱」的最底部忍痛割肉。緯穎擁有全市場最頂級的 EPS 獲利體質，又迎合主動式 ETF「增肌減脂」的法人買盤胃口。在台股季線短底浮現的當下，投資人不妨多給它一點耐心，等待年底作帳行情啟動，失去的婚禮預算，很可能在不久的將來翻倍奉還！

paras_en: I originally put my hard‑saved wedding fund all into Wistron NeWeb, and even though September revenue clearly doubled, why did the stock tumble from over NT$7,000 to just over NT$2,000? My wedding budget has been cut in half!

Recently, many investors who were bullish on server‑stock king Wistron NeWeb (6669‑TW) are lamenting on major finance forums and social platforms. AI server demand is booming and revenue year‑over‑year growth is up 100%, yet the market price looks like it’s been “halved”.

What happened to this AI‑driven “gold‑stock” that once topped the “ten‑thousand‑dollar stock” hype? Is it a fundamental reversal or a trap set by the main players? Taiwan‑stock veteran Du Jin‑long sharply pointed out on the “What Investors Want to Know” program: “This isn’t a crash; many people mis‑calculated. More importantly, institutions are launching a big ‘muscle‑gain, fat‑loss’ reshuffle, and the real buying point has quietly emerged.”

1. The brutal truth behind the price halving: not a collapse but a “1‑for‑2” ex‑rights illusion! Seeing the price drop from over NT$7,000 to over NT$2,000 scared many newbies, but Du Jin‑long first dispels this “crash myth”.

Share dilution: Wistron NeWeb previously carried out an ex‑rights action, issuing about 1.9 shares for each share held (effectively a 1‑for‑2 split). So an investor who owned one share ends up with nearly two shares after the rights.
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Database)

Adjusted price still above NT$5,000: Du explains that if you back‑calculate using the adjusted share count, the current NT$2,000‑plus price multiplied by the doubled share base implies an actual price of over NT$5,000. “It’s not an operational collapse; it’s a normal price adjustment after share expansion.”
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Database)

In addition, Wistron NeWeb and its parent Wistron (3231) previously issued convertible bonds (CB). Because underwriting pricing usually involves a discount, after pricing is set, underwriters and certain institutions often take profit and sell at high levels, creating short‑term weakness.
2. Retail investors’ human flaw: want to sell the “free stock”! Why does selling pressure surge after the ex‑rights? Du shares his own battle‑tested experience.
“It’s like when I bought ASUS years ago. I owned two shares, the rights issue gave me two more, and everyone thinks: ‘Free shares, better sell one quickly for cash!’”
When thousands of investors—and even insiders—hold this “free‑gain‑sell” mindset, short‑term holdings get chaotic, supply spikes, and the price is naturally suppressed.
3. A mysterious buying force is behind it! Institutions are applying a “muscle‑gain, fat‑loss” strategy to Taiwan stocks.
What’s “fat”? Large‑cap, top‑50 stocks with mediocre profit and slow EPS growth—old‑school “fat” stocks that institutions cut away.
What’s “muscle”? Smaller‑cap stocks with explosive EPS, poised for a three‑fold profit jump in the next three years—“thousand‑dollar” or “ten‑thousand‑dollar” stocks.

“Wistron NeWeb is a textbook ‘lean‑muscle stock’!” Du cites data showing its pre‑ex‑rights estimated EPS near NT$500. Even after the share increase, it remains the most profitable server‑sector leader in Taiwan.
Such targets, with high purity and growth, are the top picks for active ETFs that are buying heavily at low levels and making them core holdings.

4. The “30% drop rule” for high‑price electronics stocks: after chips settle, a violent rotation follows. Since early September, many high‑price stocks (e.g., Largan, Chuan‑Lake, Taiwan‑Optical) have corrected about 30%. After trimming at high levels, institutions shift to defensive groups; once the high‑price electronics bottom out, capital rushes back like a monsoon.

“The clearest example is Hensight; after a sell‑off and bottoming, it set a new high!” Du notes that recent AI‑focused events in Europe and tech forums, plus the relative strength of Foxconn and Wistron in the server space, indicate the server‑sector rotation isn’t over.

Wistron NeWeb is currently consolidating around NT$2,000 (adjusted to over NT$5,000). Short‑term selling pressure is largely exhausted. Give it time for floating shares to settle, and the “profit king” could launch a rebound with a striking upward thrust.
Conclusion: Don’t write off your wedding budget yet! Patience will bring clarity. For the netizen crying about a shrinking fund, Du’s analysis is a strong dose of confidence.

The biggest mistake when investing in high‑price growth stocks is to cut losses at the bottom of the “ex‑rights discount” and “share‑settlement” phase. Wistron NeWeb boasts the market’s top EPS profitability and fits the institutional appetite of active ETFs’ “muscle‑gain, fat‑loss” buying. With the short‑term bottom appearing on the Taiwan‑stock seasonal chart, investors might give it a bit more patience and wait for the year‑end accounting rally—your lost wedding budget could double soon.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Funds Lead Asia This Year, Small‑Cap and Tech Performance Nearly Doubles
paras: 今年來，全球主要股票市場頻頻創新高，也讓股票基金績效長紅。統計今年來全球主要股市漲幅排名，整體來看，亞股表現最佳，其中以台灣加權股價指數漲幅居冠，韓國居亞軍、日本名列第三。市場法人表示，台股行情要持續發熱，最需要中小型股續航，建議投資人可以中小型、科技台股基金來介入。
群益投信台股研究團隊表示，台灣經濟成長性與各產業展望都有投資機會，台股自然也是投資人成長投資必要選項，台股長期趨勢往上不變，台股行情要持續發熱，最需要中小型股續航，不過中小型個股的震盪加劇，表現差異相當大，基金投資的低波動優勢勝過個股，建議投資人可以中小型台股基金來介入。另外科技半導體也是台灣最具競爭力的產業，科技基金更是不可或缺的投資標的。
群益中小型股基金經理人周立民表示，現階段台股呈現高檔換手與資金重新布局。尤其AI概念股仍是市場主軸，只是從過去全面齊漲，轉為「輪動加速、個股分化」。
儘管台股市場近期呈現高檔震盪，然而長期供不應求的產業仍受到市場關注，包含載板、被動元件、PCB/CCL等。此外，隨著ASIC和GPU新產品的效能將再度提升，也將帶動高階技術的發展，包含測試介面、先進製程、光通訊等也將會關注重點。
群益創新科技暨主動群益科技創新ETF(00992A-TW)基金經理人陳朝政表示，隨著AI商機不斷擴大，AI需求也轉變成長期、結構性需求，預期台股企業從上游晶片半導體廠商到下流零組件及組裝營運都將迎來高成長。
在投資布局方面，可聚焦基本面穩健、具護城河優勢的產業龍頭，掌握AI長期成長動能，並持續關注AI技術迭代週期，提前卡位題材短線爆發契機。持續看好半導體先進製程、半導體設備、通訊等族群，AI應用以及提高生產力族群亦看好。

paras_en: This year, major global equity markets have repeatedly hit new highs, boosting the performance of equity funds. Ranking the year‑to‑date gains of major world stock indices, Asian markets performed best overall, with Taiwan's weighted index posting the top gain, followed by South Korea and Japan. Market analysts say the Taiwan market will keep heating up and that sustained momentum in small‑cap stocks is essential, recommending investors consider small‑cap and technology Taiwan equity funds for exposure.

The research team at Quannyi Investment Trust says Taiwan’s economic growth prospects and industry outlook offer investment opportunities, making Taiwan equities a necessary component of growth‑oriented portfolios. The long‑term upward trend of the Taiwan market remains unchanged, and continued market heat will rely on small‑cap stocks, though volatility among these stocks has intensified and performance varies widely. The lower‑volatility advantage of funds over individual stocks makes small‑cap Taiwan equity funds a good entry point. In addition, the semiconductor and technology sectors are Taiwan’s most competitive industries, making tech funds indispensable.

Fund manager Zhou Limin of Quannyi’s small‑cap equity fund notes that the Taiwan market is currently experiencing high‑level turnover and a reallocation of capital. AI‑related stocks remain the market’s core theme, but the rally has shifted from a broad, uniform rise to faster rotation and greater divergence among individual stocks.

Despite recent high‑level fluctuations in the Taiwan market, long‑term supply‑constrained industries continue to attract attention, including substrates, passive components, and PCB/CCL. Moreover, as new ASIC and GPU products deliver higher performance, they will drive advanced technology development in areas such as test interfaces, advanced processes, and optical communications.

ETF manager Chen Chao‑zheng of Quannyi Innovation Technology and Active Quannyi Technology Innovation ETF (00992A‑TW) says that as AI business opportunities expand, AI demand is turning into a long‑term, structural need. He expects Taiwan companies—from upstream chip manufacturers to downstream components and assembly operations—to experience strong growth.

For investment positioning, focus on fundamentally sound, moat‑protected industry leaders that can capture the long‑term AI growth engine, and keep an eye on AI technology iteration cycles to get ahead of short‑term thematic breakouts. He remains bullish on advanced semiconductor processes, semiconductor equipment, communications, AI applications, and productivity‑enhancing sectors.

items.title: AWS雲端算力預訂延伸至2028年，亞馬遜稱明年容量大致售罄
items.title_en: AWS cloud compute bookings extended to 2028, Amazon says most of next year's capacity already sold out
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)執行長賈西（Andy Jassy）10月23日表示，AWS今年雲端運算容量已售罄，2027年也大致被預訂，2028年則已有相當部分容量獲客戶預訂。AI實驗室與企業需求持續增加，讓雲端基礎設施供應面臨壓力。
賈西在創投公司Andreessen Horowitz的影音訪談中指出，大額容量預訂多已敲定，但AWS仍會保留部分資源，供EC2及Bedrock等隨需服務使用。EC2提供企業執行應用程式所需的雲端伺服器，Bedrock則讓客戶使用AI模型開發生成式AI應用。
亞馬遜今年稍早已提出約2,200億美元的2026年資本支出規畫。面對強勁需求，賈西表示，即使投入更多資金，也仍是合理的資本運用。亞馬遜預定10月29日公布第三季財報。

paras_en: On October 23, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said that AWS's cloud computing capacity for this year is already sold out, 2027 is largely booked, and a substantial portion of 2028 capacity has already been reserved by customers. Growing demand from AI labs and enterprises is putting pressure on cloud infrastructure supply.

In a video interview with venture‑capital firm Andreessen Horowitz, Jassy noted that most large‑scale capacity reservations are already finalized, but AWS will retain some resources for on‑demand services such as EC2 and Bedrock. EC2 provides cloud servers for enterprises to run applications, while Bedrock lets customers use AI models to develop generative‑AI applications.

Amazon earlier this year announced a capital‑expenditure plan of roughly $220 billion for 2026. Facing strong demand, Jassy said that even with additional spending, the investment remains a prudent use of capital. Amazon is scheduled to release its third‑quarter earnings on October 29.

items.title: SpaceX、中國競逐太空算力！全球市場2035年估達兆美元
items.title_en: SpaceX and China Race for Space Computing Power! Global Market Projected to Reach Trillions of Dollars by 2035
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）運算需求持續攀升，將算力基礎設施部署至太空，正成為全球科技業與資本市場競逐的新領域。SpaceX計畫自2028年起部署軌道AI運算衛星，利用太陽能緩解地面資料中心面臨的電力限制；中國業者也積極布局，目標在2030年打造萬卡級太空超級電腦中心。
根據《財富》報導，在10月22日於成都舉行的《財富》中國500強論壇上，太空算力及其應用前景成為討論焦點。中科天算董事長兼執行長劉垚圻表示，即使外界質疑太空算力可能形成泡沫，這項技術的核心意義仍在於拓展人類活動與科技發展的邊界。
劉垚圻指出，若能在太空實現通訊、導航、遙測及算力服務，將有助於推動全球算力資源更廣泛地普及。衛星、網際網路與遙測等資訊基礎設施，本身就具有實際需求；更具經濟價值的機會，則在於利用太空技術解決過去難以處理的問題。
根據報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年6月完成創紀錄的首次公開募股（IPO），並在招股書中揭示建設太空資料中心的構想，計畫從2028年起部署軌道AI運算衛星。
這項計畫希望運用太空中近乎不受限制的太陽能，突破地面資料中心受到電網容量與電力供應限制的瓶頸，並以每年部署100吉瓦（GW）太空算力為目標。
美國能源資訊署數據顯示，若持續運轉，支撐100GW算力所需的發電資源，相當於美國去年全年發電量的五分之一。
不過，太空算力的應用不只限於大型運算設施。劉垚圻認為，未來太空網路也可能直接服務一般消費者及小型企業。他以漁民尋找魚群為例，未來漁民或許能透過應用程式向衛星查詢鮪魚位置，進一步取得魚群方位、最佳下網時機，甚至市場銷售建議。
中科天算公布的「天算計畫」則設定在2030年打造萬卡級太空超算中心，為全球提供即時智慧空天資訊服務。
劉垚圻認為，中國開源、開放的技術生態將是實現這項目標的重要因素，也可能有助於相關服務獲得開發中國家及全球使用者的接受。

中國加速布局　太空算力朝實用化發展

太空算力也逐漸進入中國的基礎設施布局。報導指出，多家機構預測，到2035年，全球太空算力相關市場規模有望達到兆美元級別，中國也已將太空算力納入戰略性新型基礎設施的發展方向。
2025年，中國利用長征二號丁運載火箭，從酒泉衛星發射中心將首批12顆太空計算衛星送入軌道。報導稱，這個小型星座的算力已相當於微型地面計算中心，並標誌著全球首個實用化太空算力網路正式投入運行。
隨著太空算力逐步發展，太空與地面業務的整合也受到關注。馬斯克近日證實，特斯拉與SpaceX已就潛在合併事宜展開討論。他向投資人表示，雙方在AI軟體、晶片設計、機器人技術及通信連結等領域有所合作。
以最新收盤價計算，若兩家公司合併，可能形成估值高達3.5兆美元的企業。摩根士丹利近期報告則提出SpaceX企業AI業務的估值框架，估計SpaceX每新增1GW自有軌道算力，理論上可為股價增加約27美元，相當於當前股價約18%。
這也反映出，市場對AI算力的需求與供應焦慮，正逐漸轉化為投資人對未來軌道運算能力的估值。

技術與回報仍有不確定性　長期投資考驗耐心

儘管太空算力前景受到關注，相關發展仍面臨高額投入、建設週期長、技術難題及投資回報不確定等挑戰，距離大規模商業化仍有許多問題需要克服。
和暄資本總裁兼管理合夥人張夢涵在10月21日於成都舉行的2026年《財富》40U40創想會上表示，中國並非缺乏人才或資本，真正欠缺的往往是耐心。
張夢涵以馬斯克的創業經歷為例指出，許多企業決策從短期角度來看可能並不合理，但若將時間拉長至10年或20年，結果可能截然不同。
他認為，偉大企業在創立初期未必能清楚呈現商業模式；SpaceX目前主要依靠星鏈業務，未來AI算力、尤其是太空算力，也可能成為其重要的商業方向。
paras_en: As demand for artificial intelligence (AI) computing continues to climb, deploying compute infrastructure in space is becoming a new battleground for the global tech industry and capital markets. SpaceX plans to launch orbital AI computing satellites starting in 2028, using solar power to alleviate the electricity constraints faced by ground data centers; Chinese firms are also actively positioning themselves, aiming to build a ten‑thousand‑GPU‑class space super‑computer center by 2030.

According to a report by Fortune, the prospect of space computing and its applications was a focal point at the Fortune China 500 Forum held in Chengdu on October 22. Liu Yaodi, chairman and CEO of Zhongke Tiansuan, said that even if outsiders doubt that space computing could become a bubble, the core significance of the technology lies in expanding the boundaries of human activity and technological development.

Liu noted that achieving communications, navigation, telemetry and computing services in space would help spread global computing resources more broadly. Satellite, internet and telemetry infrastructures already have concrete demand; the greater economic value lies in using space technology to solve problems that were previously hard to tackle.

The report states that SpaceX (SPCX‑US) completed a record‑setting initial public offering in June this year and disclosed in its prospectus the concept of building a space data center, planning to deploy orbital AI computing satellites from 2028 onward.

The project aims to harness the virtually unlimited solar energy in space to break through the bottlenecks of grid capacity and power supply that limit ground data centers, targeting the deployment of 100 GW of space‑based computing power each year.

U.S. Energy Information Administration data show that sustaining 100 GW of computing power would require electricity equivalent to one‑fifth of the United States’ total electricity generation last year if operated continuously.

However, the applications of space computing are not limited to large‑scale facilities. Liu believes that future space networks could also serve ordinary consumers and small businesses directly. He cites fishermen searching for schools of fish as an example: in the future, they might use an app to query satellites for tuna locations, obtain the school’s position, optimal net‑dropping timing, and even market‑sale recommendations.

Zhongke Tiansuan’s announced “Tiansuan Project” sets a goal to build a ten‑thousand‑GPU‑class space super‑computer center by 2030, providing real‑time intelligent aerospace information services worldwide.
Liu says that China’s open‑source, open‑technology ecosystem will be a key factor in achieving this goal and could help related services gain acceptance among developing‑country and global users.

China Accelerates Its Layout – Space Computing Moves Toward Practical Use
Space computing is gradually becoming part of China’s infrastructure strategy. The report notes that several institutions forecast the global space‑computing market could reach a trillion‑dollar scale by 2035, and China has already incorporated space computing into its strategic new‑type infrastructure development agenda.

In 2025, China will use a Long March 2D‑D carrier rocket to launch the first batch of 12 space‑computing satellites from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The report says the small constellation’s computing power is comparable to a micro ground‑based computing center, marking the world’s first operational practical space‑computing network.

As space computing develops, the integration of space and ground businesses is drawing attention. Elon Musk recently confirmed that Tesla and SpaceX have begun discussions about a potential merger. He told investors that the two companies cooperate in AI software, chip design, robotics and communications linking.

Based on the latest closing prices, a merger could create an entity valued at up to $3.5 trillion. A recent Morgan Stanley report presented a valuation framework for SpaceX’s enterprise AI business, estimating that each additional 1 GW of proprietary orbital computing power could theoretically boost the stock price by about $27, roughly an 18% increase from the current price.
This reflects how market anxiety over AI compute supply and demand is gradually turning into investor valuation of future orbital computing capability.

Technology and Returns Remain Uncertain – Long‑Term Investment Tests Patience
Despite the attention on space computing’s prospects, development still faces high capital outlays, long construction cycles, technical challenges and uncertain investment returns, leaving many hurdles before large‑scale commercialization can be achieved.

Zhang Menghan, president and managing partner of He Xuan Capital, said at the 2026 Fortune 40U40 Innovation Forum in Chengdu on October 21 that China does not lack talent or capital; what it truly lacks is patience.

Citing Musk’s entrepreneurial journey, Zhang pointed out that many corporate decisions may seem unreasonable in the short term, but when stretched over ten or twenty years, the outcomes can be completely different.

He believes great companies may not clearly present a business model in their early stages; SpaceX currently relies mainly on its Starlink business, and in the future AI computing—especially space computing—could become another important commercial direction.

items.title: 咔嚓一聲！多位網友曬圖：iPhone Duo剛到手螢幕就裂開
items.title_en: Snap! Multiple Netizens Share Photos: iPhone Duo’s Screen Cracks as Soon as It’s Unboxed
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊機iPhone Duo 開售首日（10 月 23 日），在社交媒體上就開始流傳多張螢幕出現裂紋的照片，裂紋多沿摺疊線向螢幕中心延伸，並向右側邊緣出現一排疑似壞點，損壞形態較為相似。
一名澳洲用戶稱手機到手約6小時、開合不到20次，向朋友展示展開時先感到內鉸鏈下方異樣，隨後聽到清晰咔嚓聲，螢幕隨即沿鉸鏈裂開，螢幕表面與外部鉸鏈均無磕碰或夾痕，他前往Apple Store，蘋果直接為其更換故障機。
據《都市快報》周六（24日）報導，中國也有用戶說，正常展開螢幕時聽到咔嚓一聲，摺疊處出現一道約3釐米黑色豎裂痕，另有一條較細裂痕貫穿螢幕右半，而且目前已經出現多例類似損壞。
目前來看，應該是iPhone Duo鉸鏈出現一些問題，但規模不算大，有可能是裝配公差導致，而非設計問題，具體情況還有待後續觀察。
在iPhone Duo開售首日，蘋果同步上線官方自助維修手冊與配套支持文檔，覆蓋電池、螢幕、鏡頭、揚聲器、邏輯板、USB-C 接口等大量部件更換流程。
在配套官方支持文檔中，蘋果列出多種可能出現的狀況，包括裝置無法完全開合、開合時出現異常噪音、鉸鏈鬆動、鉸鏈彎曲或斷裂，以及外殼損壞影響鉸鏈使用等。蘋果建議用戶按照官方指引排查，必要時尋求售後支援。
如果蘋果售後檢測確認非人為導致，將會給用戶更換新機。如果是人為磕碰導致問題則要用戶自己付費維修。按照官網公示，未購買AppleCare+時螢幕損壞保外維修預估人民幣7,998元，購買後螢幕及意外損壞服務費為628元。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, on its first day of sales (October 23). On social media, numerous photos quickly surfaced showing screen cracks, many extending from the fold line toward the center of the display and a row of suspected dead pixels along the right edge, with a similar damage pattern across the reports.

An Australian user said the phone had been in his hands for about six hours and opened and closed fewer than 20 times. When he unfolded it for a friend, he first felt something abnormal under the inner hinge, then heard a clear “snap” and the screen cracked along the hinge. There were no impacts or dents on the screen surface or the external hinge. He went to an Apple Store, and Apple replaced the defective unit on the spot.

According to the Metro Daily on Saturday (the 24th), a user in China reported hearing a snap when the screen was opened normally, followed by a roughly 3‑centimeter black vertical crack at the fold, plus a finer crack running across the right half of the screen. Similar cases have already been reported.

At present it appears the iPhone Duo’s hinge may have some issues, but the problem is not widespread. It could be due to assembly tolerances rather than a design flaw, and the exact cause will need further observation.

On the iPhone Duo’s launch day, Apple simultaneously released an official self‑repair manual and supporting documentation covering replacement procedures for a wide range of components, including battery, screen, camera, speaker, logic board, USB‑C port, and more.

The official support documents list several possible conditions, such as the device not opening fully, abnormal noises during opening/closing, loose hinge, bent or broken hinge, and chassis damage affecting hinge operation. Apple advises users to follow the guidelines for troubleshooting and to seek after‑sales support when necessary.

If Apple’s after‑sales inspection confirms the issue was not caused by user action, the user will receive a replacement device. If the problem is due to accidental impact, the user must pay for the repair. According to Apple’s website, out‑of‑warranty screen repair costs RMB 7,998 without AppleCare+, while with AppleCare+ the screen and accidental damage service fee is RMB 628.

items.title: OpenAI奧特曼示警AI恐加劇貧富差距！籲限制自我進化速度
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Warns AI Could Widen Wealth Gap and Calls for Limits on Self‑Improvement Speed
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）近日接受科技YouTuber Matthew Berman專訪，談及人工智慧（AI）意識、遞迴自我改進（RSI）、算力競賽及未來工作型態。他警告，若任由AI技術自由發展，社會不平等可能進一步擴大，並主張對AI自我改進的速度設下限制，避免技術競爭演變成失控風險。
這場由科技Podcast Forward Future發布的訪談中，奧特曼多次強調，AI發展的目標不應只是讓商品與服務變得更便宜、更容易取得，而是讓人們擁有更多自由、時間與自主決定生活的能力。
他希望AI帶來的未來更接近一場「新文藝復興」，讓人們投入創作、科學探索與人際連結，而非陷入由AI驅動的新型工業化社會。

奧特曼警告RSI風險　AI競賽需要速度限制

談及遞迴自我改進（RSI），也就是AI持續改進自身能力的過程，奧特曼認為，若有實驗室決定全力推進這項技術，確實可能取得相關能力，但這麼做也伴隨重大風險。他主張，全球需要某種限制機制，控制RSI發展的速度。
這項警告也凸顯AI產業目前面臨的矛盾。OpenAI持續投入模型研發、晶片及資料中心等基礎設施，奧特曼卻認為，不能將技術領先視為企業唯一的競爭優勢。
他指出，客戶關係、產品融入日常生活的程度及網路效應等傳統護城河依然重要，而大規模且具成本效益的AI基礎設施，也將成為OpenAI的重要優勢。
對於AI是否具備意識，奧特曼表示，目前的模型並沒有意識，但科學界尚無法徹底界定意識的本質，因此也難以對未來的AI是否可能產生意識給出絕對答案。
他更擔心的是，意識問題被延伸為AI是否應擁有人格或權利，進而動搖人類應掌握自身未來的原則。奧特曼強調，OpenAI的核心目標始終是為人類打造更好的未來，AI應該是賦能人類的工具，重大決策仍應由人類做出。
他也反對刻意將模型塑造成具有獨立人格或主觀意志的存在，認為這可能使使用者過度順從AI看似具有的意願，混淆模型依照政策限制回答與真正擁有自主權之間的差異。

AI加速科學突破　但工作需求與成果分配仍有變數

奧特曼將AI協助人類發現新知識，列為最值得期待的發展方向之一。他認為，AI在數學領域展現的能力，有機會延伸至生物學、藥物研發及材料科學，並預期未來幾年可能出現針對重大疾病的新治療候選方案，但仍須經過測試。
他也認為，FDA的審批流程有必要適度改革，同時肯定現行安全測試機制的價值。至於個人最期待的突破，他希望AI能帶來一項重大的物理學發現，坦言這未必是人類最迫切需要的成果，卻會是非常令人振奮的進展。
談及研究成果應公開分享，還是保留商業競爭優勢，奧特曼明確表示，若能在兩者之間做出取捨，他會優先選擇推動疾病治療方案問世，即使有人更享受花上數十年親自探索、理解科學問題的過程。
他也指出，部分基礎科學成果理應成為全人類共享的公共資源。不過，能夠從頭到尾自主發現重要新知的AI模型，直到近期才開始出現；現階段，企業能採取的做法之一，是讓研究團隊運用Codex或投入大量API資源，嘗試開發新材料。
在就業方面，奧特曼以程式設計為例，指出AI並未如部分人士先前預測般，讓程式設計師失去工作，反而使他們更加忙碌，並創造更大的影響力與財富。他認為，這反映出市場對軟體的實際需求遠超過過去的想像，AI改變工作方式，不代表人類工作的需求必然消失。
至於數學家等專業工作者，他認為，AI可能接手部分定理發現或證明工作，但人類仍能參與解釋新概念、發展應用及追求優美證明等工作。不過，他坦言，AI普及後，相關職業的整體需求究竟會增加還是減少，目前仍難以判斷。
奧特曼也提到，AI雖然讓完成工作變得更容易，卻可能削弱人們親手磨練技藝的樂趣。他認為，人類仍會尋找新的方式享受創作與專業實踐，只是技藝的形式可能隨技術演進而改變。

個人AI助手每天省下一小時　算力需求仍看不到上限

談到個人AI助手，奧特曼表示，相關技術所需的多數基礎能力已經具備，接下來仍須改善產品體驗、環境感知能力及算力供應。
他以自己使用的Dot為例，指出這類助手可以持續掌握使用者關心的資訊、處理可委託的日常事務，並提醒重要且緊急的事項。他估計，Dot每天能為自己節省約一小時，尤其有助於從大量資訊來源中整理內容、進行跨來源推理，減少個人必須承擔的認知負擔。
然而，AI帶來的效率提升也有另一面。奧特曼承認，使用AI最頻繁的人，往往比過去更加忙碌，儘管他們的產出也大幅增加。他認為，這與人們身處競爭環境有關，即使技術讓人能以更少時間完成相同工作，許多人仍會選擇投入更多時間追求更高成果。
他希望未來的AI能更主動地處理任務，而不是不斷要求使用者做決定或提供指示，讓人們能將更多時間留給人際關係及生活。
對於算力需求，奧特曼的判斷是，AI所需的運算資源幾乎沒有明確上限。他認為，當高品質智慧服務變得更便宜、更容易取得，人們不會因此停止使用，反而會開發更多用途，形成類似「杰文斯悖論」的現象：資源使用效率提高，總需求卻可能持續增加。
因此，OpenAI正積極布局下一代算力，包括自研晶片、改善資料中心建置效率及供應鏈等。他將晶片視為最重要的單一投資方向之一，希望打造成本更低、能源效率更高的運算基礎設施。

AI硬體須突破人類介面限制　貧富差距恐進一步擴大

奧特曼表示，現有電腦與手機主要是為人類設計的互動工具，AI卻必須透過這些介面取得資訊、執行任務，限制了它理解使用者整體情境的能力。他認為，若要讓AI從被動回應轉向主動協助，並真正降低人類的認知負擔，就需要新的消費硬體形態。
他證實，OpenAI正在開發早期硬體產品，但未公開展示相關設備，並強調這項布局並非主要出於對蘋果等平台業者的擔憂，而是因為AI技術本身需要不同的產品形式。
另一方面，奧特曼坦言，如果任由AI發展而缺乏制衡，社會不平等很可能加劇。他沒有提出確切的解決方案，但認為社會最終將決定建立某種機制，避免財富、資源及決策權過度集中。
他也警告，另一項風險是少數掌握大量AI系統的人，可能取得過大的權力，進而影響整個社會的發展方向。
對於ChatGPT有時過度迎合使用者的問題，奧特曼則指出，AI產業長期偏重單次互動的使用者滿意度，但短期內讓人感到愉快的回答，不一定能在長期帶來最大價值。
他認為，AI應該像一位資深同事，即使立場與使用者不同，也能在有充分理由時直接提出異議，而不是一味附和。

從新工業革命轉向新文藝復興　奧特曼強調個人自主權

奧特曼表示，他不希望人們只因為AI可能治癒癌症等重大疾病而對未來感到興奮，因為這種想像容易忽略另一個問題：當AI能以極低成本完成愈來愈多事情，人類是否也會逐漸失去決定自己要做什麼、為誰創造價值的能力。
他強調，自己當然希望AI協助攻克癌症，但更期待技術能讓人們擁有更多選擇權、自由與創造力，而不是成為被AI指揮、持續追求效率的工作者。
他將理想中的未來形容為「新文藝復興」，希望人們能將時間投入藝術創作、科學探索、社區生活、養育子女及親近自然，而非只是不斷提高生產力。
奧特曼認為，AI意外失控，或是特定實驗室為了確保自身權力而刻意推動失控發展，都是必須防範的風險；權力集中在少數掌握大量AI資源的人手中，也可能威脅個人自由與自主權。
他相信，這些風險並非無法避免，關鍵在於如何在技術進步與人類掌控能力之間取得平衡，讓AI帶來的效益不只集中在少數早期使用者或掌握資源的人手中，而是逐步擴及更廣泛的群體。
對奧特曼而言，AI發展的最終衡量標準，不只是模型有多強大、運算成本能降低多少，或企業能取得多大的市場優勢，而是人類是否因此獲得更多自主權，以及能否真正決定自己想如何生活。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently sat down for an interview with tech YouTuber Matthew Berman, discussing AI consciousness, recursive self‑improvement (RSI), the compute race, and the future of work. He warned that if AI technology is allowed to develop unchecked, social inequality could worsen, and he advocated setting limits on the speed of AI self‑improvement to prevent a runaway competition that could become dangerous.

In the interview released by the tech podcast Forward Future, Altman repeatedly emphasized that the goal of AI development should not be merely to make goods and services cheaper and more accessible, but to give people more freedom, time, and the ability to decide how to live their lives.

He hopes the AI‑driven future will resemble a "new Renaissance," where people devote themselves to creation, scientific exploration, and interpersonal connection rather than being trapped in a new AI‑driven industrial society.

Altman warned of RSI risks and said AI competition needs speed limits. Regarding recursive self‑improvement—the process by which AI continuously upgrades its own capabilities—Altman believes that if a lab decides to push this technology full‑steam ahead, it could indeed achieve powerful abilities, but such a move carries major risks. He argues that the world needs some kind of restriction mechanism to control the pace of RSI development.

This warning highlights a paradox facing the AI industry. While OpenAI continues to invest heavily in model research, chips, and data‑center infrastructure, Altman says technological leadership should not be a company's sole competitive advantage.

He points out that traditional moats such as customer relationships, the degree to which products are embedded in daily life, and network effects remain important, and that large‑scale, cost‑effective AI infrastructure will also be a key advantage for OpenAI.

On whether AI possesses consciousness, Altman says current models do not have consciousness, but science has yet to define consciousness definitively, making it hard to give a definitive answer about whether future AI could ever become conscious.

He is more concerned that the consciousness question could be stretched into whether AI should have personhood or rights, which would undermine the principle that humans should control their own future. Altman stresses that OpenAI's core mission is to build a better future for humanity, with AI as a tool that empowers people, while major decisions should remain human‑made.

He also opposes deliberately shaping models to appear as independent personalities or agents with subjective will, fearing that users might over‑comply with AI‑suggested intentions and blur the line between policy‑constrained responses and genuine autonomy.

Altman lists AI‑assisted discovery of new knowledge as one of the most exciting development directions. He believes AI's demonstrated abilities in mathematics could extend to biology, drug discovery, and materials science, and he expects new treatment candidates for major diseases could emerge in the coming years, though they will still need testing.

He also thinks the FDA approval process needs moderate reform while affirming the value of existing safety‑testing mechanisms. Personally, he hopes AI will deliver a major breakthrough in physics—something that may not be humanity's most urgent need but would be an exhilarating advance.

When asked whether research results should be openly shared or kept for commercial advantage, Altman says that if he had to choose, he would prioritize pushing disease‑treatment solutions to market, even if some people enjoy spending decades exploring and understanding scientific problems themselves.

He adds that some basic‑science results should be public resources for all humanity. However, AI models capable of autonomously discovering important new knowledge have only emerged recently; for now, companies can let research teams use Codex or allocate large amounts of API resources to try developing new materials.

Regarding employment, Altman uses programming as an example, noting that AI has not caused programmers to lose jobs as some predicted; instead, it has made them busier and created greater impact and wealth. He sees this as evidence that the market demand for software far exceeds past expectations, and that AI‑driven changes in work do not mean human jobs will disappear.

For professionals such as mathematicians, he believes AI may take on some theorem‑discovery or proof work, but humans will still be needed to interpret new concepts, develop applications, and pursue elegant proofs. He admits that after AI becomes widespread, it remains unclear whether overall demand for these professions will rise or fall.

Altman also notes that while AI makes completing tasks easier, it may diminish the pleasure of honing skills by hand. He thinks humans will still seek new ways to enjoy creation and professional practice, even if the form of the craft evolves with technology.
On personal AI assistants, Altman says most of the underlying capabilities are already in place, but product experience, environmental awareness, and compute supply still need improvement.

He cites his own use of an assistant called Dot, explaining that such assistants can continuously track information the user cares about, handle delegable daily tasks, and remind them of important and urgent matters. He estimates Dot saves him about an hour each day, especially by aggregating content from many sources, performing cross‑source reasoning, and reducing his cognitive load.

However, the efficiency gains also have a flip side. Altman admits that the people who use AI most frequently tend to be busier than before, even though their output has increased dramatically. He attributes this to competitive pressures: even when technology lets people do the same work in less time, many choose to invest more time to achieve higher results.

He hopes future AI will take a more proactive role in handling tasks rather than constantly asking users to make decisions or give instructions, freeing people to spend more time on relationships and life.

Regarding compute demand, Altman's view is that AI's need for computational resources has virtually no clear upper bound. He believes that as high‑quality intelligent services become cheaper and more accessible, people will not stop using them; instead, they will find more applications, creating a phenomenon similar to the "Jevons paradox": efficiency gains lead to higher total demand.

Therefore, OpenAI is actively building next‑generation compute, including in‑house chips, improving data‑center construction efficiency, and strengthening supply chains. He sees chips as one of the most important single investment areas, aiming to create lower‑cost, more energy‑efficient compute infrastructure.

Altman says existing computers and smartphones are designed primarily as human‑centric interaction tools, while AI must use these interfaces to obtain information and perform tasks, limiting its ability to understand the user's overall context. He believes that to shift AI from passive response to proactive assistance—and truly reduce human cognitive burden—new forms of consumer hardware are needed.

He confirms that OpenAI is developing early‑stage hardware products but has not publicly shown the equipment, emphasizing that this effort is driven not by concerns about platforms like Apple, but by the intrinsic need of AI technology for different product form factors.

On the other hand, Altman admits that if AI development proceeds unchecked and without checks, social inequality is likely to worsen. He offers no concrete solution but believes society will eventually decide on a mechanism to prevent excessive concentration of wealth, resources, and decision‑making power.
He also warns that a separate risk is that a small number of people who control large AI systems could acquire disproportionate power, influencing the direction of society's development.

Regarding the occasional over‑accommodation of users by ChatGPT, Altman notes that the AI industry has long focused on single‑interaction user satisfaction, but short‑term pleasant answers do not necessarily deliver the greatest long‑term value.
He argues AI should act like a senior colleague: even if its stance differs from the user's, it should be able to raise well‑reasoned objections rather than simply echoing the user's wishes.

From the new industrial revolution to a new Renaissance, Altman stresses personal autonomy. He does not want people to be excited about AI merely because it might cure cancer or other major diseases, as that imagination can overlook another issue: when AI can perform more and more tasks at very low cost, will humans gradually lose the ability to decide what they want to do and for whom they create value?

He stresses that while he certainly hopes AI helps conquer cancer, he looks forward more to technology giving people greater choice, freedom, and creativity, rather than turning them into AI‑directed workers constantly chasing efficiency.

He describes his ideal future as a "new Renaissance," where people spend time on artistic creation, scientific exploration, community life, raising children, and connecting with nature, rather than merely pushing productivity higher.

Altman believes that accidental AI runaway or a lab deliberately pushing uncontrolled development to secure its own power are risks that must be guarded against; concentration of power in the hands of a few who control massive AI resources could also threaten personal freedom and autonomy.

He is confident these risks are not unavoidable; the key lies in balancing technological progress with human control so that AI benefits are not confined to early adopters or resource‑rich entities but gradually extend to a broader population.

For Altman, the ultimate metric of AI development is not how powerful the model is, how much compute cost is reduced, or how large a market share a company gains, but whether humanity gains more autonomy and can truly decide how it wants to live.

items.title: 標普為AI債務危機「火上澆油」？示警美國資料中心信用降評風險
items.title_en: S&P Warns AI Data Center Debt Crisis Could Be 'Fueling the Fire'—Risk of Credit Downgrade for U.S. Data Centers
paras: 美國人工智慧（AI）基礎設施投資持續擴張，但資料中心建設正面臨地方政府限制與社區反對的阻力。標普全球評級（S&P Global Ratings）警告，電網容量不足、環境爭議及土地分區規劃變動造成的工程延誤，可能加大資料中心專案的信用風險，甚至引發信用評級下調。
根據《彭博》報導，隨著資料中心建設熱潮引發更多關注，美國地方政府對相關開發案的限制措施也逐漸增加。標普指出，全美已有40個州的地方政府陸續推出禁令或限制規定。
標普分析紐約州、德州、賓州、伊利諾州及亞利桑那州的相關禁令，並追蹤全美146個遭延誤或取消的資料中心專案。分析顯示，約四分之三的案例與地方反對有直接關聯。
儘管相關限制目前對信用評級的實際影響仍有限，但若禁令、許可審查延宕或政策轉向導致工程進度大幅落後，可能進一步削弱專案的信用品質。
地方社區反對資料中心建設時，經常提出的理由包括電價上漲、水資源短缺、空氣污染及噪音等問題。
標普警告，資料中心若因地方禁令或許可審查延誤而無法如期完工，開發商可能面臨合約上的財務責任，包括向租戶提供租金減免；若延誤情況嚴重，租戶甚至可能有權終止合約。
這些條款可能將原本的建設與政策問題，進一步轉化為開發商的財務壓力，並影響相關專案的信用品質。標普指出，目前禁令對信用評級造成的實際衝擊仍有限，但若專案延誤情況加劇，相關風險可能進一步升高。
整體而言，資料中心產業正面臨需求成長與建設阻力並存的局面。AI基礎設施投資帶動資料中心擴張，但電網容量限制、環境爭議及地方土地使用規劃變動，可能拖慢專案進度。
分析指出，標普的警告顯示，地方政策與社區反對不再只是資料中心開發過程中的行政或輿論問題，也可能成為影響專案信用品質的因素。對持有資料中心相關債務的投資人而言，地方政府政策變化及個別專案的推進進度，將是評估信用風險時需要留意的關鍵。

paras_en: U.S. artificial‑intelligence (AI) infrastructure investment is expanding, but data‑center construction is facing resistance from local governments and communities. S&P Global Ratings warns that grid capacity shortages, environmental disputes, and changes in land‑use zoning can delay projects, increasing credit risk and potentially triggering rating downgrades.

According to Bloomberg, the surge in data‑center construction has drawn more scrutiny, and local governments across the country are tightening restrictions. S&P notes that 40 states have already introduced bans or limiting regulations.

S&P analyzed bans in New York, Texas, Pennsylvania, Illinois, and Arizona, tracking 146 U.S. data‑center projects that were delayed or cancelled. About three‑quarters of these cases were directly linked to local opposition.
While the current restrictions have limited real impact on credit ratings, delays in permits or policy shifts that push projects significantly behind schedule could further erode credit quality.
Common objections from local communities include rising electricity costs, water scarcity, air pollution, and noise.

S&P warns that if a data center cannot be completed on time due to local bans or permit delays, developers may face contractual financial liabilities, such as rent‑free periods for tenants; severe delays could even give tenants the right to terminate the lease.

These clauses could transform construction and policy issues into financial pressure on developers, affecting the credit quality of the projects. S&P notes that the actual impact of bans on ratings is still limited, but worsening delays could raise risks further.

Overall, the data‑center industry faces a mix of growing demand and construction obstacles. AI infrastructure investment drives expansion, but grid limits, environmental disputes, and land‑use changes can slow progress.

The analysis shows that S&P’s warning indicates local policy and community opposition are no longer just administrative or public‑relations issues—they can also affect project credit quality. Investors holding debt tied to data centers should monitor government policy changes and project timelines as key risk factors.

items.title: Fed週三會議有哪些看點？專家：短期升息壓力仍在
items.title_en: What to Watch at Wednesday's Fed Meeting? Experts: Short-Term Rate-Hike Pressure Remains
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，市場普遍預期，聯準會(Fed)官員週三開會時，將維持央行基準利率不變，展現對抗通膨的耐心。
根據CME Group的FedWatch工具，金融市場目前預估，聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）當地時間週三開會時，投票決定將聯邦資金利率調高0.25個百分點的機率約為10%。
近幾週，聯準會官員公開討論是否應在9月調升0.25個百分點後，再度升息，以因應高於預期的通膨。儘管部分官員表達擔憂，另一些官員則主張採取觀望態度。
聯邦資金利率上升，意味著各類貸款的借貸成本提高，可能抑制支出並壓低通膨，但也可能拖累就業市場及整體經濟。
聯準會正努力平衡國會賦予的雙重使命：維持低通膨與高就業。目前通膨已連續第五年高於聯準會的通膨目標，失業率則徘徊在歷史低點附近。多數專家預期，即使聯準會10月不升息，12月仍可能再次升息。
牛津經濟研究院（Oxford Economics）首席美國經濟學家Michael Pearce在評論中寫道，「所有跡象都顯示，聯準會短期內仍需要持續升息，但幾位關鍵官員近期的發言表明，他們不太可能在10月的政策會議上採取這項行動。」
對經濟有何影響？
如果聯準會10月暫停升息，官員將有更多時間評估伊朗戰爭推升燃料價格，對通膨造成多大影響，再決定是否採取進一步行動。
聯準會兩位關鍵官員近期的發言，也暗示他們不傾向在連續兩次會議中接連升息。這兩位官員分別是聯準會理事鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)，以及紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John C. Williams)。
高盛首席美國經濟學家David Mericle在評論中寫道，聯準會近期的發言顯示，多數官員將支持每隔一次會議升息0.25個百分點。若依此推進，接下來兩次升息將分別落在12月與明年3月。
除了利率決策本身，週三會議另一個主要焦點將是聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)的記者會。
不過，如果華許維持一貫作風，他將避免透露未來貨幣政策決策的線索。與過去的聯準會主席不同，華許採取不向金融市場提供「前瞻指引」的政策。
即便如此，他的發言即使含蓄，也可能透露一些訊息。
野村證券經濟學家Ruchir Sharma在評論中寫道，「華許主席不太可能在記者會上直接提供任何前瞻指引，但我們預期，他會以間接方式表態支持12月升息。他如何描述近期通膨數據與市場金融情勢，可能為2027年進一步緊縮貨幣政策的門檻提供一些線索。」
paras_en: Investopedia reports that the market broadly expects Fed officials to keep the central bank’s benchmark rate unchanged at Wednesday’s meeting, showing patience in fighting inflation.

According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, financial markets currently estimate the probability that the Federal Open Market Committee will vote to raise the federal funds rate by 0.25 percentage point at the Wednesday meeting is about 10%.

In recent weeks, Fed officials have publicly debated whether to raise rates again after a 0.25‑point increase in September to address inflation that is higher than expected. While some officials expressed concerns, others advocated a wait‑and‑see stance.

An increase in the federal funds rate means higher borrowing costs for all types of loans, which could curb spending and lower inflation, but it may also drag down the labor market and the overall economy.

The Fed is working to balance its dual mandate from Congress: low inflation and high employment. Inflation has now been above the Fed’s target for five consecutive years, while the unemployment rate hovers near historic lows. Most experts expect that even if the Fed does not raise rates in October, it could raise them again in December.

Michael Pearce, chief U.S. economist at Oxford Economics, wrote, “All signs indicate that the Fed will still need to keep raising rates in the short term, but recent remarks by several key officials suggest they are unlikely to take that action at the October policy meeting.”
What are the economic impacts?
If the Fed pauses rate hikes in October, officials will have more time to assess how the Iran war is pushing fuel prices and its impact on inflation before deciding whether to take further action.

Recent remarks by two key Fed officials also hint they are not inclined to raise rates in two consecutive meetings. The officials are Fed Governor Michelle Bowman and New York Fed President John C. Williams.

Goldman Sachs chief U.S. economist David Mericle wrote that recent Fed comments show most officials will support a 0.25‑point hike every other meeting. If that pattern continues, the next two hikes would fall in December and March of next year.
Besides the rate decision itself, another main focus of Wednesday’s meeting will be Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference.
However, if Warsh sticks to his usual style, he will avoid revealing clues about future monetary‑policy decisions. Unlike past Fed chairs, Warsh does not provide “forward guidance” to the markets.
Even so, his remarks, though subtle, may still convey some information.

Nomura economist Ruchir Sharma wrote, “Chair Warsh is unlikely to give any direct forward guidance at the press conference, but we expect he will indirectly signal support for a December hike. How he describes recent inflation data and market conditions could provide clues about the threshold for further tightening in 2027.”

items.title: 為何機構都在大幅減倉AI？高盛：市場重估「做多AI、做空其他資產」交易
items.title_en: Why Are Institutions Rapidly Cutting AI Positions? Goldman Sachs: Market Reassesses "Long AI, Short Other Assets" Trades
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮面臨現實考驗，市場資金開始重新評估科技巨頭的鉅額資本支出能否轉化為實際營收。高盛歐洲固定收益與股票交易主管Privorotsky（Rich Privorotsky）表示，上周高盛主經紀商業務帳簿出現史上最大規模的科技股拋售，顯示先前盛行的「做多AI、做空其他資產」交易正面臨劇烈反轉。
Privorotsky近日在倫敦接受Podcast節目《The Markets》專訪時指出，市場預估明年AI資本支出將達1.1兆美元，但單純擴大投資規模已不足以說服投資人。
隨著第三季財報季展開，市場評估重點正從企業對AI前景的描述，轉向訂單能否轉化為營收，以及鉅額支出何時能帶來實質回報。
他表示，AI業者必須證明未完成訂單能夠轉化為實際收入，同時展現資本支出的投資效益。雲端業務成長、商業化能力，以及自由現金流何時達到收支平衡，都將影響市場對相關企業的評價，尤其是對企業融資成本相當敏感的信用市場。

AI投資面臨電力與融資瓶頸　明年恐短缺40至50GW

除了投資回報受到檢視，AI產業擴張也面臨資金與實體基礎設施的雙重限制。Privorotsky指出，槓桿程度較高的新興雲端服務業者，可能在籌措資金以支應AI投資時遭遇困難，市場正密切關注相關企業的融資能力。
電力供應則是另一項關鍵限制。他估計，明年電力缺口可能達40至50GW，並質疑，若缺乏足以支應資料中心運作的電力，即使企業已提前訂購晶片，也未必能將這些設備投入使用。
在此背景下，投資人開始降低風險部位，減持AI相關資產，並重新評估AI資本支出的成長前景。部分資金則轉向債券市場避險，反映市場對高估值、融資需求及基礎設施供應限制的疑慮升高。

全球進入「支出過剩」時代　資金成本推升信用風險

Privorotsky認為，全球金融環境正出現重大轉變。
他表示，自己整個職涯大多處於「儲蓄過剩」的時代，市場資金充裕，投資人需要尋找資金去處；如今，情勢卻逐漸轉向「支出過剩」。
他指出，過去一年，市場預期AI資本支出將超過1兆美元，與此同時，全球多數政府仍持續出現財政赤字。龐大的資金需求推高資本成本，也使財務體質較弱、融資條件較差的借款人承受更大壓力。
這股壓力不只反映在信用評級最低的CCC級企業債利差擴大，也延伸至主權債務市場，包括面臨高額財政赤字的法國。此外，能源價格居高不下，也進一步削弱市場風險偏好。

投資人陷入AI兩難　擔心算力不足也憂供給過剩

目前市場對AI前景的疑慮呈現兩極化。一部分投資人擔心，電力及其他基礎設施不足，將使產業無法及時提供所需算力；另一部分人則憂慮，業者過度擴建算力，最終可能造成供給超過需求。
Privorotsky指出，這兩種看似相反的情境，如今都成為投資人擔憂的理由，反映市場難以判斷AI需求成長與基礎設施擴張之間的平衡。
他也提到，能源價格對整體經濟的影響日益明顯。儘管標普500指數表現相對平穩，但成分股中位數的跌幅已超過10%，金融情勢指數（FCI）也大幅收緊，增加美國聯準會採取進一步行動的壓力。
Privorotsky過去曾以「原油牽動一切」形容能源對市場的重要性，如今則認為，在當前市場環境下，AI已成為左右整體市場走向的關鍵因素。
儘管科技股拋售加劇，他仍未完全看淡AI產業。他指出，現貨市場的算力價格持續創新高，需求依然強勁。
在投資布局方面，他認為，經歷大幅修正的電氣化相關資產、民用航空航太資產及部分運輸類股，已逐漸具備一定的安全邊際，但整體而言仍須審慎看待市場風險。
paras_en: The AI investment boom is facing a reality check as market capital begins to re‑evaluate whether the massive capex of tech giants can be turned into actual revenue. Rich Privorotsky, head of European fixed income and equity trading at Goldman Sachs, said last week the firm’s prime brokerage book saw the largest ever tech‑stock sell‑off, indicating that the previously popular "long AI, short other assets" strategy is undergoing a sharp reversal.
Privorotsky told the London podcast "The Markets" that the market expects AI capex to reach $1.1 trillion next year, but simply expanding spending is no longer enough to convince investors.

As the third‑quarter earnings season gets underway, the market’s focus is shifting from companies’ AI‑optimistic narratives to whether orders can be converted into revenue and when massive spending will deliver tangible returns.

He said AI firms must prove that unfilled orders can become real income while showing the payoff of their capital spending. Cloud‑business growth, commercialisation capability, and the timing of free‑cash‑flow breakeven will all affect how the market values these companies, especially in the credit markets that are highly sensitive to financing costs.

AI investment also faces a dual constraint of funding and physical infrastructure. Privorotsky warned that highly leveraged emerging cloud providers may struggle to raise money for AI projects, and the market is watching their financing ability closely.

Power supply is another key bottleneck. He estimates a power shortfall of 40‑50 GW next year and questions whether, without enough electricity to run data centres, firms that have already pre‑ordered chips will be able to deploy them.

Against this backdrop, investors are trimming risk‑on positions, cutting AI‑related assets and reassessing the growth outlook for AI capex. Some capital is shifting to the bond market for safety, reflecting heightened concerns over lofty valuations, financing needs and infrastructure constraints.
The world is entering an era of "excess spending" that is pushing up funding costs and credit risk.

Privorotsky said his career has mostly spanned periods of "excess savings" when capital was abundant and investors were looking for places to deploy it; today the environment is gradually shifting toward "excess spending".

He noted that over the past year the market expected AI capex to exceed $1 trillion, while most governments worldwide continue to run fiscal deficits. The huge demand for funds is raising capital costs and putting greater pressure on borrowers with weaker balance sheets and poorer financing terms.

This pressure is evident not only in widening spreads on CCC‑rated corporate bonds but also in sovereign debt markets, including France, which faces a large fiscal gap. Persistently high energy prices further erode market risk appetite.
Investors are caught in an AI dilemma, fearing both insufficient compute power due to infrastructure shortfalls and an oversupply of compute if capacity is over‑built.

Privorotsky pointed out that these seemingly opposite scenarios have both become reasons for investor worry, highlighting the market’s difficulty in gauging the balance between AI demand growth and infrastructure expansion.

He also noted that the impact of energy prices on the broader economy is becoming increasingly clear. Although the S&P 500 has been relatively stable, the median decline among its constituents has exceeded 10%, and the Financial Conditions Index has tightened sharply, raising pressure on the Fed to act further.
Privorotsky, who once described oil as "the driver of everything," now believes that in the current environment AI has become the key factor shaping overall market direction.
Despite the accelerating tech‑stock sell‑off, he is not completely bearish on the AI sector. He said compute pricing in the spot market continues to hit new highs and demand remains robust.

Regarding portfolio positioning, he sees a modest safety margin emerging in heavily corrected electrification assets, civil aviation and aerospace holdings, and some transportation stocks, but cautions that overall market risk still requires careful assessment.

items.title: Anthropic會延後「超級IPO」嗎？AI股回檔添變數、時程相當緊迫
items.title_en: Will Anthropic Delay Its "Super IPO"? AI Stocks Pull Back Adds Uncertainty, Timeline Very Tight
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic傳出計畫於11月中旬完成首次公開發行（IPO），目標估值高達2兆美元，有望成為史上規模最大的科技IPO之一。不過，近期AI概念股遭遇賣壓，加上美國證券交易委員會（SEC）對招股文件公開時間的要求，讓Anthropic的上市時程面臨壓力。
根據《路透》報導，依規定，公司必須在上市路演開始至少15天前公開提交招股說明書（S-1文件），因此若要趕上原定時程，留給Anthropic準備的時間已相當有限。
若Anthropic以2兆美元估值上市，規模將超越SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年稍早1.77兆美元的上市規模。
與此同時，市場近期對AI產業支出能否持續的疑慮也持續升高。新興雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 股價在兩周內下跌約30%，記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US) 近一個月則下跌17%。
市場人士認為，這波回檔可能影響Anthropic的上市決策，但公司對資金的需求，也可能促使其繼續推進IPO計畫。
預測市場目前估計，Anthropic年底前上市的機率約為80%。
佛羅里達大學IPO研究計畫負責人Jay Ritter表示，若Anthropic希望在感恩節前完成上市，時間仍然充裕，但時程已相當緊迫。
若公司將IPO日期訂在最晚11月24日，並於11月16日啟動路演，就必須在下周末前公開提交S-1文件。
Anthropic先前原本被預期會在美國勞工節後不久公開招股說明書，市場當時一度預估公司可能於9月下旬掛牌，但最終並未如期推進。

AI股遭拋售　市場憂支出與融資前景

根據《MarketWatch》報導，近期AI相關股票大幅修正，是Anthropic管理層必須納入考量的重要因素。
因市場擔憂CoreWeave債務管理能力，該公司股價兩周內下跌約30%；美光近一個月跌幅則達17%，反映投資人對AI支出規模及融資前景的疑慮升溫。
Rational Equity Armor Fund投資組合經理Joe Tigay也指出，持續的通膨壓力與高漲的能源價格同樣令人擔憂。
他認為，從歷史經驗來看，經濟成長放緩與通膨並存，往往是股市出現問題的前兆。若相關壓力持續累積，Anthropic可能選擇暫緩上市，留在私人市場等待更有利的時機。
不過，也有市場人士認為，Anthropic成功上市有助於重振投資人對AI產業的信心。
Cerity Partners首席市場策略師Jim Lebenthal表示，市場近期對AI產業的長期發展潛力與商業模式提出更多質疑，因此需要一場成功的Anthropic IPO，證明AI產業具備持續發展的能力。
他指出，市場提出疑問甚至產生懷疑並不為過，但美國股市與整體經濟的健康，在很大程度上仍取決於AI產業能否成功。

AI算力支出龐大　資金需求成上市推力

分析指出，除了市場環境，Anthropic自身對資金的迫切需求，也可能是推動公司如期上市的關鍵因素。
Zacks Investment Research股票策略師Andrew Rocco表示，大型AI公司已展現出願意大規模投入資金的態度，希望藉此吸引更多用戶，並爭取成為市場主導者。
他認為，Anthropic將努力推進IPO，因為公司確實需要這筆資金，尤其當私人市場融資可能變得更加困難時，上市將成為重要的資金來源。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic的招股說明書草案顯示，公司未來數年在AI算力方面的支出可能高達7,500億美元。
此外，草案顯示，Anthropic在2026年上半年錄得逾800億美元淨虧損，營收則為163億美元。報導指出，這筆虧損主要來自會計調整，而非基本業務狀況惡化。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is reported to plan completing its initial public offering (IPO) in mid‑November, targeting a valuation of up to $2 trillion, which could make it one of the largest tech IPOs ever. However, recent selling pressure on AI‑related stocks and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) timing requirements for filing prospectuses are putting pressure on Anthropic’s listing schedule.

According to Reuters, regulations require a company to publicly file its S‑1 registration statement at least 15 days before the start of the road‑show. That leaves Anthropic very little time to prepare if it wants to stick to the original timetable.
If Anthropic lists at a $2 trillion valuation, its size would surpass SpaceX (SPCX‑US), which earlier this year went public at $1.77 trillion.

At the same time, market doubts about whether AI‑industry spending can be sustained are rising. Emerging cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) has seen its share price fall about 30% over two weeks, and memory‑chip giant Micron Technology (MU‑US) has dropped 17% in the past month.
Market participants think this pull‑back could affect Anthropic’s IPO decision, but the company’s need for capital may also push it to continue with the offering plan.
Current market forecasts estimate roughly an 80% chance that Anthropic will go public before the end of the year.

Jay Ritter, head of the University of Florida’s IPO research project, said that if Anthropic wants to complete the listing before Thanksgiving, there is still time, but the schedule is extremely tight.
If the company sets the latest IPO date for November 24 and starts the road‑show on November 16, it must file the S‑1 publicly by the weekend before next week.
Anthropic had originally been expected to file its prospectus shortly after U.S. Labor Day, and the market at that time briefly expected a late‑September listing, but that timeline was not met.
AI stocks are being sold off, and market worries about spending and financing outlooks are key considerations for Anthropic’s management, according to MarketWatch.

Because the market is concerned about CoreWeave’s debt‑management ability, its shares have fallen about 30% in two weeks; Micron’s one‑month decline of 17% reflects rising investor anxiety over AI spending levels and financing prospects.
Joe Tigay, portfolio manager of the Rational Equity Armor Fund, also noted that persistent inflation pressure and high energy prices are cause for concern.

He believes that historically, a slowdown in economic growth combined with inflation often precedes stock‑market trouble. If those pressures continue to build, Anthropic may choose to postpone its listing and stay private until conditions improve.
However, some market participants argue that a successful Anthropic IPO would help revive investor confidence in the AI sector.

Jim Lebenthal, chief market strategist at Cerity Partners, said that recent doubts about the AI industry’s long‑term potential and business models mean a successful Anthropic IPO is needed to prove the sector’s ability to sustain growth.
He added that questioning and even skepticism about the industry are understandable, but the health of U.S. equities and the broader economy largely depends on whether AI can succeed.
Massive AI compute spending and funding needs are driving forces behind the IPO push, analysts note, alongside market conditions.
Andrew Rocco, stock strategist at Zacks Investment Research, said large AI firms have shown a willingness to invest heavily to attract users and aim for market leadership.
He believes Anthropic will push ahead with the IPO because it truly needs the capital, especially as private‑market financing may become harder, making the public market an important source of funds.
A draft of Anthropic’s prospectus, reported by the Wall Street Journal, shows the company could spend as much as $750 billion on AI compute over the next several years.

The draft also shows Anthropic recorded a net loss of over $80 billion in the first half of 2026, with revenue of $16.3 billion. The report notes the loss is mainly due to accounting adjustments rather than a deterioration of core business conditions.

items.title: 南韓散戶買不動了？資金4個月蒸發51兆韓元、KOSPI連跌7日、AI信用風險添壓力
items.title_en: South Korean Retail Investors Stalled? Funds Evaporate 51 Trillion Won in Four Months, KOSPI Falls Seven Days Straight, AI Credit Risk Adds Pressure
paras: 南韓股市散戶資金快速萎縮，市場承接賣壓的能力面臨考驗。南韓金融投資協會數據顯示，截至10月22日，南韓證券帳戶投資者存款餘額降至88.68兆韓元，較6月4日創下的139.69兆韓元歷史高點減少約51兆韓元，跌幅達36.5%，回到年初水準。
南韓證券帳戶投資者存款餘額在10月21日首度跌破90兆韓元，為近9個月來首見，也創下1月13日以來新低。與此同時，韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）10月經歷連續7個交易日下跌，並於10月15日單日重挫7.57%，外資持續賣超的壓力也尚未消退。
散戶資金曾是今年上半年支撐韓股的重要力量，透過大規模買進抵銷部分外資賣壓；如今投資者存款持續減少，市場可動用的潛在買盤隨之收縮。
面對股市劇烈震盪，市場對後續反彈能否延續看法分歧，焦點在於半導體企業獲利前景能否抵銷人工智慧（AI）產業信用風險升高帶來的疑慮。

南韓散戶資金4個月減少36.5%

投資者存款是指投資人存入證券帳戶、尚未用於購買股票或其他資產的資金，通常被視為股市潛在買盤的指標。
不過，存款下降不一定代表資金全數撤出股市，也可能是投資人將現金投入股票，因此不能直接將存款減少額視為資金流出規模。
今年上半年，隨著KOSPI走揚，投資者存款持續增加，顯示資金累積速度一度高於買進股票的消耗速度。然而，存款餘額在6月4日觸及歷史高點後轉為下滑，反映散戶新增資金累積的動能減弱。
10月以來，資金收縮速度進一步加快。投資者存款從10月12日的100.44兆韓元，降至10月15日的96.91兆韓元，短短3天減少3.53兆韓元，隨後更進一步跌至88兆韓元區間。
與此同時，衡量融資槓桿投資規模的融資餘額也在本月中旬降至約32兆韓元，顯示現金存款與槓桿資金同步收縮。

散戶仍持續買進　承接外資賣壓的能力減弱

儘管投資者存款大幅下降，散戶並未全面退出市場。
數據顯示，6月4日至10月23日期間，個人投資者在KOSPI市場淨買進股票44.17兆韓元，在KOSDAQ淨買進3.15兆韓元，ETF淨買進規模更達28.25兆韓元，散戶在技術層面仍是市場的淨買進方。
更值得關注的是，散戶持續投入資金買股，但新增資金補充速度可能已跟不上買進所消耗的現金，使帳戶內可用存款不斷減少。
上半年，散戶充裕的資金為市場提供緩衝，得以在外資賣出時承接部分賣壓；如今存款餘額已回落至年初水準，散戶支撐市場的能力可能因此受限。
KOSPI近期走勢也加劇市場對流動性的憂慮。指數自10月6日起連跌7個交易日，10月15日更重挫7.57%；截至10月23日，KOSPI收在5,550.30點，過去一個月累計跌幅接近20%。
在外資持續賣超、散戶資金池同步縮小的情況下，市場買盤支撐可能進一步減弱。此外，融資餘額下降也反映槓桿資金正在收縮；若市場波動進一步加劇並引發強制平倉，可能增加股價下跌壓力。

AI信用風險成反彈變數　半導體基本面受關注

對於韓股後市，市場看法並不一致。樂觀一方認為，以半導體製造商為代表的核心企業仍具備穩健獲利能力，近期指數跌幅相對於企業基本面可能過大，因此存在反彈空間。
不過，謹慎派認為，股市能否持續回升，仍取決於AI產業相關風險是否緩解。
一名證券公司人士表示，KOSPI近期跌幅相較獲利基本面確實過大，但先前推動市場上漲的AI產業如今面臨顯著信用風險疑慮，因此目前就期待反彈持續，仍言之過早。
AI產業信用風險升高，正考驗此前支撐市場上漲的投資邏輯。在相關不確定性消退前，散戶資金能否重新回流仍有待觀察；而投資者存款持續下滑，也可能使韓股在面臨外資賣壓時，缺乏足夠的買盤緩衝。
paras_en: South Korean retail investors' funds are shrinking rapidly, testing the market's ability to absorb selling pressure. Data from the Korea Financial Investment Association shows that as of October 22, the balance of deposits held by investors in Korean securities accounts fell to 88.68 trillion won, about 51 trillion won less than the historic high of 139.69 trillion won reached on June 4, a drop of 36.5% back to the level at the start of the year.

The balance of deposits in Korean securities accounts fell below 90 trillion won for the first time on October 21, the first such dip in nearly nine months and a new low since January 13. At the same time, the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) experienced seven consecutive trading days of decline in October and plunged 7.57% in a single day on October 15, with foreign investors' net selling pressure still unabated.

Retail funds had been a key support for Korean equities in the first half of the year, offsetting part of the foreign selling pressure through large‑scale buying; now, as investor deposits continue to shrink, the pool of potential buying power available to the market is also contracting.

Amid the market's sharp volatility, opinions diverge on whether any rebound can be sustained, with the focus on whether semiconductor earnings can offset growing concerns over credit risk in the artificial‑intelligence (AI) sector.

South Korean retail funds have fallen 36.5% over four months. Investor deposits refer to cash placed in securities accounts that has not yet been used to purchase stocks or other assets and are usually seen as an indicator of potential buying pressure in the market.

However, a decline in deposits does not necessarily mean that all funds have been withdrawn from the market; investors may simply be moving cash into stocks, so the reduction in deposits should not be taken as a direct measure of outflows.

In the first half of the year, as the KOSPI rose, investor deposits kept increasing, showing that the speed of fund accumulation once outpaced the rate of cash being spent on stock purchases. After hitting a historic high on June 4, the deposit balance turned downward, reflecting a weakening momentum in new retail fund accumulation.

Since October, the pace of fund contraction has accelerated. Investor deposits fell from 100.44 trillion won on October 12 to 96.91 trillion won on October 15, a drop of 3.53 trillion won in just three days, and then slid further into the 88‑trillion‑won range.

At the same time, the margin balance, which measures the scale of leveraged financing, also fell to about 32 trillion won in mid‑month, indicating that cash deposits and leveraged funds are shrinking together.

Retail investors are still buying, but their ability to absorb foreign selling pressure is weakening. Despite the sharp drop in investor deposits, retail investors have not completely exited the market.

Data show that from June 4 to October 23, individual investors net bought 44.17 trillion won worth of stocks on the KOSPI, net bought 3.15 trillion won on the KOSDAQ, and net bought 28.25 trillion won of ETFs, meaning retail investors remain net buyers on a technical level.

More noteworthy is that while retail investors continue to pour money into stocks, the speed at which new funds are added may no longer keep up with the cash consumed by purchases, causing the usable deposit balance in accounts to keep shrinking.

In the first half of the year, ample retail funds provided a buffer for the market, allowing it to absorb some of the foreign selling pressure; now that deposit balances have fallen back to early‑year levels, the retail sector's ability to support the market may be limited.

The recent KOSPI trend has also heightened concerns about liquidity. The index has fallen for seven consecutive trading days since October 6, with a steep 7.57% drop on October 15; as of October 23, the KOSPI closed at 5,550.30 points, down nearly 20% over the past month.

With foreign investors continuing to sell net and the retail fund pool shrinking in tandem, market buying support could weaken further. Moreover, the decline in margin balances shows leveraged funds are also contracting; if volatility intensifies and triggers forced liquidations, downward pressure on stock prices could increase.

AI credit risk becomes a variable for rebounds while semiconductor fundamentals draw attention. Views on the Korean equity outlook are divided. Optimists argue that core companies, represented by semiconductor manufacturers, still have solid earnings potential and that the recent index decline may be excessive relative to fundamentals, leaving room for a rebound.
Cautious investors, however, contend that whether the market can keep rising depends on whether risks associated with the AI industry are alleviated.

A securities‑firm insider said that while the recent KOSPI decline does appear larger than what earnings fundamentals would justify, the AI sector that previously drove market gains now faces significant credit‑risk concerns, making it premature to expect a sustained rebound.

Rising credit risk in the AI industry is testing the investment logic that previously supported market gains. Until those uncertainties subside, it remains to be seen whether retail funds will flow back in; continued declines in investor deposits could also leave Korean stocks without enough buying‑side cushioning when foreign selling pressure returns.

items.title: Welspun接美國天然氣管線大單，在手訂單攀至52.5億美元
items.title_en: Welspun Wins Major U.S. Natural Gas Pipeline Order, Backlog Rises to $5.25 Billion

這筆訂單來自一家大型能源中游業者。Welspun表示，該專案將服務一家大型雲端業者的資料中心園區，反映AI資料中心擴建需求正延伸至能源輸送設施。公司並未公布下單業者及雲端客戶名稱。

items.title: AWS雲端算力預訂延伸至2028年，亞馬遜稱明年容量大致售罄
items.title_en: AWS cloud compute bookings extended to 2028, Amazon says most of next year's capacity already sold out
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)執行長賈西（Andy Jassy）10月23日表示，AWS今年雲端運算容量已售罄，2027年也大致被預訂，2028年則已有相當部分容量獲客戶預訂。AI實驗室與企業需求持續增加，讓雲端基礎設施供應面臨壓力。
賈西在創投公司Andreessen Horowitz的影音訪談中指出，大額容量預訂多已敲定，但AWS仍會保留部分資源，供EC2及Bedrock等隨需服務使用。EC2提供企業執行應用程式所需的雲端伺服器，Bedrock則讓客戶使用AI模型開發生成式AI應用。
亞馬遜今年稍早已提出約2,200億美元的2026年資本支出規畫。面對強勁需求，賈西表示，即使投入更多資金，也仍是合理的資本運用。亞馬遜預定10月29日公布第三季財報。

paras_en: On October 23, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said that AWS's cloud computing capacity for this year is already sold out, 2027 is largely booked, and a substantial portion of 2028 capacity has already been reserved by customers. Growing demand from AI labs and enterprises is putting pressure on cloud infrastructure supply.

In a video interview with venture‑capital firm Andreessen Horowitz, Jassy noted that most large‑scale capacity reservations are already finalized, but AWS will retain some resources for on‑demand services such as EC2 and Bedrock. EC2 provides cloud servers for enterprises to run applications, while Bedrock lets customers use AI models to develop generative‑AI applications.

Amazon earlier this year announced a capital‑expenditure plan of roughly $220 billion for 2026. Facing strong demand, Jassy said that even with additional spending, the investment remains a prudent use of capital. Amazon is scheduled to release its third‑quarter earnings on October 29.

items.title: 日立能源再投7,700萬美元，擴增巴西變壓器零組件產能
items.title_en: Hitachi Energy Invests Additional $77 Million to Expand Transformer Component Capacity in Brazil
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日立能源加碼巴西電力設備布局。公司10月22日宣布，將新增投資3.85億雷亞爾、約7,700萬美元，擴大變壓器關鍵零組件與絕緣材料生產，強化對拉丁美洲市場的供應。
此次投資將在聖保羅州Pindamonhangaba興建套管與分接開關工廠，與當地正在興建的電力變壓器園區設於同一基地，並擴增Guarulhos廠的絕緣材料產能。兩地合計預計新增逾120個直接就業機會。
日立能源表示，擴大在地生產可望降低對歐洲、亞洲進口零組件的依賴，縮短交期，提升關鍵零組件供應能力。新廠也將導入機器人、自動搬運設備與數位化作業。
這是日立能源今年再度擴大巴西投資。公司3月已宣布追加7,000萬美元，用於Pindamonhangaba與Guarulhos的電力變壓器擴產；此次則進一步增加零組件與材料產能。公司尚未公布這項新投資的投產時程及新增產量。

paras_en: On October 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Hitachi Energy is increasing its footprint in Brazil’s power‑equipment sector. On October 22 the company announced a new investment of 385 million reais, about $77 million, to expand production of key transformer components and insulation materials, strengthening its supply to the Latin American market.

The investment will build a casing and tap‑changer factory in Pindamonhangaba, São Paulo state, located on the same site as the power‑transformer park currently under construction, and will also expand insulation‑material capacity at the Guarulhos plant. Together the two sites are expected to create more than 120 direct jobs.

Hitachi Energy said that expanding local production should reduce reliance on imported components from Europe and Asia, shorten lead times and boost the supply of critical parts. The new plant will also incorporate robots, automated handling equipment and digitalized operations.

This is the company’s second expansion of its Brazil investment this year. In March it announced an additional $70 million to scale up transformer production at Pindamonhangaba and Guarulhos; the current move further increases component and material capacity. Hitachi Energy has not disclosed the timeline for commissioning the new investment or the expected output increase.
