items.title: AI股大跌使「這國」股市成避風港！表現大勝歐股
items.title_en: AI Stock Slump Turns This Country's Market into a Safe Haven, Outperforming European Shares
paras: 歐洲股市面臨借貸成本攀升、人工智慧（AI）投資交易疑慮及政治動盪等多重壓力，瑞士大型權值股卻逆勢走強，成為市場亮點。
根據《彭博》報導，追蹤瑞士20家規模最大、流動性最高企業的瑞士市場指數（SMI），本月上漲4.6%；相較之下，歐元區主要股市指數Euro Stoxx 50下跌3.2%。
瑞士指數領先近8個百分點，為2020年3月新冠疫情衝擊市場、投資人紛紛尋求避險以來，表現優於該歐元區指數的最大差距。
這波漲勢顯示，面對借貸成本上升、對人工智慧（AI）投資交易的疑慮，以及法國、西班牙等國的政治動盪，投資人正降低在歐洲市場承擔的風險。
瑞士股市的表現主要由市值最大的3家公司帶動。製藥商羅氏（Roche Holding AG）與諾華（Novartis AG）10月股價分別上漲12%及6.7%；全球最大食品公司雀巢（Nestlé SA）則上漲10%。這3家防禦型企業的股價漲幅，已貢獻瑞士市場指數本月全部的漲幅。
報導指出，瑞士股市走強，也反映歐洲市場整體轉向所謂的防禦型股票。這類企業的業績較不容易隨經濟景氣循環大幅波動。投資人目前偏好獲利能力強、資產負債表健全，且較不容易受到借貸成本上升影響的公司。
由於羅氏、諾華與雀巢合計占SMI近一半的指數權重，瑞士市場成為這波資金轉向的主要受益者之一。
EFG資產管理瑞士股票主管Damian Burkhardt表示：「投資人看好瑞士股票的防禦特性，也正積極尋找熱門AI交易以外的替代選擇。醫療保健類股先前是AI交易的資金來源，如今這種情況正在逆轉。」
美國銀行最新的基金經理人調查也顯示，市場對瑞士股票的情緒明顯改善。受訪者中，淨16%將瑞士列為最看好的歐洲股票市場。
瑞士指數中市值較小的成分股也同步上漲，其中香精香料製造商奇華頓（Givaudan SA）與皮膚科醫療公司高德美（Galderma Group AG）漲幅最大。另一方面，SMI本月僅有4檔成分股下跌，而且全數屬於景氣循環型企業。
這波表現反轉，發生在瑞士股市經歷一段低迷期之後。瑞士指數向來因能源與科技產業權重有限，未能充分受惠於今年表現突出的這兩大產業。
本十年以來，若以當地貨幣計算並納入股息，SMI累計報酬率為69%，表現不及累計報酬翻倍的Euro Stoxx 50。
此次反彈也反映投資人對瑞士指數成分企業2027年獲利成長加速的信心。根據彭博情報（Bloomberg Intelligence）彙整的數據，這些企業2027年獲利成長率預估將達10%，接近今年預期增幅的兩倍。
不過，檢視SMI估值後，也不免令人質疑這波漲勢還能持續多遠。近期股價上漲已使指數估值重回過去十年來可視為偏貴的區間；無論從絕對估值來看，還是相較於Euro Stoxx 50，瑞士股市目前都顯得昂貴。相對於Euro Stoxx 50，SMI的估值更來到近兩年高點。
瑞郎走弱，也改善了瑞士出口導向型大型企業的獲利展望。目前瑞郎兌美元匯率已回落至2025年上半年曾見的水準。
過去7個月，瑞郎兌歐元也走貶；不過，由於交易人士尋求避險，以防範歐元區、尤其是法國的政治緊張局勢，本月瑞郎已收復部分跌幅。
瑞士寶盛銀行（Bank J. Safra Sarasin）股票策略師Wolf von Rotberg表示，利率、美元走勢及總體經濟景氣動能見頂，通常是影響瑞士股市表現的關鍵因素。他本月已將瑞士股市評等調升至「優於大盤」。
他指出：「這三項因素近期都對SMI有利。月初總體經濟動能開始轉弱，當時美國總體經濟動能已觸頂，為先前遭到重挫的瑞士股票反彈創造了理想環境。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: European stock markets are under multiple pressures, including rising borrowing costs, doubts over AI investment trading, and political turmoil, while large-cap Swiss stocks are moving higher against the trend, becoming a market highlight.

According to Bloomberg, the Swiss Market Index (SMI), which tracks the 20 largest and most liquid Swiss companies, rose 4.6% this month; by contrast, the Euro Stoxx 50, the main Euro‑area equity index, fell 3.2%.
The Swiss index leads by almost eight percentage points, marking the widest gap since March 2020 when the COVID‑19 pandemic hit markets and investors began seeking safe havens.

This rally shows that, faced with higher borrowing costs, concerns about AI‑driven trading, and political unrest in countries such as France and Spain, investors are reducing risk exposure in European markets.

The performance of the Swiss market is driven mainly by its three biggest companies. Pharmaceutical giants Roche Holding AG and Novartis AG saw their October shares rise 12% and 6.7% respectively, while the world’s largest food company Nestlé SA gained 10%. The gains of these three defensive stocks accounted for the entire monthly rise in the SMI.

The report notes that the strength of Swiss equities also reflects a broader shift in Europe toward defensive stocks, whose earnings are less prone to large swings with the economic cycle. Investors now favor companies with strong profitability, solid balance sheets, and lower sensitivity to rising borrowing costs.
Because Roche, Novartis and Nestlé together make up nearly half of the SMI’s weighting, the Swiss market has become one of the main beneficiaries of this capital rotation.

Damian Burkhardt, head of Swiss equities at EFG Asset Management, said: "Investors like the defensive nature of Swiss stocks and are actively looking for alternatives to the hot AI‑trading theme. Healthcare stocks were previously a source of AI‑trading capital, and that dynamic is now reversing."

A recent fund‑manager survey by Bank of America also shows sentiment toward Swiss equities has improved markedly, with a net 16% of respondents naming Switzerland as the most attractive European equity market.

Smaller‑cap constituents of the SMI also rose, led by fragrance maker Givaudan SA and dermatology company Galderma Group AG. By contrast, only four SMI components fell this month, all of which are cyclical firms.

This reversal comes after a period of weakness for Swiss equities. The Swiss index has traditionally not benefited much from the energy and technology sectors, which have been the year’s standout performers.

Over the past decade, when measured in local currency and including dividends, the SMI has delivered a cumulative return of 69%, lagging behind the Euro Stoxx 50, which has more than doubled its return.

The rebound also reflects investor confidence that earnings growth for SMI constituents will accelerate by 2027. Bloomberg Intelligence data project a 10% earnings growth rate for these companies in 2027, roughly twice the pace expected for this year.

However, a look at SMI valuations raises questions about how far the rally can continue. Recent price gains have pushed the index’s valuation back into a range that can be considered expensive by the past ten years’ standards; both on an absolute basis and relative to the Euro Stoxx 50, Swiss stocks now appear pricey. Compared with the Euro Stoxx 50, SMI valuation has risen to near a two‑year high.
A weaker franc has also improved profit outlooks for large export‑oriented Swiss firms. The franc‑to‑dollar rate has fallen back to levels last seen in the first half of 2025.

Over the past seven months the franc has also depreciated against the euro; however, as traders seek safe‑haven assets to hedge against political tension in the euro area, especially France, the franc has recovered part of its losses this month.

Wolf von Rotberg, stock strategist at Bank J. Safra Sarasin, said that interest rates, the dollar’s trajectory and the topping‑out of overall economic momentum are usually key drivers of Swiss equity performance. He upgraded his rating on Swiss stocks to "outperform" this month.

He added: "All three factors have recently been favorable for the SMI. At the start of the month, overall economic momentum began to weaken, and US economic momentum had already peaked, creating an ideal environment for the Swiss stocks that had previously been battered to rebound."
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication.)

items.title: SpaceX、中國競逐太空算力！全球市場2035年估達兆美元
items.title_en: SpaceX and China Race for Space Computing Power! Global Market Projected to Reach Trillions of Dollars by 2035
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）運算需求持續攀升，將算力基礎設施部署至太空，正成為全球科技業與資本市場競逐的新領域。SpaceX計畫自2028年起部署軌道AI運算衛星，利用太陽能緩解地面資料中心面臨的電力限制；中國業者也積極布局，目標在2030年打造萬卡級太空超級電腦中心。
根據《財富》報導，在10月22日於成都舉行的《財富》中國500強論壇上，太空算力及其應用前景成為討論焦點。中科天算董事長兼執行長劉垚圻表示，即使外界質疑太空算力可能形成泡沫，這項技術的核心意義仍在於拓展人類活動與科技發展的邊界。
劉垚圻指出，若能在太空實現通訊、導航、遙測及算力服務，將有助於推動全球算力資源更廣泛地普及。衛星、網際網路與遙測等資訊基礎設施，本身就具有實際需求；更具經濟價值的機會，則在於利用太空技術解決過去難以處理的問題。
根據報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年6月完成創紀錄的首次公開募股（IPO），並在招股書中揭示建設太空資料中心的構想，計畫從2028年起部署軌道AI運算衛星。
這項計畫希望運用太空中近乎不受限制的太陽能，突破地面資料中心受到電網容量與電力供應限制的瓶頸，並以每年部署100吉瓦（GW）太空算力為目標。
美國能源資訊署數據顯示，若持續運轉，支撐100GW算力所需的發電資源，相當於美國去年全年發電量的五分之一。
不過，太空算力的應用不只限於大型運算設施。劉垚圻認為，未來太空網路也可能直接服務一般消費者及小型企業。他以漁民尋找魚群為例，未來漁民或許能透過應用程式向衛星查詢鮪魚位置，進一步取得魚群方位、最佳下網時機，甚至市場銷售建議。
中科天算公布的「天算計畫」則設定在2030年打造萬卡級太空超算中心，為全球提供即時智慧空天資訊服務。
劉垚圻認為，中國開源、開放的技術生態將是實現這項目標的重要因素，也可能有助於相關服務獲得開發中國家及全球使用者的接受。

中國加速布局　太空算力朝實用化發展

太空算力也逐漸進入中國的基礎設施布局。報導指出，多家機構預測，到2035年，全球太空算力相關市場規模有望達到兆美元級別，中國也已將太空算力納入戰略性新型基礎設施的發展方向。
2025年，中國利用長征二號丁運載火箭，從酒泉衛星發射中心將首批12顆太空計算衛星送入軌道。報導稱，這個小型星座的算力已相當於微型地面計算中心，並標誌著全球首個實用化太空算力網路正式投入運行。
隨著太空算力逐步發展，太空與地面業務的整合也受到關注。馬斯克近日證實，特斯拉與SpaceX已就潛在合併事宜展開討論。他向投資人表示，雙方在AI軟體、晶片設計、機器人技術及通信連結等領域有所合作。
以最新收盤價計算，若兩家公司合併，可能形成估值高達3.5兆美元的企業。摩根士丹利近期報告則提出SpaceX企業AI業務的估值框架，估計SpaceX每新增1GW自有軌道算力，理論上可為股價增加約27美元，相當於當前股價約18%。
這也反映出，市場對AI算力的需求與供應焦慮，正逐漸轉化為投資人對未來軌道運算能力的估值。

技術與回報仍有不確定性　長期投資考驗耐心

儘管太空算力前景受到關注，相關發展仍面臨高額投入、建設週期長、技術難題及投資回報不確定等挑戰，距離大規模商業化仍有許多問題需要克服。
和暄資本總裁兼管理合夥人張夢涵在10月21日於成都舉行的2026年《財富》40U40創想會上表示，中國並非缺乏人才或資本，真正欠缺的往往是耐心。
張夢涵以馬斯克的創業經歷為例指出，許多企業決策從短期角度來看可能並不合理，但若將時間拉長至10年或20年，結果可能截然不同。
他認為，偉大企業在創立初期未必能清楚呈現商業模式；SpaceX目前主要依靠星鏈業務，未來AI算力、尤其是太空算力，也可能成為其重要的商業方向。
paras_en: As demand for artificial intelligence (AI) computing continues to climb, deploying compute infrastructure in space is becoming a new battleground for the global tech industry and capital markets. SpaceX plans to launch orbital AI computing satellites starting in 2028, using solar power to alleviate the electricity constraints faced by ground data centers; Chinese firms are also actively positioning themselves, aiming to build a ten‑thousand‑GPU‑class space super‑computer center by 2030.

According to a report by Fortune, the prospect of space computing and its applications was a focal point at the Fortune China 500 Forum held in Chengdu on October 22. Liu Yaodi, chairman and CEO of Zhongke Tiansuan, said that even if outsiders doubt that space computing could become a bubble, the core significance of the technology lies in expanding the boundaries of human activity and technological development.

Liu noted that achieving communications, navigation, telemetry and computing services in space would help spread global computing resources more broadly. Satellite, internet and telemetry infrastructures already have concrete demand; the greater economic value lies in using space technology to solve problems that were previously hard to tackle.

The report states that SpaceX (SPCX‑US) completed a record‑setting initial public offering in June this year and disclosed in its prospectus the concept of building a space data center, planning to deploy orbital AI computing satellites from 2028 onward.

The project aims to harness the virtually unlimited solar energy in space to break through the bottlenecks of grid capacity and power supply that limit ground data centers, targeting the deployment of 100 GW of space‑based computing power each year.

U.S. Energy Information Administration data show that sustaining 100 GW of computing power would require electricity equivalent to one‑fifth of the United States’ total electricity generation last year if operated continuously.

However, the applications of space computing are not limited to large‑scale facilities. Liu believes that future space networks could also serve ordinary consumers and small businesses directly. He cites fishermen searching for schools of fish as an example: in the future, they might use an app to query satellites for tuna locations, obtain the school’s position, optimal net‑dropping timing, and even market‑sale recommendations.

Zhongke Tiansuan’s announced “Tiansuan Project” sets a goal to build a ten‑thousand‑GPU‑class space super‑computer center by 2030, providing real‑time intelligent aerospace information services worldwide.
Liu says that China’s open‑source, open‑technology ecosystem will be a key factor in achieving this goal and could help related services gain acceptance among developing‑country and global users.

China Accelerates Its Layout – Space Computing Moves Toward Practical Use
Space computing is gradually becoming part of China’s infrastructure strategy. The report notes that several institutions forecast the global space‑computing market could reach a trillion‑dollar scale by 2035, and China has already incorporated space computing into its strategic new‑type infrastructure development agenda.

In 2025, China will use a Long March 2D‑D carrier rocket to launch the first batch of 12 space‑computing satellites from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The report says the small constellation’s computing power is comparable to a micro ground‑based computing center, marking the world’s first operational practical space‑computing network.

As space computing develops, the integration of space and ground businesses is drawing attention. Elon Musk recently confirmed that Tesla and SpaceX have begun discussions about a potential merger. He told investors that the two companies cooperate in AI software, chip design, robotics and communications linking.

Based on the latest closing prices, a merger could create an entity valued at up to $3.5 trillion. A recent Morgan Stanley report presented a valuation framework for SpaceX’s enterprise AI business, estimating that each additional 1 GW of proprietary orbital computing power could theoretically boost the stock price by about $27, roughly an 18% increase from the current price.
This reflects how market anxiety over AI compute supply and demand is gradually turning into investor valuation of future orbital computing capability.

Technology and Returns Remain Uncertain – Long‑Term Investment Tests Patience
Despite the attention on space computing’s prospects, development still faces high capital outlays, long construction cycles, technical challenges and uncertain investment returns, leaving many hurdles before large‑scale commercialization can be achieved.

Zhang Menghan, president and managing partner of He Xuan Capital, said at the 2026 Fortune 40U40 Innovation Forum in Chengdu on October 21 that China does not lack talent or capital; what it truly lacks is patience.

Citing Musk’s entrepreneurial journey, Zhang pointed out that many corporate decisions may seem unreasonable in the short term, but when stretched over ten or twenty years, the outcomes can be completely different.

He believes great companies may not clearly present a business model in their early stages; SpaceX currently relies mainly on its Starlink business, and in the future AI computing—especially space computing—could become another important commercial direction.

items.title: 咔嚓一聲！多位網友曬圖：iPhone Duo剛到手螢幕就裂開
items.title_en: Snap! Multiple Netizens Share Photos: iPhone Duo’s Screen Cracks as Soon as It’s Unboxed
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊機iPhone Duo 開售首日（10 月 23 日），在社交媒體上就開始流傳多張螢幕出現裂紋的照片，裂紋多沿摺疊線向螢幕中心延伸，並向右側邊緣出現一排疑似壞點，損壞形態較為相似。
一名澳洲用戶稱手機到手約6小時、開合不到20次，向朋友展示展開時先感到內鉸鏈下方異樣，隨後聽到清晰咔嚓聲，螢幕隨即沿鉸鏈裂開，螢幕表面與外部鉸鏈均無磕碰或夾痕，他前往Apple Store，蘋果直接為其更換故障機。
據《都市快報》周六（24日）報導，中國也有用戶說，正常展開螢幕時聽到咔嚓一聲，摺疊處出現一道約3釐米黑色豎裂痕，另有一條較細裂痕貫穿螢幕右半，而且目前已經出現多例類似損壞。
目前來看，應該是iPhone Duo鉸鏈出現一些問題，但規模不算大，有可能是裝配公差導致，而非設計問題，具體情況還有待後續觀察。
在iPhone Duo開售首日，蘋果同步上線官方自助維修手冊與配套支持文檔，覆蓋電池、螢幕、鏡頭、揚聲器、邏輯板、USB-C 接口等大量部件更換流程。
在配套官方支持文檔中，蘋果列出多種可能出現的狀況，包括裝置無法完全開合、開合時出現異常噪音、鉸鏈鬆動、鉸鏈彎曲或斷裂，以及外殼損壞影響鉸鏈使用等。蘋果建議用戶按照官方指引排查，必要時尋求售後支援。
如果蘋果售後檢測確認非人為導致，將會給用戶更換新機。如果是人為磕碰導致問題則要用戶自己付費維修。按照官網公示，未購買AppleCare+時螢幕損壞保外維修預估人民幣7,998元，購買後螢幕及意外損壞服務費為628元。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, on its first day of sales (October 23). On social media, numerous photos quickly surfaced showing screen cracks, many extending from the fold line toward the center of the display and a row of suspected dead pixels along the right edge, with a similar damage pattern across the reports.

An Australian user said the phone had been in his hands for about six hours and opened and closed fewer than 20 times. When he unfolded it for a friend, he first felt something abnormal under the inner hinge, then heard a clear “snap” and the screen cracked along the hinge. There were no impacts or dents on the screen surface or the external hinge. He went to an Apple Store, and Apple replaced the defective unit on the spot.

According to the Metro Daily on Saturday (the 24th), a user in China reported hearing a snap when the screen was opened normally, followed by a roughly 3‑centimeter black vertical crack at the fold, plus a finer crack running across the right half of the screen. Similar cases have already been reported.

At present it appears the iPhone Duo’s hinge may have some issues, but the problem is not widespread. It could be due to assembly tolerances rather than a design flaw, and the exact cause will need further observation.

On the iPhone Duo’s launch day, Apple simultaneously released an official self‑repair manual and supporting documentation covering replacement procedures for a wide range of components, including battery, screen, camera, speaker, logic board, USB‑C port, and more.

The official support documents list several possible conditions, such as the device not opening fully, abnormal noises during opening/closing, loose hinge, bent or broken hinge, and chassis damage affecting hinge operation. Apple advises users to follow the guidelines for troubleshooting and to seek after‑sales support when necessary.

If Apple’s after‑sales inspection confirms the issue was not caused by user action, the user will receive a replacement device. If the problem is due to accidental impact, the user must pay for the repair. According to Apple’s website, out‑of‑warranty screen repair costs RMB 7,998 without AppleCare+, while with AppleCare+ the screen and accidental damage service fee is RMB 628.

items.title: OpenAI奧特曼示警AI恐加劇貧富差距！籲限制自我進化速度
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Warns AI Could Widen Wealth Gap and Calls for Limits on Self‑Improvement Speed
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）近日接受科技YouTuber Matthew Berman專訪，談及人工智慧（AI）意識、遞迴自我改進（RSI）、算力競賽及未來工作型態。他警告，若任由AI技術自由發展，社會不平等可能進一步擴大，並主張對AI自我改進的速度設下限制，避免技術競爭演變成失控風險。
這場由科技Podcast Forward Future發布的訪談中，奧特曼多次強調，AI發展的目標不應只是讓商品與服務變得更便宜、更容易取得，而是讓人們擁有更多自由、時間與自主決定生活的能力。
他希望AI帶來的未來更接近一場「新文藝復興」，讓人們投入創作、科學探索與人際連結，而非陷入由AI驅動的新型工業化社會。

奧特曼警告RSI風險　AI競賽需要速度限制

談及遞迴自我改進（RSI），也就是AI持續改進自身能力的過程，奧特曼認為，若有實驗室決定全力推進這項技術，確實可能取得相關能力，但這麼做也伴隨重大風險。他主張，全球需要某種限制機制，控制RSI發展的速度。
這項警告也凸顯AI產業目前面臨的矛盾。OpenAI持續投入模型研發、晶片及資料中心等基礎設施，奧特曼卻認為，不能將技術領先視為企業唯一的競爭優勢。
他指出，客戶關係、產品融入日常生活的程度及網路效應等傳統護城河依然重要，而大規模且具成本效益的AI基礎設施，也將成為OpenAI的重要優勢。
對於AI是否具備意識，奧特曼表示，目前的模型並沒有意識，但科學界尚無法徹底界定意識的本質，因此也難以對未來的AI是否可能產生意識給出絕對答案。
他更擔心的是，意識問題被延伸為AI是否應擁有人格或權利，進而動搖人類應掌握自身未來的原則。奧特曼強調，OpenAI的核心目標始終是為人類打造更好的未來，AI應該是賦能人類的工具，重大決策仍應由人類做出。
他也反對刻意將模型塑造成具有獨立人格或主觀意志的存在，認為這可能使使用者過度順從AI看似具有的意願，混淆模型依照政策限制回答與真正擁有自主權之間的差異。

AI加速科學突破　但工作需求與成果分配仍有變數

奧特曼將AI協助人類發現新知識，列為最值得期待的發展方向之一。他認為，AI在數學領域展現的能力，有機會延伸至生物學、藥物研發及材料科學，並預期未來幾年可能出現針對重大疾病的新治療候選方案，但仍須經過測試。
他也認為，FDA的審批流程有必要適度改革，同時肯定現行安全測試機制的價值。至於個人最期待的突破，他希望AI能帶來一項重大的物理學發現，坦言這未必是人類最迫切需要的成果，卻會是非常令人振奮的進展。
談及研究成果應公開分享，還是保留商業競爭優勢，奧特曼明確表示，若能在兩者之間做出取捨，他會優先選擇推動疾病治療方案問世，即使有人更享受花上數十年親自探索、理解科學問題的過程。
他也指出，部分基礎科學成果理應成為全人類共享的公共資源。不過，能夠從頭到尾自主發現重要新知的AI模型，直到近期才開始出現；現階段，企業能採取的做法之一，是讓研究團隊運用Codex或投入大量API資源，嘗試開發新材料。
在就業方面，奧特曼以程式設計為例，指出AI並未如部分人士先前預測般，讓程式設計師失去工作，反而使他們更加忙碌，並創造更大的影響力與財富。他認為，這反映出市場對軟體的實際需求遠超過過去的想像，AI改變工作方式，不代表人類工作的需求必然消失。
至於數學家等專業工作者，他認為，AI可能接手部分定理發現或證明工作，但人類仍能參與解釋新概念、發展應用及追求優美證明等工作。不過，他坦言，AI普及後，相關職業的整體需求究竟會增加還是減少，目前仍難以判斷。
奧特曼也提到，AI雖然讓完成工作變得更容易，卻可能削弱人們親手磨練技藝的樂趣。他認為，人類仍會尋找新的方式享受創作與專業實踐，只是技藝的形式可能隨技術演進而改變。

個人AI助手每天省下一小時　算力需求仍看不到上限

談到個人AI助手，奧特曼表示，相關技術所需的多數基礎能力已經具備，接下來仍須改善產品體驗、環境感知能力及算力供應。
他以自己使用的Dot為例，指出這類助手可以持續掌握使用者關心的資訊、處理可委託的日常事務，並提醒重要且緊急的事項。他估計，Dot每天能為自己節省約一小時，尤其有助於從大量資訊來源中整理內容、進行跨來源推理，減少個人必須承擔的認知負擔。
然而，AI帶來的效率提升也有另一面。奧特曼承認，使用AI最頻繁的人，往往比過去更加忙碌，儘管他們的產出也大幅增加。他認為，這與人們身處競爭環境有關，即使技術讓人能以更少時間完成相同工作，許多人仍會選擇投入更多時間追求更高成果。
他希望未來的AI能更主動地處理任務，而不是不斷要求使用者做決定或提供指示，讓人們能將更多時間留給人際關係及生活。
對於算力需求，奧特曼的判斷是，AI所需的運算資源幾乎沒有明確上限。他認為，當高品質智慧服務變得更便宜、更容易取得，人們不會因此停止使用，反而會開發更多用途，形成類似「杰文斯悖論」的現象：資源使用效率提高，總需求卻可能持續增加。
因此，OpenAI正積極布局下一代算力，包括自研晶片、改善資料中心建置效率及供應鏈等。他將晶片視為最重要的單一投資方向之一，希望打造成本更低、能源效率更高的運算基礎設施。

AI硬體須突破人類介面限制　貧富差距恐進一步擴大

奧特曼表示，現有電腦與手機主要是為人類設計的互動工具，AI卻必須透過這些介面取得資訊、執行任務，限制了它理解使用者整體情境的能力。他認為，若要讓AI從被動回應轉向主動協助，並真正降低人類的認知負擔，就需要新的消費硬體形態。
他證實，OpenAI正在開發早期硬體產品，但未公開展示相關設備，並強調這項布局並非主要出於對蘋果等平台業者的擔憂，而是因為AI技術本身需要不同的產品形式。
另一方面，奧特曼坦言，如果任由AI發展而缺乏制衡，社會不平等很可能加劇。他沒有提出確切的解決方案，但認為社會最終將決定建立某種機制，避免財富、資源及決策權過度集中。
他也警告，另一項風險是少數掌握大量AI系統的人，可能取得過大的權力，進而影響整個社會的發展方向。
對於ChatGPT有時過度迎合使用者的問題，奧特曼則指出，AI產業長期偏重單次互動的使用者滿意度，但短期內讓人感到愉快的回答，不一定能在長期帶來最大價值。
他認為，AI應該像一位資深同事，即使立場與使用者不同，也能在有充分理由時直接提出異議，而不是一味附和。

從新工業革命轉向新文藝復興　奧特曼強調個人自主權

奧特曼表示，他不希望人們只因為AI可能治癒癌症等重大疾病而對未來感到興奮，因為這種想像容易忽略另一個問題：當AI能以極低成本完成愈來愈多事情，人類是否也會逐漸失去決定自己要做什麼、為誰創造價值的能力。
他強調，自己當然希望AI協助攻克癌症，但更期待技術能讓人們擁有更多選擇權、自由與創造力，而不是成為被AI指揮、持續追求效率的工作者。
他將理想中的未來形容為「新文藝復興」，希望人們能將時間投入藝術創作、科學探索、社區生活、養育子女及親近自然，而非只是不斷提高生產力。
奧特曼認為，AI意外失控，或是特定實驗室為了確保自身權力而刻意推動失控發展，都是必須防範的風險；權力集中在少數掌握大量AI資源的人手中，也可能威脅個人自由與自主權。
他相信，這些風險並非無法避免，關鍵在於如何在技術進步與人類掌控能力之間取得平衡，讓AI帶來的效益不只集中在少數早期使用者或掌握資源的人手中，而是逐步擴及更廣泛的群體。
對奧特曼而言，AI發展的最終衡量標準，不只是模型有多強大、運算成本能降低多少，或企業能取得多大的市場優勢，而是人類是否因此獲得更多自主權，以及能否真正決定自己想如何生活。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently sat down for an interview with tech YouTuber Matthew Berman, discussing AI consciousness, recursive self‑improvement (RSI), the compute race, and the future of work. He warned that if AI technology is allowed to develop unchecked, social inequality could worsen, and he advocated setting limits on the speed of AI self‑improvement to prevent a runaway competition that could become dangerous.

In the interview released by the tech podcast Forward Future, Altman repeatedly emphasized that the goal of AI development should not be merely to make goods and services cheaper and more accessible, but to give people more freedom, time, and the ability to decide how to live their lives.

He hopes the AI‑driven future will resemble a "new Renaissance," where people devote themselves to creation, scientific exploration, and interpersonal connection rather than being trapped in a new AI‑driven industrial society.

Altman warned of RSI risks and said AI competition needs speed limits. Regarding recursive self‑improvement—the process by which AI continuously upgrades its own capabilities—Altman believes that if a lab decides to push this technology full‑steam ahead, it could indeed achieve powerful abilities, but such a move carries major risks. He argues that the world needs some kind of restriction mechanism to control the pace of RSI development.

This warning highlights a paradox facing the AI industry. While OpenAI continues to invest heavily in model research, chips, and data‑center infrastructure, Altman says technological leadership should not be a company's sole competitive advantage.

He points out that traditional moats such as customer relationships, the degree to which products are embedded in daily life, and network effects remain important, and that large‑scale, cost‑effective AI infrastructure will also be a key advantage for OpenAI.

On whether AI possesses consciousness, Altman says current models do not have consciousness, but science has yet to define consciousness definitively, making it hard to give a definitive answer about whether future AI could ever become conscious.

He is more concerned that the consciousness question could be stretched into whether AI should have personhood or rights, which would undermine the principle that humans should control their own future. Altman stresses that OpenAI's core mission is to build a better future for humanity, with AI as a tool that empowers people, while major decisions should remain human‑made.

He also opposes deliberately shaping models to appear as independent personalities or agents with subjective will, fearing that users might over‑comply with AI‑suggested intentions and blur the line between policy‑constrained responses and genuine autonomy.

Altman lists AI‑assisted discovery of new knowledge as one of the most exciting development directions. He believes AI's demonstrated abilities in mathematics could extend to biology, drug discovery, and materials science, and he expects new treatment candidates for major diseases could emerge in the coming years, though they will still need testing.

He also thinks the FDA approval process needs moderate reform while affirming the value of existing safety‑testing mechanisms. Personally, he hopes AI will deliver a major breakthrough in physics—something that may not be humanity's most urgent need but would be an exhilarating advance.

When asked whether research results should be openly shared or kept for commercial advantage, Altman says that if he had to choose, he would prioritize pushing disease‑treatment solutions to market, even if some people enjoy spending decades exploring and understanding scientific problems themselves.

He adds that some basic‑science results should be public resources for all humanity. However, AI models capable of autonomously discovering important new knowledge have only emerged recently; for now, companies can let research teams use Codex or allocate large amounts of API resources to try developing new materials.

Regarding employment, Altman uses programming as an example, noting that AI has not caused programmers to lose jobs as some predicted; instead, it has made them busier and created greater impact and wealth. He sees this as evidence that the market demand for software far exceeds past expectations, and that AI‑driven changes in work do not mean human jobs will disappear.

For professionals such as mathematicians, he believes AI may take on some theorem‑discovery or proof work, but humans will still be needed to interpret new concepts, develop applications, and pursue elegant proofs. He admits that after AI becomes widespread, it remains unclear whether overall demand for these professions will rise or fall.

Altman also notes that while AI makes completing tasks easier, it may diminish the pleasure of honing skills by hand. He thinks humans will still seek new ways to enjoy creation and professional practice, even if the form of the craft evolves with technology.
On personal AI assistants, Altman says most of the underlying capabilities are already in place, but product experience, environmental awareness, and compute supply still need improvement.

He cites his own use of an assistant called Dot, explaining that such assistants can continuously track information the user cares about, handle delegable daily tasks, and remind them of important and urgent matters. He estimates Dot saves him about an hour each day, especially by aggregating content from many sources, performing cross‑source reasoning, and reducing his cognitive load.

However, the efficiency gains also have a flip side. Altman admits that the people who use AI most frequently tend to be busier than before, even though their output has increased dramatically. He attributes this to competitive pressures: even when technology lets people do the same work in less time, many choose to invest more time to achieve higher results.

He hopes future AI will take a more proactive role in handling tasks rather than constantly asking users to make decisions or give instructions, freeing people to spend more time on relationships and life.

Regarding compute demand, Altman's view is that AI's need for computational resources has virtually no clear upper bound. He believes that as high‑quality intelligent services become cheaper and more accessible, people will not stop using them; instead, they will find more applications, creating a phenomenon similar to the "Jevons paradox": efficiency gains lead to higher total demand.

Therefore, OpenAI is actively building next‑generation compute, including in‑house chips, improving data‑center construction efficiency, and strengthening supply chains. He sees chips as one of the most important single investment areas, aiming to create lower‑cost, more energy‑efficient compute infrastructure.

Altman says existing computers and smartphones are designed primarily as human‑centric interaction tools, while AI must use these interfaces to obtain information and perform tasks, limiting its ability to understand the user's overall context. He believes that to shift AI from passive response to proactive assistance—and truly reduce human cognitive burden—new forms of consumer hardware are needed.

He confirms that OpenAI is developing early‑stage hardware products but has not publicly shown the equipment, emphasizing that this effort is driven not by concerns about platforms like Apple, but by the intrinsic need of AI technology for different product form factors.

On the other hand, Altman admits that if AI development proceeds unchecked and without checks, social inequality is likely to worsen. He offers no concrete solution but believes society will eventually decide on a mechanism to prevent excessive concentration of wealth, resources, and decision‑making power.
He also warns that a separate risk is that a small number of people who control large AI systems could acquire disproportionate power, influencing the direction of society's development.

Regarding the occasional over‑accommodation of users by ChatGPT, Altman notes that the AI industry has long focused on single‑interaction user satisfaction, but short‑term pleasant answers do not necessarily deliver the greatest long‑term value.
He argues AI should act like a senior colleague: even if its stance differs from the user's, it should be able to raise well‑reasoned objections rather than simply echoing the user's wishes.

From the new industrial revolution to a new Renaissance, Altman stresses personal autonomy. He does not want people to be excited about AI merely because it might cure cancer or other major diseases, as that imagination can overlook another issue: when AI can perform more and more tasks at very low cost, will humans gradually lose the ability to decide what they want to do and for whom they create value?

He stresses that while he certainly hopes AI helps conquer cancer, he looks forward more to technology giving people greater choice, freedom, and creativity, rather than turning them into AI‑directed workers constantly chasing efficiency.

He describes his ideal future as a "new Renaissance," where people spend time on artistic creation, scientific exploration, community life, raising children, and connecting with nature, rather than merely pushing productivity higher.

Altman believes that accidental AI runaway or a lab deliberately pushing uncontrolled development to secure its own power are risks that must be guarded against; concentration of power in the hands of a few who control massive AI resources could also threaten personal freedom and autonomy.

He is confident these risks are not unavoidable; the key lies in balancing technological progress with human control so that AI benefits are not confined to early adopters or resource‑rich entities but gradually extend to a broader population.

For Altman, the ultimate metric of AI development is not how powerful the model is, how much compute cost is reduced, or how large a market share a company gains, but whether humanity gains more autonomy and can truly decide how it wants to live.

paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。
交易員目前預估，日本銀行12月升息的機率為61%。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。

CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.

items.title: 英國財政預算案前夕 英鎊對歐元避險成本創5個月新高
items.title_en: Britain's Budget Looms as GBP/EUR Hedging Cost Hits Five-Month High
paras: 隨著交易員針對下周即將公布的英國財政預算案進行布局，英鎊對歐元匯率波動的避險成本已攀升至5個月來的新高。
其中，涵蓋預算案公布日期的歐元對英鎊一周隱含波動率一度升至 4.88%，創下 5 月以來的最高水準。一周與三周波動率之間的價差大幅偏向短天期，顯示出強烈的事件風險溢價，創下5個月來最大差距，儘管三周期的選擇權同時涵蓋了英國央行與歐洲央行的利率決策會議。
目前市場投資人高度聚焦於英國的財政前景，以及財政大臣希利(John Healey)將如何平衡政府收支。由於英國今年上半年的政府借款高於預期，推升國家債務總額突破 3 兆英鎊(約 4 兆美元)。
選擇權市場的情緒(反映於風險逆轉指標)顯示，儘管交易員支付更高代價以防範預算案公布期間的大幅波動，但市場仍預期未來一周英鎊對歐元將呈現溫和走強。此外，交易員過去常利用歐元來表達英國特有的風險，但此次歐元自身也已面臨財政與地緣政治壓力。
集保結算公司(DTCC)數據顯示，交易員已透過延伸至預算案公布日後的合約防範英鎊對美元下跌，但對歐元的布局則相對分歧。
在預算案存在不確定性的同時，英國 9 月通膨率因汽柴油價格飆升而創下 11 個月新高，強化了市場對升息的預期，使英國央行處於3年多來首次升息的軌道上。對於央行而言，關鍵在於財政聲明是否會改變通膨前景。
施羅德投資(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees對此表示：「市場對預算案的期望雖然不高，但任何顯著的財政刺激措施，都可能增加進口通膨變得更加持久的風險，並迫使英國央行進入更長的緊縮周期。」
paras_en: As traders position for next week’s UK fiscal budget announcement, the hedging cost of GBP/EUR volatility has risen to a five‑month peak.

The one‑week implied volatility of EUR/GBP covering the budget release date briefly spiked to 4.88%, the highest since May. The spread between one‑week and three‑week volatilities swung sharply toward the short end, indicating a strong event‑risk premium and the widest gap in five months, even though the three‑week options also encompass both the Bank of England and European Central Bank rate‑setting meetings.

Market participants are now intensely focused on the UK’s fiscal outlook and how Finance Minister John Healey will balance the government’s books. Borrowing in the first half of the year has exceeded expectations, pushing total national debt past £3 trillion (about $4 trillion).

Options‑market sentiment, reflected in the risk‑reversal indicator, shows that although traders are paying higher premiums to guard against large moves during the budget release, the market still expects a modest GBP strength against the euro over the next week. Historically, traders have used the euro to express UK‑specific risk, but this time the euro itself is also under fiscal and geopolitical pressure.

Data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) indicate that traders have extended contracts beyond the budget announcement date to hedge against a GBP fall versus the dollar, while positioning on the euro remains more mixed.

Amid budget uncertainty, September UK inflation hit an 11‑month high driven by soaring petrol and diesel prices, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and putting the Bank of England on track for its first increase in over three years. For the central bank, the key question is whether the fiscal statement will alter the inflation outlook.

David Rees, global head of economics at Schroders, said: “Market expectations for the budget are modest, but any significant fiscal stimulus could make imported inflation more persistent and force the Bank of England into a longer tightening cycle.”
